  const [collapsedDates, setCollapsedDates] = useState({});
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);
  const [showMemberModal, setShowMemberModal] = useState(false);
  const [activePayment, setActivePayment] = useState(null);
  const [activeSplitExpense, setActiveSplitExpense] = useState(null);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [swipedId, setSwipedId] = useState(null);
  const [highlightedId, setHighlightedId] = useState(null);
  const [isSubmittingExpense, setIsSubmittingExpense] = useState(false);
  const [pendingMemberAction, setPendingMemberAction] = useState(null);
  const [pendingDeleteId, setPendingDeleteId] = useState(null);
  const [pendingSplitId, setPendingSplitId] = useState(null);
  const [pendingSettlement, setPendingSettlement] = useState(null);
  const [pendingHistoryId, setPendingHistoryId] = useState(null);
  const expenseSubmitLock = useRef(false);
  const settlementSubmitLock = useRef(false);
  usePinchGuard();

  const [date, setDate] = useState(getTodayISO());
  const [item, setItem] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(CATEGORIES[0]);

  const [odometerStart, setOdometerStart] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("lastOdometerEnd") || "",
  );
  const [odometerEnd, setOdometerEnd] = useState("");

  // ปิดการทำงานกดค้างเพื่อเลื่อนไปด้านบน
  // const [isPressing, setIsPressing] = useState(false);
  // const pressTimer = useRef(null);
  // const hasScrolled = useRef(false);

  // ดึงรายชื่อจาก Database ตรงๆ
  const refreshMembers = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!navigator.onLine) return;
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("trip_members")
      .select("name")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: true });
    if (data && data.length > 0) {
      const fetchedMembers = data.map((d) => d.name);
      setMembers(fetchedMembers);
      localStorage.setItem("tripMembers", JSON.stringify(fetchedMembers));
      setPaidBy((prev) =>
        fetchedMembers.includes(prev) ? prev : fetchedMembers[0],
      );
    }
  }, []);

  // ดึงรายจ่ายจาก Database ตรงๆ
  const refreshExpenses = useCallback(async () => {
    // 1. ตรวจสอบหากไม่มีอินเทอร์เน็ต ให้ดึงข้อมูลที่เคยแคชไว้ใน localStorage มาแสดงผลทันที
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      const cachedData = localStorage.getItem("tripExpensesCache");
      if (cachedData) {
        setExpenses(JSON.parse(cachedData));
      }
      return;
    }

    setIsSyncing(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;

      if (data) {
        // 2. หากดึงข้อมูลสำเร็จ ให้อัปเดต State และบันทึกสำรองลง localStorage
        setExpenses(data);
        localStorage.setItem("tripExpensesCache", JSON.stringify(data));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      // 3. หากเกิด Error ระหว่างดึงข้อมูล ให้ดึงข้อมูลจากแคชมาแสดงผลสำรอง
      const cachedData = localStorage.getItem("tripExpensesCache");
      if (cachedData) {
        setExpenses(JSON.parse(cachedData));
      }
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => setIsSyncing(false), 500);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. เช็กสถานะอินเทอร์เน็ตตั้งต้นของเครื่องทันทีที่เปิดแอป
    setIsOffline(!navigator.onLine);

    // 2. ฟังก์ชันจัดการเมื่อเน็ตกลับมาเชื่อมต่อ
    const handleOnline = () => {
      setIsOffline(false);
      Promise.all([refreshMembers(), refreshExpenses()]).then(() =>
        setLoading(false),
      );
    };

    // 3. ฟังก์ชันจัดการเมื่อเน็ตหลุด
    const handleOffline = () => {
      setIsOffline(true);
    };

    // 4. ผูก Event Listener ดักฟังสถานะเครือข่าย
    window.addEventListener("online", handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener("offline", handleOffline);

    // 5. สั่งดึงข้อมูลทันที (ถ้ามีเน็ตจะดึงจาก Supabase / ถ้าออฟไลน์จะดึงจาก localStorage ในเครื่อง)
    Promise.all([refreshMembers(), refreshExpenses()]).then(() =>
      setLoading(false),
    );

    // 6. ตั้งค่า Realtime Subscription สำหรับ Supabase
    const expenseSub = supabase
      .channel("trip_expenses_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_expenses" },
        refreshExpenses,
      )
      .subscribe();

    const memberSub = supabase
      .channel("trip_members_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_members" },
        refreshMembers,
      )
      .subscribe();

    // 7. คืนค่าฟังก์ชัน Cleanup เพื่อลบ Listener และ Subscription ออกเมื่อเลิกใช้งาน
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("online", handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", handleOffline);
      supabase.removeChannel(expenseSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(memberSub);
    };
  }, [refreshExpenses, refreshMembers]);

  const handleAppClick = () => {
    if (swipedId) setSwipedId(null);
  };

  // บันทึกตรงเข้า Database
  const handleAddMember = async (name, details) => {
    if (pendingMemberAction) return;
    // 1. ตรวจสอบสถานะการเชื่อมต่ออินเทอร์เน็ต
    if (isOffline)
      return dynaura.warning({
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        description: "ไม่สามารถเพิ่มสมาชิกขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
        duration: 4000,
      });

    if (!MEMBERS.includes(name)) {
      setPendingMemberAction(name);
      const notificationId = dynaura.loading({
        id: `add-member-${Date.now()}`,
        title: `กำลังเพิ่ม ${name}`,
        description: "กำลังบันทึกสมาชิกลงฐานข้อมูล",
        progress: 0.15,
      });
      // 2. บันทึกรายชื่อสมาชิกใหม่ลงฐานข้อมูล Supabase
      try {
        const { error } = await supabase.from("trip_members").insert([{ name }]);
        if (error) throw error;
        dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });

        setPaidBy(name);
        localStorage.setItem("defaultPaidBy", name);

        await refreshMembers();

        if (details) handleUpdateMemberDetails(name, details, false);
        dynaura.update(notificationId, {
          type: "success",
          title: "เพิ่ม " + name + " สำเร็จ",
          description: undefined,
          progress: undefined,
          duration: 3000,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        dynaura.update(notificationId, {
          type: "error",
          title: "เพิ่มไม่สำเร็จ",
          description: error.message,
          progress: undefined,
          duration: 5000,
        });
      } finally {
        setPendingMemberAction(null);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateMemberDetails = (name, details, showToast = true) => {
    const updated = { ...memberDetails, [name]: details };
    setMemberDetails(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("memberDetails", JSON.stringify(updated));
    if (showToast)
      dynaura.success({
        title: "บันทึกข้อมูลเรียบร้อย",
        description: `ข้อมูลการชำระเงินของ ${name}`,
        duration: 1000,
      });
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async (name, hasDebt) => {
    if (pendingMemberAction) return;
    if (isOffline)
      return dynaura.warning({
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        description: "ไม่สามารถลบสมาชิกขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
        duration: 4000,
      });
    if (MEMBERS.length <= 1)
      return dynaura.warning({
        title: "ลบไม่ได้",
        description: "ต้องมีสมาชิกอย่างน้อย 1 คน",
        duration: 4000,
      });
    if (hasDebt)
      return dynaura.error({
        title: "ลบไม่ได้",
        description: `${name} มียอดค้างชำระอยู่`,
        duration: 4000,
      });

    const result = await Swal.fire({
      ...SWAL_THEME,
      title: "ยืนยันการลบ",
      text: `ลบ ${name} ออกจากทริป?`,
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "ลบ",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
      customClass: {
        ...SWAL_THEME.customClass,
        confirmButton:
          "bg-red-600 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-500 transition text-sm cursor-pointer",
      },
    });
    if (!result.isConfirmed) return;
    setPendingMemberAction(name);
    const notificationId = dynaura.loading({
      id: `remove-member-${name}-${Date.now()}`,
      title: `กำลังลบ ${name}`,
      description: "กำลังอัปเดตรายชื่อสมาชิก",
      progress: 0.15,
    });
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_members")
        .delete()
        .eq("name", name);
      if (error) throw error;
      dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });
      await refreshMembers();
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "success",
        title: `ลบ ${name} แล้ว`,
        description: undefined,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 3000,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "error",
        title: "ลบไม่สำเร็จ",
        description: error.message,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 5000,
      });
    } finally {
      setPendingMemberAction(null);
    }
  };

  const handleAddExpense = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (expenseSubmitLock.current) return;
    if (isOffline)
      return Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "warning",
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        text: "ไม่สามารถบันทึกรายการขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
      });

    const numericAmount = Number(amount);
    if (!Number.isFinite(numericAmount) || numericAmount <= 0)
      return Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "warning",
        title: "กรุณากรอกจำนวนเงิน",
      });

    const wasEditing = Boolean(editId);
    expenseSubmitLock.current = true;
    setIsSubmittingExpense(true);
    const notificationId = dynaura.loading({
      id: `expense-${wasEditing ? "edit" : "add"}-${Date.now()}`,
      title: wasEditing ? "กำลังแก้ไขรายการ" : "กำลังบันทึกรายการ",
      description: item.trim() || category,
      progress: 0.12,
    });

    const payload = {
      expense_date: formatForDB(date),
      item_name: item.trim() || category,
      amount: numericAmount,
      category,
      paid_by: paidBy,
      split_between: [paidBy],
      odometer_start:
        category === "ค่าน้ำมัน" && odometerStart
          ? Number(odometerStart)
          : null,
      odometer_end:
        category === "ค่าน้ำมัน" && odometerEnd ? Number(odometerEnd) : null,
    };

    try {
      if (wasEditing) {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .update(payload)
          .eq("id", editId);
        if (error) throw error;
        dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });
        setEditId(null);
        setHighlightedId(editId);
        setTimeout(() => setHighlightedId(null), 2000);
      } else {
        const { error } = await supabase.from("trip_expenses").insert([payload]);
        if (error) throw error;
        dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });
      }

      await refreshExpenses();
      dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 1 });
      setItem("");
      setAmount("");
      setCategory(CATEGORIES[0]);
      setOdometerStart("");
      setOdometerEnd("");
      localStorage.setItem("lastOdometerEnd", "");
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "success",
        title: wasEditing ? "แก้ไขสำเร็จ" : "บันทึกสำเร็จ",
        description: `${formatMoney(numericAmount)} บาท`,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 4000,
        confetti: true,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "error",
        title: wasEditing ? "แก้ไขไม่สำเร็จ" : "บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ",
        description: error.message,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 5000,
      });
    } finally {
      expenseSubmitLock.current = false;
      setIsSubmittingExpense(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateSplit = async (id, newSplit) => {
    if (pendingSplitId) return false;
    if (isOffline) {
      dynaura.warning({
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        description: "ไม่สามารถแก้ไขการหารขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
        duration: 4000,
      });
      return false;
    }
    setPendingSplitId(id);
    const notificationId = dynaura.loading({
      id: `update-split-${id}-${Date.now()}`,
      title: "กำลังอัปเดตการหาร",
      description: "กำลังบันทึกผู้ร่วมรายการ",
      progress: 0.15,
    });
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .update({ split_between: newSplit })
        .eq("id", id);
      if (error) throw error;
      dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });
      await refreshExpenses();
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "success",
        title: "อัปเดตการหารสำเร็จ",
        description: "ยอดแบ่งรายการได้รับการอัปเดต",
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 3000,
      });
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "error",
        title: "อัปเดตไม่สำเร็จ",
        description: error.message,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 5000,
      });
      return false;
    } finally {
      setPendingSplitId(null);
    }
  };

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setDate(getTodayISO());
    setItem("");
    setAmount("");
    setCategory(CATEGORIES[0]);
    setOdometerStart("");
    setOdometerEnd("");
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (pendingDeleteId) return;
    if (isOffline)
      return dynaura.warning({
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        description: "ไม่สามารถลบรายการขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
        duration: 4000,
      });
    const r = await Swal.fire({
      ...SWAL_THEME,
      title: "ยืนยันการลบ?",
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "ลบ",
      customClass: {
        ...SWAL_THEME.customClass,
        confirmButton:
          "bg-red-600 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-500 transition text-sm cursor-pointer",
      },
    });
    if (r.isConfirmed) {
      setPendingDeleteId(id);
      const notificationId = dynaura.loading({
        id: `delete-expense-${id}-${Date.now()}`,
        title: "กำลังลบรายการ",
        description: "กำลังอัปเดตรายจ่ายและยอดคงเหลือ",
        progress: 0.15,
      });
      try {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .delete()
          .eq("id", id);
        if (error) throw error;
        dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });
        await refreshExpenses();
        dynaura.update(notificationId, {
          type: "success",
          title: "ลบรายการแล้ว",
          description: "รายจ่ายและยอดคงเหลือถูกอัปเดต",
          progress: undefined,
          duration: 3000,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        dynaura.update(notificationId, {
          type: "error",
          title: "ลบไม่สำเร็จ",
          description: error.message,
          progress: undefined,
          duration: 5000,
        });
      } finally {
        setPendingDeleteId(null);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleUndoHistory = async (id) => {
    if (pendingHistoryId) return;
    if (isOffline)
      return dynaura.warning({
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        description: "ไม่สามารถกู้คืนยอดขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
        duration: 4000,
      });
    setPendingHistoryId(id);
    const notificationId = dynaura.loading({
      id: `undo-history-${id}-${Date.now()}`,
      title: "กำลังกู้คืนยอด",
      description: "กำลังลบประวัติการเคลียร์ยอด",
      progress: 0.15,
    });
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .delete()
        .eq("id", id);
      if (error) throw error;
      dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });
      await refreshExpenses();
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "success",
        title: "กู้คืนยอดเรียบร้อย",
        description: "ยอดค้างชำระถูกคำนวณใหม่",
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 3000,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "error",
        title: "กู้คืนไม่สำเร็จ",
        description: error.message,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 5000,
      });
    } finally {
      setPendingHistoryId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleSettleDebt = async (from, to, settleAmount) => {
    if (settlementSubmitLock.current) return;
    if (isOffline)
      return Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "warning",
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        text: "ไม่สามารถทำรายการขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
      });
    const today = new Date();
    const formattedDate = `${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}/${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}/${today.getFullYear()}`;
    const newHistory = {
      expense_date: formattedDate,
      item_name: `[เคลียร์ยอด] ${from} -> ${to}`,
      amount: settleAmount,
      category: HISTORY_CATEGORY,
      paid_by: from,
      split_between: [from], // 👈 🧠 เพิ่มบรรทัดนี้เข้ามา! เพื่อแก้บั๊กไม่ให้ฐานข้อมูลเตือน Error
    };

    settlementSubmitLock.current = true;
    setPendingSettlement(`${from}-${to}`);
    const notificationId = dynaura.loading({
      id: `settle-${from}-${to}-${Date.now()}`,
      title: "กำลังบันทึกประวัติการโอน",
      description: `${from} → ${to}`,
      progress: 0.15,
    });
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.from("trip_expenses").insert([newHistory]);
      if (error) throw error;
      dynaura.update(notificationId, { progress: 0.72 });
      setActivePayment(null);
      await refreshExpenses();
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "success",
        title: "บันทึกประวัติการโอนแล้ว",
        description: `฿${formatMoney(settleAmount)} จาก ${from} ถึง ${to}`,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 4000,
        confetti: true,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      dynaura.update(notificationId, {
        type: "error",
        title: "บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ",
        description: error.message,
        progress: undefined,
        duration: 5000,
      });
    } finally {
      settlementSubmitLock.current = false;
      setPendingSettlement(null);
    }
  };

  // ปิดการทำงานกดค้างเพื่อเลื่อนไปด้านบน
  // const startPressTimer = () => {
  //   hasScrolled.current = false;
  //   setIsPressing(true);
  //   pressTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
  //     window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  //     hasScrolled.current = true;
  //     setIsPressing(false);
  //   }, 400);
  // };
  // const cancelPressTimer = () => {
  //   clearTimeout(pressTimer.current);
  //   setIsPressing(false);
  // };

  const regularExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (e) => e.category !== HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const historyExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (e) => e.category === HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const groupedExpenses = useMemo(
    () =>
      regularExpenses.reduce((groups, expense) => {
        (groups[expense.expense_date] ||= []).push(expense);
        return groups;
      }, {}),
    [regularExpenses],
  );
  const totalExpense = useMemo(
    () => regularExpenses.reduce((sum, e) => sum + Number(e.amount), 0),
    [regularExpenses],
  );

  const settlements = useSettlements(expenses, MEMBERS);

  // หน้าจอตอนกำลังโหลดข้อมูลตอนเปิดแอปครั้งแรก
  // if (loading) {
  //   return (
  //     <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-950 p-6 text-center text-gray-100">
  //       <Loader2 size={48} className="mb-4 animate-spin text-lime-400" />
  //       <p className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-400">
  //         กำลังเชื่อมต่อฐานข้อมูล...
  //       </p>
  //     </div>
  //   );
  // }

  return (
    <div
      className="relative min-h-dvh bg-gray-950 pb-24 font-sans text-gray-100"
      onClick={handleAppClick}
    >
      <Toaster position="top" theme="dark" offset={12} haptics />
      <style>{`
        @keyframes drawRing { 0% { stroke-dashoffset: 176; } 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
        .animate-draw-fast { animation: drawRing 0.4s linear forwards; }
      `}</style>

            }

              setEditId(exp.id);
              setDate(parseForUI(exp.expense_date));
              setPaidBy(exp.paid_by);
              setItem(exp.item_name);
              setAmount(exp.amount);
              setCategory(exp.category);
              setOdometerStart(exp.odometer_start || "");
              setOdometerEnd(exp.odometer_end || "");
              window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
            }}
            onDelete={handleDelete}
            onOpenSplitModal={setActiveSplitExpense}
            pendingDeleteId={pendingDeleteId}
            pendingSplitId={pendingSplitId}
            swipedId={swipedId}
            setSwipedId={setSwipedId}
            highlightedId={highlightedId}
            MEMBERS={MEMBERS}
          />
        </div>

        <SettlementSection
          settlements={settlements}
          onOpenPayment={setActivePayment}
          onOpenHistory={() => setShowHistory(true)}
          pendingSettlement={pendingSettlement}
        />
      </main>

      <ThemeMenu />

      {showMemberModal && (
        <MemberModal
          members={MEMBERS}
          balances={settlements.balances}
          memberDetails={memberDetails}
          onClose={() => setShowMemberModal(false)}
          onAdd={handleAddMember}
          onRemove={handleRemoveMember}
          onUpdateDetails={handleUpdateMemberDetails}
          pendingMemberAction={pendingMemberAction}
        />
      )}
      {activePayment && (
        <PaymentModal
          from={activePayment.from}
          to={activePayment.to}
          amount={activePayment.amount}
          memberDetails={memberDetails}
          onClose={() => setActivePayment(null)}
          onUpdateDetails={handleUpdateMemberDetails}
          onConfirm={handleSettleDebt}
          isSubmitting={Boolean(pendingSettlement)}
        />
      )}
      {activeSplitExpense && (
        <SplitModal
          expense={activeSplitExpense}
          members={MEMBERS}
          onClose={() => setActiveSplitExpense(null)}
          onSave={handleUpdateSplit}
        />
      )}
      {showHistory && (
        <HistoryModal
          expenses={historyExpenses}
          onClose={() => setShowHistory(false)}
          onUndo={handleUndoHistory}
          pendingHistoryId={pendingHistoryId}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/ExpenseItem.jsx =====
import { Edit2, Trash2, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import useSwipeDrag from "../hooks/useSwipeDrag";

export default function ExpenseItem({
  expense,
  MEMBERS,
  swipedId,
  setSwipedId,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onOpenSplitModal,
  isLast,
  isHighlighted, //  รับ State การ Highlight
  isPendingDelete,
  isPendingSplit,
}) {
  const validSplit = expense.split_between?.filter(m => MEMBERS.includes(m)) || [];
  const itemRef = useRef(null); //  Ref สำหรับเลื่อนหน้าจอ
  const isOpen = swipedId === expense.id;
  const {
    drag,
    currentOffset,
    isSwiped,
    consumeSuppressedClick,
    touchHandlers,
    mouseHandlers,
  } = useSwipeDrag({
    id: expense.id,
    isOpen,
    setOpen: setSwipedId,
  });

  //  สั่ง Auto-scroll มาที่ Item นี้เมื่อโดน Highlight
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isHighlighted && itemRef.current) {
      itemRef.current.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: "smooth",
        block: "center", // ให้กล่องรายการอยู่ตรงกลางจอพอดี
      });
    }
  }, [isHighlighted]);

  const splitList = validSplit.length > 0 
  ? validSplit
  : (MEMBERS.includes(expense.paid_by) ? [expense.paid_by] : [MEMBERS[0]]); // ถ้าไม่มีใครอยู่ใน split_between ให้ใช้ paid_by หรือสมาชิกคนแรกแทน
  const isGas = expense.category === "ค่าน้ำมัน";
  const distance =
    isGas && expense.odometer_start && expense.odometer_end
      ? Number(expense.odometer_end) - Number(expense.odometer_start)
      : 0;


  return (
    <div
      ref={itemRef} //  ผูก Ref เพื่อดึงหน้าจอ
      className={`relative bg-gray-900 ${!isLast ? "border-b border-gray-800" : ""}`}
    >
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 flex items-center justify-center">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            onDelete(expense.id);
            setSwipedId(null);
          }}
          disabled={isPendingDelete}
          className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-white shadow-sm transition ${
            isPendingDelete
              ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
              : "bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600"
          }`}
          style={{
            opacity: Math.min(1, -currentOffset / 40),
            transform: `scale(${Math.min(1.2, 0.2 + (-currentOffset / 70) * 0.8)})`,
            transition: drag.active
              ? "none"
              : "all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        //  สลับ Class การสว่าง (Highlight สีเหลือง) หาก isHighlighted เป็น true
        className={`relative z-10 flex cursor-grab touch-pan-y items-center justify-between p-3 pl-8 active:cursor-grabbing transition-colors duration-700 ${
          isHighlighted ? "bg-yellow-200/30 shadow-[inset_4px_0_0_#c9c9af]" : "bg-gray-800"
        }`}
        style={{
          transform: `translate3d(${currentOffset}px, 0, 0)`,
          transition: drag.active
            ? "none"
            : "transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.5s ease-out, box-shadow 0.5s ease-out, border-radius 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s",
          borderTopRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
          borderBottomRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
        }}
        {...touchHandlers}
        {...mouseHandlers}
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (consumeSuppressedClick()) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
          }
          setSwipedId(null);
        }}
      >
        <div className="pointer-events-none flex-1">
          <p className="mb-0.5 text-xs text-gray-400">
            จ่ายโดย:{" "}
            <span className="font-bold text-lime-400">{expense.paid_by}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="font-medium text-gray-100">{expense.item_name}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
            {expense.category}{" "}
            {splitList.length > 0 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-sky-400">
                {" "}
                (หาร {splitList.length} คน)
              </span>
            )}
          </p>
          {distance > 0 && (
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-400">
              ไมล์ {expense.odometer_start} - {expense.odometer_end} ({distance}{" "}
              กม.)
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <p className="pointer-events-none font-bold text-gray-100">
            ฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)}
          </p>
          <div className="relative z-20 flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              disabled={isPendingSplit}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onOpenSplitModal(expense);
              }}
              className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-gray-400 transition ${
                isPendingSplit
                  ? "cursor-not-allowed border-gray-500 bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                  : "border-gray-600 hover:border-sky-400 hover:bg-sky-400/10 hover:text-sky-400"
              }`}
              title="เลือกคนหาร"
              aria-label="เลือกคนหาร"
            >
              <Users size={19} />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onEdit(expense);
                setSwipedId(null);
              }}
              className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-gray-400 transition hover:bg-lime-400/10 hover:text-lime-400"
              title="แก้ไขรายการ"
              aria-label="แก้ไขรายการ"
            >
              <Edit2 size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: src/components/ExpenseList.jsx =====
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, FolderClosed, FolderOpen, Maximize2, Minimize2, Receipt } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import ExpenseItem from "./ExpenseItem";

export default function ExpenseList({
  expenses,
  groupedExpenses,
  loading,
  isExpanded,
  collapsedDates,
  onToggleExpanded,
  onToggleDate,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onOpenSplitModal,
  swipedId,
  setSwipedId,
  highlightedId, 
  MEMBERS,
  pendingDeleteId,
  pendingSplitId,
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      if (swipedId) setSwipedId(null);
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, [swipedId, setSwipedId]);

  return (
    <section
      className="relative rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm"
      onClick={() => setSwipedId(null)}
    >
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-100">
          <Receipt size={20} /> <h2>รายการ ({expenses.length})</h2>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onToggleExpanded}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-300 shadow-sm"
        >
          {isExpanded ? <Minimize2 size={14} /> : <Maximize2 size={14} />}{" "}
          {isExpanded ? "ย่อเก็บ" : "ดูเต็ม"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">กำลังโหลด...</p>
      ) : expenses.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">ไม่มีรายการ</p>
      ) : (
        <div
          className={`space-y-4 pr-2 transition-all ${!isExpanded ? "max-h-96 overflow-y-auto overscroll-none" : ""}`}
        >
          {Object.keys(groupedExpenses).map((date) => (
            <div
              key={date}
              className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 shadow-sm"
            >
              <button
                onClick={() => onToggleDate(date)}
                className="relative z-20 flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-t-lg border-b-2 border-gray-700 bg-gray-700 p-3 hover:bg-gray-600"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-100">
                  {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                    <FolderClosed size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                  ) : (
                    <FolderOpen size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                  )}
                  <span>{date}</span>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-gray-600 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-normal text-gray-300">
                    {groupedExpenses[date].length} รายการ
                  </span>
                </div>
                {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                  <ChevronRight size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronDown size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                )}
              </button>
              <div
                className={`grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${collapsedDates[date] ? "grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0" : "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"}`}
              >
                <div className="overflow-hidden bg-gray-900 ">
                  {groupedExpenses[date].map((expense, index) => (
                    <ExpenseItem
                      key={expense.id}
                      expense={expense}
                      swipedId={swipedId}
                      setSwipedId={setSwipedId}
                      onEdit={onEdit}
                      onDelete={onDelete}
                      onOpenSplitModal={onOpenSplitModal}
                      isLast={index === groupedExpenses[date].length - 1}
                      isHighlighted={highlightedId === expense.id} 
                      MEMBERS={MEMBERS}
                      isPendingDelete={pendingDeleteId === expense.id}
                      isPendingSplit={pendingSplitId === expense.id}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

===== FILE: src/components/HistoryModal.jsx =====
import { History, RotateCcw, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

export default function HistoryModal({ expenses, onClose, onUndo, pendingHistoryId }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
  }, [onClose]);

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/60"
      panelClassName="max-h-[80vh] max-w-md"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
            <History size={20} /> ประวัติการเคลียร์ยอด
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="hover:text-lime-300">
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          {expenses.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-10 text-center text-gray-400">
              ยังไม่มีประวัติการโอนเงิน
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {expenses.map((expense) => (
                <div
                  key={expense.id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-3"
                >
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      {expense.expense_date}
                    </p>
                    <p className="font-medium text-gray-100">
                      {expense.item_name}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-right">
                    <p className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                      ฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)}
                    </p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onUndo(expense.id)}
                      disabled={pendingHistoryId === expense.id}
                      className={`ml-2 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-3xl border px-2 py-1 text-xs transition ${
                        pendingHistoryId === expense.id
                          ? "cursor-not-allowed border-gray-500 bg-gray-500 text-gray-300 shimmer"
                          : "border-sky-500/30 bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-400 hover:bg-sky-500 hover:text-gray-950"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <RotateCcw size={14} /> กู้คืน
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/MemberItem.jsx =====
import { Edit2, Save, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { BANKS } from "../data/constants";
import useSwipeDrag from "../hooks/useSwipeDrag";

export default function MemberItem({
  member,
  hasDebt,
  details,
  onRemove,
  onUpdateDetails,
  swipedMember,
  setSwipedMember,
  isEditing,
  onEdit,
  setShowNewPayForm,
  isPending,
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    promptpay: details?.promptpay || "",
    bankId: details?.bankId || "kbank",
    bankAcc: details?.bankAcc || "",
  });

  const isOpen = swipedMember === member;
  const {
    drag,
    currentOffset,
    isSwiped,
    consumeSuppressedClick,
    touchHandlers,
    mouseHandlers,
  } = useSwipeDrag({
    id: member,
    isOpen,
    setOpen: setSwipedMember,
    canDrag: !isEditing,
  });

  return (
    <div className="relative mb-2 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-800 bg-gray-900/50">
      
      {/* 💻 [Desktop View] ปุ่มลบโชว์ไว้ตลอดทางด้านขวา ไม่ต้องปัด */}
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 hidden md:flex items-center justify-center z-20">
        <button
          onClick={() => onRemove(member, hasDebt)}
          disabled={isPending}
          className={`flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition ${
            isPending
              ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
              : hasDebt
              ? "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
              : "bg-red-500 text-white hover:bg-red-600"
          }`}
          title={hasDebt ? "มียอดค้างชำระ ลบไม่ได้" : "ลบสมาชิก"}
        >
          <Trash2 size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 📱 [Mobile View] ปุ่มลบสำหรับระบบ Swipe */}
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 flex md:hidden items-center justify-center">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            onRemove(member, hasDebt);
            setSwipedMember(null);
          }}
          disabled={isPending}
          className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition ${
            isPending
              ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
              : hasDebt
              ? "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
              : "bg-red-500 text-white hover:bg-red-600"
          }`}
          style={{
            opacity: Math.min(1, -currentOffset / 40),
            transform: `scale(${Math.min(1.08, 0.2 + (-currentOffset / 70) * 0.8)})`,
            transition: drag.active ? "none" : "all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-800 p-3 md:pr-14"
        style={{
          transform: `translate3d(${currentOffset}px, 0, 0)`,
          transition: drag.active
            ? "none"
            : "transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-radius 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s",
          borderTopRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
          borderBottomRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
        }}
        {...touchHandlers}
        {...mouseHandlers}
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (consumeSuppressedClick()) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
          }
          setSwipedMember(null);
        }}
      >
        <span className="font-medium text-gray-100">{member}</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              onEdit();
              setShowNewPayForm(false); 
            }}
            className="p-1.5 text-sky-400 transition hover:bg-sky-400/20 rounded z-30"
          >
            <Edit2 size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {isEditing && (
        <div className="border-t border-gray-700 bg-gray-900/80 p-3 space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] text-gray-400">
              เบอร์พร้อมเพย์ (เว้นว่างได้)
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={form.promptpay}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, promptpay: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              placeholder="เช่น 0812345678"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                ธนาคาร (หลัก)
              </label>
              <select
                value={form.bankId}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, bankId: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-xs focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              >
                {BANKS.map((b) => (
                  <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                    {b.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                เลขบัญชี
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={form.bankAcc}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, bankAcc: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                placeholder="เลขบัญชี..."
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              onUpdateDetails(member, form);
              onEdit(); // ปิดฟอร์มแก้ไขหลังจากกดบันทึก
            }}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded bg-lime-400 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300"
          >
            <Save size={16} /> บันทึกข้อมูล
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/MemberModal.jsx =====
import { Plus, UserPlus, Users, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BANKS } from "../data/constants";
import MemberItem from "./MemberItem";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

export default function MemberModal({
  members,
  balances,
  memberDetails,
  onClose,
  onAdd,
  onRemove,
  onUpdateDetails,
  pendingMemberAction,
}) {
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [showNewPayForm, setShowNewPayForm] = useState(false);
  const [newPayForm, setNewPayForm] = useState({
    promptpay: "",
    bankId: "kbank",
    bankAcc: "",
  });
  const [swipedMember, setSwipedMember] = useState(null);
  const [editingMember, setEditingMember] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleAdd = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = newName.trim();
    if (trimmed) {
      onAdd(trimmed, showNewPayForm ? newPayForm : null);
      setNewName("");
      setShowNewPayForm(false);
      setNewPayForm({ promptpay: "", bankId: "kbank", bankAcc: "" });
    }
  };

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/70"
      panelClassName="max-h-[85vh] max-w-md"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
            <Users size={20} /> จัดการสมาชิก
          </h2>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-gray-400 hover:text-lime-300"
          >
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          <div className="mb-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800/30 p-3">
            <form onSubmit={handleAdd} className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={newName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อ..."
                className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!newName.trim() || Boolean(pendingMemberAction)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-gray-950 transition ${
                  pendingMemberAction
                    ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                    : "bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300"
                } disabled:opacity-50`}
              >
                <UserPlus size={16} /> เพิ่ม
              </button>
            </form>

            {!showNewPayForm ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowNewPayForm(true);
                  setEditingMember(null);
                }}
                className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-sky-400 hover:text-sky-300 transition"
              >
                <Plus size={12} /> เพิ่มวิธีการชำระเงินให้{" "}
                {newName || "เพื่อนใหม่"} (ตั้งค่าภายหลังได้)
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 border-t border-gray-700 pt-3 relative">
                <div className="flex justify-end pr-2 ">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowNewPayForm(false)}
                    className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] bg-red-700 p-1.5 rounded font-medium text-gray-200 transition hover:text-red-500"
                  >
                    <X size={12} /> ยกเลิก
                  </button>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="เบอร์พร้อมเพย์..."
                  value={newPayForm.promptpay}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNewPayForm({ ...newPayForm, promptpay: e.target.value })
                  }
                  className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                />
                <p className="font-medium text-xs text-sky-400 ">หรือ</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2 ">
                  <select
                    value={newPayForm.bankId}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewPayForm({ ...newPayForm, bankId: e.target.value })
                    }
                    className="flex rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {BANKS.map((b) => (
                      <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                        {b.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="เลขบัญชี..."
                    value={newPayForm.bankAcc}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewPayForm({ ...newPayForm, bankAcc: e.target.value })
                    }
                    className="flex rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none w-full"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">
              ปัดซ้ายเพื่อลบสมาชิก ({members.length})
            </p>
            {members.map((member) => {
              const balance =
                balances.find((b) => b.member === member)?.balance || 0;
              const hasDebt = Math.abs(balance) > 0.01;
              const details = memberDetails[member] || {};
              return (
                <MemberItem
                  key={member}
                  setShowNewPayForm={setShowNewPayForm}
                  member={member}
                  hasDebt={hasDebt}
                  details={details}
                  onRemove={onRemove}
                  onUpdateDetails={onUpdateDetails}
                  swipedMember={swipedMember}
                  setSwipedMember={setSwipedMember}
                  isEditing={editingMember === member}
                  isPending={pendingMemberAction === member}
                  onEdit={() =>
                    setEditingMember(editingMember === member ? null : member)
                  }
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}


===== FILE: src/components/ModalShell.jsx =====
export default function ModalShell({
  children,
  onClose,
  backdropClassName = "bg-gray-950/70",
  panelClassName = "",
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm ${backdropClassName}`}
      style={{ touchAction: "pan-x pan-y" }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={`flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 text-gray-100 shadow-2xl ${panelClassName}`}
        style={{ touchAction: "pan-x pan-y" }}
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { CheckCircle, Copy } from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { BANKS, SWAL_THEME } from "../data/constants";
import { formatMoney, openBankApp } from "../utils/trip";
import Swal from "sweetalert2";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

export default function PaymentModal({
  from,
  to,
  amount,
  memberDetails,
  onUpdateDetails,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  isSubmitting,
}) {
  const details = memberDetails[to] || {};
  // const [tab, setTab] = useState(details.promptpay ? "qr" : "bank");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("qr");
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    promptpay: details.promptpay || "",
    bankId: details.bankId || "kbank",
    bankAcc: details.bankAcc || "",
  });

  const selectedBank = BANKS.find(
    (b) => b.id === (details.bankId || form.bankId),
  );

  const handleSaveDetails = () => {
    onUpdateDetails(to, form);
  };

  const handleConfirmPay = async () => {
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    const result = await Swal.fire({
      ...SWAL_THEME,
      title: `ยืนยันการโอนเงิน`,
      html: `คุณโอนเงิน <strong class="text-2xl text-lime-400">฿${formatMoney(amount)}</strong> ให้ ${to} เรียบร้อยแล้วใช่หรือไม่?`,
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "โอนเรียบร้อย",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
    });
    if (result.isConfirmed) {
      onConfirm(from, to, amount);
    }
  };

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/80"
      panelClassName="max-w-sm"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
        <div className="bg-gray-800 p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">ชำระเงินให้</p>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-lime-400">{to}</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-3xl font-bold text-white">
            ฿{formatMoney(amount)}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex border-b border-gray-800">
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("qr")}
            className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition ${tab === "qr" ? "border-b-2 border-lime-400 text-lime-400" : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-300"}`}
          >
            สแกนคิวอาร์
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("bank")}
            className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition ${tab === "bank" ? "border-b-2 border-lime-400 text-lime-400" : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-300"}`}
          >
            คัดลอกบัญชี
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-5">
          {tab === "qr" && (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
              {details.promptpay ? (
                <>
                  <div className="mb-4 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-white p-2">
                    <img
                      src={`https://promptpay.io/${details.promptpay}/${amount}.png`}
                      alt="PromptPay QR"
                      className="h-48 w-48 object-contain"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    พร้อมเพย์:{" "}
                    <span className="font-mono text-gray-200">
                      {details.promptpay}
                    </span>
                  </p>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="w-full space-y-3">
                  <p className="text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
                    ไม่มีข้อมูลพร้อมเพย์ของ {to}
                  </p>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={form.promptpay}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({ ...form, promptpay: e.target.value })
                    }
                    placeholder="กรอกเบอร์โทรหรือเลขบัตร..."
                    className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSaveDetails}
                    className="w-full rounded bg-gray-700 py-2 text-sm font-bold hover:bg-gray-600 transition"
                  >
                    บันทึกและสร้าง QR
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {tab === "bank" && (
            <div className="flex flex-col">
              {details.bankAcc ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-gray-800 bg-gray-800/50 p-4 text-center">
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      {selectedBank?.name}
                    </p>
                    <p className="font-mono text-lg tracking-wider text-gray-100">
                      {details.bankAcc}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() =>
                        openBankApp(
                          details.bankAcc,
                          selectedBank?.scheme,
                          "คัดลอกเลขบัญชีแล้ว",
                        )
                      }
                      className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 py-3 text-sm text-gray-300 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
                    >
                      <Copy size={16} /> ก๊อปเลขบัญชีและเปิดแอปธนาคาร
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                    *เมื่อกดปุ่ม ระบบจะพยายามเปิดแอปธนาคารให้อัตโนมัติ
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="w-full space-y-3">
                  <p className="text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
                    ไม่มีข้อมูลบัญชีของ {to}
                  </p>
                  <select
                    value={form.bankId}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({ ...form, bankId: e.target.value })
                    }
                    className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {BANKS.map((b) => (
                      <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                        {b.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={form.bankAcc}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({ ...form, bankAcc: e.target.value })
                    }
                    placeholder="เลขบัญชี..."
                    className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSaveDetails}
                    className="w-full rounded bg-gray-700 py-2 text-sm font-bold hover:bg-gray-600 transition"
                  >
                    บันทึกข้อมูลบัญชี
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="mt-6 flex gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-700 transition"
            >
              ปิดหน้าต่าง
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleConfirmPay}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className={`flex-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg py-3 text-sm font-bold text-gray-950 transition ${
                isSubmitting
                  ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                  : "bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300"
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCircle size={16} /> {isSubmitting ? "กำลังบันทึก..." : "ยืนยันการโอน"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}

===== FILE: src/components/SplitModal.jsx =====
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

export default function SplitModal({ expense, members, onClose, onSave }) {
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSplit, setSelectedSplit] = useState(() => {
    const rawSplit =
      expense?.split_between?.length > 0
        ? expense.split_between
        : [expense.paid_by];
    return rawSplit.filter((m) => members.includes(m));
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleToggle = (member) =>
    setSelectedSplit((prev) =>
      prev.includes(member)
        ? prev.filter((m) => m !== member)
        : [...prev, member],
    );
  const isAllSelected =
    selectedSplit.length === members.length && members.length > 0;
  const handleToggleAll = () =>
    isAllSelected ? setSelectedSplit([]) : setSelectedSplit([...members]);

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/70"
      panelClassName="max-w-sm"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-800 bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-gray-100">
              ระบุผู้หารรายการ
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-lime-400 font-medium">
              {expense.item_name} (฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)})
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4">
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">เลือกคนที่ร่วมหาร</p>
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-lime-400 hover:text-lime-300">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isAllSelected}
                onChange={handleToggleAll}
                className="split-check h-3.5 w-3.5 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span>เลือกทุกคน</span>
            </label>
          </div>
          <div className="mb-4 max-h-56 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {members.map((member) => (
              <label
                key={member}
                className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-800 bg-gray-800/60 p-3 transition hover:bg-gray-750"
              >
                <span className="font-medium text-gray-100 text-sm">
                  {member}
                </span>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={selectedSplit.includes(member)}
                  onChange={() => handleToggle(member)}
                  className="split-check h-4 w-4 cursor-pointer"
                />
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
            >
              ยกเลิก
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              disabled={isSaving}
              onClick={async () => {
                setIsSaving(true);
                const success = await onSave(expense.id, selectedSplit);
                setIsSaving(false);
                if (success) onClose();
              }}
              className={`flex-1 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-950 transition ${
                isSaving
                  ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                  : "bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300"
              }`}
            >
              {isSaving ? "กำลังบันทึก..." : "ตกลง"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed bottom-[max(1.25rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] right-5 z-40 h-14 w-14"

import { Check, RefreshCw, Users } from "lucide-react";

export default function TripHeader({
  totalExpense,
  isSyncing,
  onRefresh,
  MEMBERS,
  onOpenMemberModal,
}) {
  const [syncStatus, setSyncStatus] = useState("idle");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSyncing) setSyncStatus("syncing");
    else if (!isSyncing && syncStatus === "syncing") {
      setSyncStatus("success");
      setTimeout(() => setSyncStatus("idle"), 1500);
    }
  }, [isSyncing, syncStatus]);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-gray-900 p-4 text-gray-100 shadow-md">
      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-md text-center">
        <button
          onClick={onOpenMemberModal}

        >
          <Users size={20} className="text-lime-400" />
          <span className="text-base font-bold text-gray-300">
            {MEMBERS.length}
          </span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={onRefresh}
          disabled={syncStatus === "syncing"}
          className="absolute right-1 top-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-800 transition hover:bg-gray-700"

===== FILE: src/context/ThemeContext.jsx =====
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("tripTheme") || "dark",
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    localStorage.setItem("tripTheme", theme);
  }, [theme]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider");
  return context;
}

===== FILE: src/hooks/usePinchGuard.js =====
import { useEffect } from "react";

export default function usePinchGuard() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const preventPinchTouch = (event) => {
      if (event.touches?.length > 1) event.preventDefault();
    };
    const preventSafariGesture = (event) => event.preventDefault();

    document.addEventListener("touchmove", preventPinchTouch, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener("gesturestart", preventSafariGesture, {
      passive: false,
    });
    document.addEventListener("gesturechange", preventSafariGesture, {
      passive: false,
    });

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("touchmove", preventPinchTouch);
      document.removeEventListener("gesturestart", preventSafariGesture);
      document.removeEventListener("gesturechange", preventSafariGesture);
    };
  }, []);
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useSettlements.js =====
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { HISTORY_CATEGORY } from "../data/constants";

export default function useSettlements(expenses, members) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const regularExpenses = expenses.filter(
      (expense) => expense.category !== HISTORY_CATEGORY,
    );
    const historyExpenses = expenses.filter(
      (expense) => expense.category === HISTORY_CATEGORY,
    );

    const balances = members.map((member) => ({ member, balance: 0 }));

    regularExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
      const payer = balances.find((balance) => balance.member === expense.paid_by);
      if (payer) payer.balance += Number(expense.amount);

      const configuredSplit = Array.isArray(expense.split_between)
        ? expense.split_between
        : [];
      const validSplit = configuredSplit.filter((member) =>
        members.includes(member),
      );
      const splitters =
        validSplit.length > 0
          ? validSplit
          : members.includes(expense.paid_by)
            ? [expense.paid_by]
            : [members[0]];

      const costPerPerson = Number(expense.amount) / splitters.length;
      splitters.forEach((member) => {
        const debtor = balances.find((balance) => balance.member === member);
        if (debtor) debtor.balance -= costPerPerson;
      });
    });

    historyExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
      const payer = balances.find((balance) => balance.member === expense.paid_by);
      if (payer) payer.balance += Number(expense.amount);
      members.forEach((member) => {
        if (expense.item_name.includes(`-> ${member}`)) {
          const receiver = balances.find(
            (balance) => balance.member === member,
          );
          if (receiver) receiver.balance -= Number(expense.amount);
        }
      });
    });

    const debtors = balances
      .filter((balance) => balance.balance < -0.01)
      .map((balance) => ({ ...balance }));
    const creditors = balances
      .filter((balance) => balance.balance > 0.01)
      .map((balance) => ({ ...balance }));
    const transfers = [];
    let debtorIndex = 0;
    let creditorIndex = 0;

    while (debtorIndex < debtors.length && creditorIndex < creditors.length) {
      const debtor = debtors[debtorIndex];
      const creditor = creditors[creditorIndex];
      const amount = Math.min(Math.abs(debtor.balance), creditor.balance);
      if (amount > 0.01) {
        transfers.push({ from: debtor.member, to: creditor.member, amount });
      }
      debtor.balance += amount;
      creditor.balance -= amount;
      if (Math.abs(debtor.balance) < 0.01) debtorIndex++;
      if (creditor.balance < 0.01) creditorIndex++;
    }

    return { balances, transfers };
  }, [expenses, members]);
}


===== FILE: src/hooks/useSwipeDrag.js =====
import { useRef, useState } from "react";

export default function useSwipeDrag({
  id,
  isOpen,
  setOpen,
  canDrag = true,
}) {
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState({
    active: false,
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    offset: 0,
    scrolling: false,
  });
  const isMouse = useRef(false);
  const suppressClick = useRef(false);

  let currentOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
  if (drag.active) {
    currentOffset = (isOpen ? -70 : 0) + drag.offset;
    currentOffset = Math.max(-90, Math.min(0, currentOffset));
  }

  const startDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!canDrag) return;
    setDrag({
      active: true,
      startX: clientX,
      startY: clientY,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
    if (!isOpen) setOpen(null);
  };

  const moveDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    const diffX = clientX - drag.startX;
    const diffY = Math.abs(clientY - drag.startY);

    if (!drag.scrolling && diffY > 15 && Math.abs(diffX) < 15) {
      setDrag((previous) => ({ ...previous, scrolling: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      setDrag((previous) => ({ ...previous, offset: diffX }));
    }
  };

  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    suppressClick.current = Math.abs(drag.offset) > 5;
    isMouse.current = false;

    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      const baseOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
      if (baseOffset + drag.offset < -35) setOpen(id);
      else setOpen(null);
    }

    setDrag({
      active: false,
      startX: 0,
      startY: 0,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
  };

  const touchHandlers = {
    onTouchStart: (event) =>
      startDrag(
        event.targetTouches[0].clientX,
        event.targetTouches[0].clientY,
      ),
    onTouchMove: (event) =>
      moveDrag(
        event.targetTouches[0].clientX,
        event.targetTouches[0].clientY,
      ),
    onTouchEnd: endDrag,
  };

  const mouseHandlers = {
    onMouseDown: (event) => {
      isMouse.current = true;
      startDrag(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    },
    onMouseMove: (event) => {
      if (isMouse.current) moveDrag(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    },
    onMouseUp: () => {
      if (isMouse.current) endDrag();
    },
    onMouseLeave: () => {
      if (isMouse.current) endDrag();
    },
  };

  const consumeSuppressedClick = () => {
    if (!suppressClick.current) return false;
    suppressClick.current = false;
    return true;
  };

  return {
    drag,
    currentOffset,
    isSwiped: currentOffset < -5,
    consumeSuppressedClick,
    touchHandlers,
    mouseHandlers,
  };
}

===== FILE: src/utils/trip.js =====
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";
import { DEFAULT_MEMBERS } from "../data/constants";

export const getTodayISO = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA");

export const formatForDB = (isoDate) => {
  if (!isoDate || !isoDate.includes("-")) return isoDate;
  const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-");
  return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
};

export const parseForUI = (thDate) => {
  if (!thDate || !thDate.includes("/")) return getTodayISO();
  const [d, m, y] = thDate.split("/");
  return `${y}-${m.padStart(2, "0")}-${d.padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

export const getStoredMembers = () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tripMembers") || "null");
    if (Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length > 0) return saved;
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed local data and use the defaults.
  }
  return DEFAULT_MEMBERS;
};

export const getStoredMemberDetails = () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("memberDetails") || "null");
    if (saved) return saved;
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed local data and use an empty details object.
  }
  return {};
};

export const formatMoney = (value) =>
  Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });

export const openBankApp = async (textToCopy, scheme, title) => {
  let copied = false;
  if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy);
      copied = true;
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }
  } else {
    const textarea = document.createElement("textarea");
    textarea.value = textToCopy;
    textarea.style.position = "fixed";
    textarea.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    textarea.select();
    copied = document.execCommand("copy");
    textarea.remove();
  }

  if (!copied) {
    dynaura.error({
      title: "คัดลอกไม่สำเร็จ",
      description: "กรุณาลองคัดลอกเลขบัญชีอีกครั้ง",
      duration: 4000,
    });
    return;
  }

  dynaura.success({
    title,
    description: scheme
      ? "ก๊อปเลขบัญชีแล้ว กำลังเปิดแอปธนาคาร"
      : "คัดลอกเลขบัญชีเรียบร้อยแล้ว",
    duration: 3000,
  });

  if (scheme) window.location.href = scheme;
};
// ดึงข้อมูลคิวที่ค้างซิงค์ (Get pending sync queue)
