==================== FILE: ./src/components/ExpenseItem.jsx ====================
import { Edit2, Trash2, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import useSwipeDrag from "../hooks/useSwipeDrag";
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";

export default function ExpenseItem({
  expense,
  MEMBERS,
  swipedId,
  setSwipedId,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onOpenSplitModal,
  isLast,
  isHighlighted,
  isPendingDelete,
  isPendingSplit,
  isOffline,
}) {
  const validSplit =
    expense.split_between?.filter((m) => MEMBERS.includes(m)) || [];
  const itemRef = useRef(null);
  const splitTriggerRef = useRef(null);
  const tooltipRef = useRef(null);
  const [tooltipPos, setTooltipPos] = useState(null);

  const isOpen = swipedId === expense.id;
  const isPendingSync = expense.isPendingSync === true;
  const canInteract = !isOffline && !isPendingSync;
  const {
    drag,
    currentOffset,
    isSwiped,
    consumeSuppressedClick,
    touchHandlers,
    mouseHandlers,
  } = useSwipeDrag({
    id: expense.id,
    isOpen,
    setOpen: setSwipedId,
    canDrag: canInteract,
  });

  const createdTime = expense.created_at
    ? new Date(expense.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], {
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        hour12: false,
      })
    : "";

  const warnOffline = () =>
    dynaura.warning({
      title: "ออฟไลน์",
      description: "ไม่สามารถแก้ไขหรือลบรายการขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
      duration: 4000,
    });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isHighlighted && itemRef.current) {
      itemRef.current.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: "smooth",
        block: "center",
      });
    }
  }, [isHighlighted]);

  const splitList =
    validSplit.length > 0
      ? validSplit
      : MEMBERS.includes(expense.paid_by)
        ? [expense.paid_by]
        : [MEMBERS[0]].filter(Boolean);

  const calculateTooltipPosition = useCallback(() => {
    if (!splitTriggerRef.current) return null;
    const rect = splitTriggerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const tooltipWidth = 220;
    const placeAbove = rect.bottom + 130 > window.innerHeight;
    const left = Math.max(
      12,
      Math.min(rect.left - 8, window.innerWidth - tooltipWidth - 12),
    );
    const arrowLeft = Math.max(
      14,
      Math.min(rect.left + rect.width / 2 - left - 6, tooltipWidth - 26),
    );

    return {
      top: placeAbove ? rect.top - 8 : rect.bottom + 8,
      left,
      arrowLeft,
      placeAbove,
      width: tooltipWidth,
    };
  }, []);

  const handleToggleSplitTooltip = (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (tooltipPos) {
      setTooltipPos(null);
      return;
    }
    setSwipedId(null);
    setTooltipPos(calculateTooltipPosition());
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tooltipPos) return;

    const handlePointerDown = (event) => {
      if (
        splitTriggerRef.current?.contains(event.target) ||
        tooltipRef.current?.contains(event.target)
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setTooltipPos(null);
    };

    const handleCloseOnMove = () => setTooltipPos(null);

    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleCloseOnMove, true);
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleCloseOnMove);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleCloseOnMove, true);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleCloseOnMove);
    };
  }, [tooltipPos]);

  const isGas = expense.category === "ค่าน้ำมัน";
  const distance =
    isGas && expense.odometer_start && expense.odometer_end
      ? Number(expense.odometer_end) - Number(expense.odometer_start)
      : 0;

  return (
    <div
      ref={itemRef}
      className={`relative bg-gray-900 ${!isLast ? "border-b border-gray-800" : ""}`}
    >
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 flex items-center justify-center">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (!canInteract) {
              warnOffline();
              return;
            }
            onDelete(expense.id);
            setSwipedId(null);
          }}
          disabled={isPendingDelete || !canInteract}
          className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-white shadow-sm transition ${
            isPendingDelete || !canInteract
              ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
              : "bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600"
          }`}
          style={{
            opacity: Math.min(1, -currentOffset / 40),
            transform: `scale(${Math.min(1.2, 0.2 + (-currentOffset / 70) * 0.8)})`,
            transition: drag.active
              ? "none"
              : "all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className={`relative z-10 flex cursor-grab touch-pan-y items-center justify-between p-3 pl-8 transition-colors duration-700 active:cursor-grabbing ${
          isHighlighted
            ? "bg-yellow-200/30 shadow-[inset_4px_0_0_#c9c9af]"
            : "bg-gray-800"
        }`}
        style={{
          transform: `translate3d(${currentOffset}px, 0, 0)`,
          transition: drag.active
            ? "none"
            : "transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 0.5s ease-out, box-shadow 0.5s ease-out, border-radius 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s",
          borderTopRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
          borderBottomRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
        }}
        {...touchHandlers}
        {...mouseHandlers}
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (consumeSuppressedClick()) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            return;
          }
          setSwipedId(null);
        }}
      >
        <div className="pointer-events-none flex-1">
          <p className="mb-0.5 text-xs text-gray-400">
            จ่ายโดย:{" "}
            <span className="font-bold text-lime-400">{expense.paid_by}</span>
            {createdTime && (
              <span className="ml-1 text-[11px] font-normal text-gray-400">
                {createdTime}
              </span>
            )}
            {isPendingSync && (
              <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-bold text-amber-400">
                รอซิงค์
              </span>
            )}
          </p>
          <p className="font-medium text-gray-100">{expense.item_name}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
            {expense.category}{" "}
            {splitList.length > 0 && (
              <button
                ref={splitTriggerRef}
                type="button"
                onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                onTouchStart={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                onClick={handleToggleSplitTooltip}
                className="pointer-events-auto inline-flex items-center rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-sky-400 underline decoration-sky-400/50 underline-offset-2 transition hover:bg-sky-400/15"
              >
                (หาร {splitList.length} คน)
              </button>
            )}
          </p>
          {distance > 0 && (
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-amber-400">
              ไมล์ {expense.odometer_start} - {expense.odometer_end} ({distance}{" "}
              กม.)
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <p className="pointer-events-none font-bold text-gray-100">
            ฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)}
          </p>
          <div className="relative z-20 flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              disabled={isPendingSplit || !canInteract}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (!canInteract) {
                  warnOffline();
                  return;
                }
                setTooltipPos(null);
                onOpenSplitModal(expense);
              }}
              className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-gray-400 transition ${
                isPendingSplit || !canInteract
                  ? "cursor-not-allowed border-gray-500 bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                  : "border-gray-600 hover:border-sky-400 hover:bg-sky-400/10 hover:text-sky-400"
              }`}
              title="เลือกคนหาร"
              aria-label="เลือกคนหาร"
            >
              <Users size={19} />
            </button>
            <button
              disabled={!canInteract}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (!canInteract) {
                  warnOffline();
                  return;
                }
                setTooltipPos(null);
                onEdit(expense);
                setSwipedId(null);
              }}
              className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-gray-400 transition ${
                !canInteract
                  ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-40"
                  : "hover:bg-lime-400/10 hover:text-lime-400"
              }`}
              title="แก้ไขรายการ"
              aria-label="แก้ไขรายการ"
            >
              <Edit2 size={20} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {tooltipPos &&
        createPortal(
          <div
            ref={tooltipRef}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            style={{
              top: `${tooltipPos.top}px`,
              left: `${tooltipPos.left}px`,
              width: `${tooltipPos.width}px`,
              transform: tooltipPos.placeAbove
                ? "translateY(-100%)"
                : "translateY(0)",
            }}
            className="fixed z-50 rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-3 text-xs text-gray-100 shadow-2xl"
          >
            {/* ลูกศรชี้ไปยังปุ่ม (หาร X คน) */}
            <div
              style={{ left: `${tooltipPos.arrowLeft}px` }}
              className={`absolute h-3 w-3 rotate-45 border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 ${
                tooltipPos.placeAbove
                  ? "-bottom-1.5 border-b border-r"
                  : "-top-1.5 border-l border-t"
              }`}
            />
            <p className="mb-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-lime-400">
              ผู้ร่วมหาร ({splitList.length} คน)
            </p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {splitList.map((member) => (
                <span
                  key={member}
                  className="rounded-md border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-100"
                >
                  {member}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>,
          document.body,
        )}
    </div>
  );
}


==================== FILE: ./src/components/ExpenseList.jsx ====================
import {
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  FolderClosed,
  FolderOpen,
  Maximize2,
  Minimize2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import ExpenseItem from "./ExpenseItem";

export default function ExpenseList({
  expenses,
  groupedExpenses,
  loading,
  isExpanded,
  collapsedDates,
  onToggleExpanded,
  onToggleDate,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onOpenSplitModal,
  swipedId,
  setSwipedId,
  highlightedId,
  MEMBERS,
  pendingDeleteId,
  pendingSplitId,
  isOffline,
}) {
  const [isSectionOpen, setIsSectionOpen] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      if (swipedId) setSwipedId(null);
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll);
  }, [swipedId, setSwipedId]);

  const handleToggleSection = () => {
    setSwipedId(null);
    setIsSectionOpen((prev) => !prev);
  };

  return (
    <section
      className="relative rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm"
      onClick={() => setSwipedId(null)}
    >
      <div
        role="button"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-expanded={isSectionOpen}
        onClick={handleToggleSection}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            handleToggleSection();
          }
        }}
        className="flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center justify-between gap-2"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-300">
          <h2>รายการ ({expenses.length})</h2>
          <ChevronDown
            size={18}
            className={`text-gray-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${
              isSectionOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
            }`}
          />
        </div>

        {isSectionOpen && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={(event) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
              onToggleExpanded();
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-300 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-gray-700"
          >
            {isExpanded ? <Minimize2 size={14} /> : <Maximize2 size={14} />}{" "}
            {isExpanded ? "ย่อเก็บ" : "ดูเต็ม"}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div
        className={`grid transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity,margin] duration-300 ease-in-out ${
          isSectionOpen
            ? "mt-4 grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"
            : "mt-0 grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"
        }`}
      >
        <div className="overflow-hidden">
          {loading ? (
            <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">กำลังโหลด...</p>
          ) : expenses.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">ไม่มีรายการ</p>
          ) : (
            <div
              className={`space-y-4 pr-2 transition-all ${!isExpanded ? "max-h-96 overflow-y-auto overscroll-none" : ""}`}
            >
              {Object.keys(groupedExpenses).map((date) => (
                <div
                  key={date}
                  className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 shadow-sm"
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onToggleDate(date)}
                    className="expense-date-header relative z-20 flex w-full items-center justify-between border-b-2 border-gray-700 bg-[#374151] p-3 hover:bg-[#374151]"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-300">
                      {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                        <FolderClosed size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                      ) : (
                        <FolderOpen size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                      )}
                      <span>{date}</span>
                      <span className="rounded-full bg-gray-600 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-normal text-gray-300">
                        {groupedExpenses[date].length} รายการ
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                      <ChevronRight size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronDown size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                  <div
                    className={`grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${collapsedDates[date] ? "grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0" : "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"}`}
                  >
                    <div className="overflow-hidden bg-gray-900">
                      {groupedExpenses[date].map((expense, index) => (
                        <ExpenseItem
                          key={expense.id}
                          expense={expense}
                          swipedId={swipedId}
                          setSwipedId={setSwipedId}
                          onEdit={onEdit}
                          onDelete={onDelete}
                          onOpenSplitModal={onOpenSplitModal}
                          isLast={index === groupedExpenses[date].length - 1}
                          isHighlighted={highlightedId === expense.id}
                          MEMBERS={MEMBERS}
                          isPendingDelete={pendingDeleteId === expense.id}
                          isPendingSplit={pendingSplitId === expense.id}
                          isOffline={isOffline}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

                      disabled={pendingHistoryId === expense.id || isOffline}

import { Edit2, Save, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BANKS } from "../data/constants";
import useSwipeDrag from "../hooks/useSwipeDrag";
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";
import { normalizePromptPay, validatePromptPay } from "../utils/trip";

export default function MemberItem({
  member,
  hasDebt,
  details,
  onRemove,
  onUpdateDetails,
  swipedMember,
  setSwipedMember,
  isEditing,
  onEdit,
  setShowNewPayForm,
  isPending,
  isOffline,
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    promptpay: details?.promptpay || "",
    bankId: details?.bankId || "kbank",
    bankAcc: details?.bankAcc || "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isEditing) {
      setForm({
        promptpay: details?.promptpay || "",
        bankId: details?.bankId || "kbank",
        bankAcc: details?.bankAcc || "",
      });
    }
  }, [isEditing, details]);

  const warnOffline = () =>
    dynaura.warning({
      title: "ออฟไลน์",
      description: "ไม่สามารถแก้ไขหรือลบสมาชิกขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
      duration: 4000,
    });

  const isOpen = swipedMember === member;
  const {
    drag,
    currentOffset,
    isSwiped,
    consumeSuppressedClick,
    touchHandlers,
    mouseHandlers,
  } = useSwipeDrag({
    id: member,
    isOpen,
    setOpen: setSwipedMember,
    canDrag: !isEditing,
  });

  return (
    <div className="relative mb-2 overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-800 bg-gray-900/50">
      
      {/* 💻 [Desktop View] ปุ่มลบโชว์ไว้ตลอดทางด้านขวา ไม่ต้องปัด */}
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 hidden md:flex items-center justify-center z-20">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (isOffline) {
              warnOffline();
              return;
            }
            onRemove(member, hasDebt);
          }}
          disabled={isPending || isOffline}
          className={`flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition ${
            isPending || isOffline
              ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
              : hasDebt
              ? "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
              : "bg-red-500 text-white hover:bg-red-600"
          }`}
          title={hasDebt ? "มียอดค้างชำระ ลบไม่ได้" : "ลบสมาชิก"}
        >
          <Trash2 size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 📱 [Mobile View] ปุ่มลบสำหรับระบบ Swipe */}
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 flex md:hidden items-center justify-center">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (isOffline) {
              warnOffline();
              return;
            }
            onRemove(member, hasDebt);
            setSwipedMember(null);
          }}
          disabled={isPending || isOffline}
          className={`flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full shadow-sm transition ${
            isPending || isOffline
              ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
              : hasDebt
              ? "bg-gray-700 text-gray-500 cursor-not-allowed"
              : "bg-red-500 text-white hover:bg-red-600"
          }`}
          style={{
            opacity: Math.min(1, -currentOffset / 40),
            transform: `scale(${Math.min(1.08, 0.2 + (-currentOffset / 70) * 0.8)})`,
            transition: drag.active ? "none" : "all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)",
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-800 p-3 md:pr-14"
        style={{
          transform: `translate3d(${currentOffset}px, 0, 0)`,
          transition: drag.active
            ? "none"
            : "transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-radius 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s",
          borderTopRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
          borderBottomRightRadius: isSwiped ? "24px" : "0px",
        }}
        {...touchHandlers}
        {...mouseHandlers}
        onClick={(e) => {
          if (consumeSuppressedClick()) {

          setSwipedMember(null);
        }}
      >
        <span className="font-medium text-gray-100">{member}</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (isOffline) {
                warnOffline();
                return;
              }
              onEdit();
              setShowNewPayForm(false); 
            }}
            className="p-1.5 text-sky-400 transition hover:bg-sky-400/20 rounded z-30"
            disabled={isOffline}
          >
            <Edit2 size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {isEditing && (
        <div className="border-t border-gray-700 bg-gray-900/80 p-3 space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] text-gray-400">
              เบอร์พร้อมเพย์ (เว้นว่างได้)
            </label>
            <input
              type="tel"
              value={form.promptpay}
              inputMode="numeric"
              pattern="[0-9]*"
              onChange={(e) =>
                setForm({
                  ...form,
                  promptpay: normalizePromptPay(e.target.value).replace(/\D/g, ""),
                })
              }
              className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              placeholder="เช่น 0812345678"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                ธนาคาร (หลัก)
              </label>
              <select
                value={form.bankId}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, bankId: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-xs focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              >
                {BANKS.map((b) => (
                  <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                    {b.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                เลขบัญชี
              </label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                value={form.bankAcc}
                inputMode="numeric"
                pattern="[0-9]*"
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setForm({
                    ...form,
                    bankAcc: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""),
                  })
                }
                className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                placeholder="เลขบัญชี..."
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => {

              onEdit(); // ปิดฟอร์มแก้ไขหลังจากกดบันทึก
            }}
            disabled={isOffline}

              isOffline ? "opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed" : ""
            }`}
          >
            <Save size={16} /> บันทึกข้อมูล
          </button>
        </div>

import { Plus, UserPlus, Users, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BANKS } from "../data/constants";
import MemberItem from "./MemberItem";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";
import { normalizePromptPay, validatePromptPay } from "../utils/trip";

export default function MemberModal({
  members,
  balances,
  memberDetails,
  onClose,
  onAdd,
  onRemove,
  onUpdateDetails,
  pendingMemberAction,
  isOffline,
}) {
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [showNewPayForm, setShowNewPayForm] = useState(false);
  const [newPayForm, setNewPayForm] = useState({
    promptpay: "",
    bankId: "kbank",
    bankAcc: "",
  });
  const [swipedMember, setSwipedMember] = useState(null);
  const [editingMember, setEditingMember] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleAdd = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isOffline) {
      dynaura.warning({
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        description: "ไม่สามารถเพิ่มสมาชิกขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
        duration: 4000,
      });
      return;
    }
    const trimmed = newName.trim();
    if (trimmed) {
      let paymentDetails = null;
      if (showNewPayForm) {
        const validation = validatePromptPay(newPayForm.promptpay);
        if (!validation.valid) {
          dynaura.warning({
            title: "เลขพร้อมเพย์ไม่ถูกต้อง",
            description: validation.message,
            duration: 4000,
          });
          return;
        }
        paymentDetails = {
          ...newPayForm,
          promptpay: validation.normalized,
        };
      }
      onAdd(trimmed, paymentDetails);
      setNewName("");
      setShowNewPayForm(false);
      setNewPayForm({ promptpay: "", bankId: "kbank", bankAcc: "" });
    }
  };

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/70"
      panelClassName="max-h-[85vh] max-w-md"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
            <Users size={20} /> จัดการสมาชิก
          </h2>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-gray-400 hover:text-lime-300"
          >
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          <div className="mb-6 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800/30 p-3">
            <form onSubmit={handleAdd} className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={newName}
                onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="พิมพ์ชื่อ..."
                className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!newName.trim() || Boolean(pendingMemberAction) || isOffline}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-gray-950 transition ${
                  pendingMemberAction
                    ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                    : "bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300"
                } disabled:opacity-50`}
              >
                <UserPlus size={16} /> เพิ่ม
              </button>
            </form>

            {!showNewPayForm ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowNewPayForm(true);
                  setEditingMember(null);
                }}
                className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-sky-400 hover:text-sky-300 transition"
              >
                <Plus size={12} /> เพิ่มวิธีการชำระเงินให้{" "}
                {newName || "เพื่อนใหม่"} (ตั้งค่าภายหลังได้)
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 border-t border-gray-700 pt-3 relative">
                <div className="flex justify-end pr-2 ">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowNewPayForm(false)}
                    className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] bg-red-700 p-1.5 rounded font-medium text-gray-200 transition hover:text-red-500"
                  >
                    <X size={12} /> ยกเลิก
                  </button>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  placeholder="เบอร์พร้อมเพย์..."
                  value={newPayForm.promptpay}
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  pattern="[0-9]*"
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setNewPayForm({
                      ...newPayForm,
                      promptpay: normalizePromptPay(e.target.value).replace(/\D/g, ""),
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                />
                <p className="font-medium text-xs text-sky-400 ">หรือ</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2 ">
                  <select
                    value={newPayForm.bankId}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewPayForm({ ...newPayForm, bankId: e.target.value })
                    }
                    className="flex rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {BANKS.map((b) => (
                      <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                        {b.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    placeholder="เลขบัญชี..."
                    value={newPayForm.bankAcc}
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    pattern="[0-9]*"
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setNewPayForm({
                        ...newPayForm,
                        bankAcc: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""),
                      })
                    }
                    className="flex rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none w-full"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">
              ปัดซ้ายเพื่อลบสมาชิก ({members.length})
            </p>
            {members.map((member) => {
              const balance =
                balances.find((b) => b.member === member)?.balance || 0;
              const hasDebt = Math.abs(balance) > 0.01;
              const details = memberDetails[member] || {};
              return (
                <MemberItem
                  key={member}
                  setShowNewPayForm={setShowNewPayForm}
                  member={member}
                  hasDebt={hasDebt}
                  details={details}
                  onRemove={onRemove}
                  onUpdateDetails={onUpdateDetails}
                  swipedMember={swipedMember}
                  setSwipedMember={setSwipedMember}
                  isEditing={editingMember === member}
                  isPending={pendingMemberAction === member}
                  isOffline={isOffline}
                  onEdit={() =>
                    setEditingMember(editingMember === member ? null : member)
                  }
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}

  children,

      style={{ touchAction: "pan-x pan-y" }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className={`flex w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 text-gray-100 shadow-2xl ${panelClassName}`}
        style={{ touchAction: "pan-x pan-y" }}
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>

==================== FILE: ./src/components/PaymentModal.jsx ====================
import { CheckCircle, Copy, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { BANKS, SWAL_THEME } from "../data/constants";
import {
  formatMoney,
  normalizePromptPay,
  openBankApp,
  validatePromptPay,
} from "../utils/trip";
import Swal from "sweetalert2";
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

const APP_BANKS = BANKS.filter((bank) => Boolean(bank.scheme));

export default function PaymentModal({
  from,
  to,
  amount,
  memberDetails,
  onUpdateDetails,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
  isSubmitting,
}) {
  const details = memberDetails[to] || {};
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("qr");
  const [showBankPicker, setShowBankPicker] = useState(false);
  const normalizedPromptPay = normalizePromptPay(details.promptpay);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    promptpay: normalizedPromptPay,
    bankId: details.bankId || "kbank",
    bankAcc: details.bankAcc || "",
  });

  const selectedBank = BANKS.find(
    (b) => b.id === (details.bankId || form.bankId),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEscape = (event) => {
      if (event.key !== "Escape") return;
      if (showBankPicker) {
        setShowBankPicker(false);
      } else {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
  }, [onClose, showBankPicker]);

  const handleSaveDetails = () => {
    if (tab === "qr") {
      const validation = validatePromptPay(form.promptpay);
      if (!validation.valid) {
        dynaura.warning({
          title: "เลขพร้อมเพย์ไม่ถูกต้อง",
          description: validation.message,
          duration: 4000,
        });
        return;
      }
      if (!validation.normalized) {
        dynaura.warning({
          title: "กรุณากรอกเลขพร้อมเพย์",
          description: "เว้นวรรคหรือใส่เครื่องหมาย - จะถูกกรองออกอัตโนมัติ",
          duration: 4000,
        });
        return;
      }
      onUpdateDetails(to, { ...form, promptpay: validation.normalized });
    } else {
      onUpdateDetails(to, form);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyAccount = async () => {
    await openBankApp(details.bankAcc, "", "คัดลอกเลขบัญชีแล้ว");
    setShowBankPicker(true);
  };

  const handleOpenSelectedBankApp = (scheme) => {
    setShowBankPicker(false);
    if (scheme) {
      window.location.href = scheme;
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmPay = async () => {
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    const result = await Swal.fire({
      ...SWAL_THEME,
      title: `ยืนยันการโอนเงิน`,
      html: `คุณโอนเงิน <strong class="text-2xl text-lime-400">฿${formatMoney(amount)}</strong> ให้ ${to} เรียบร้อยแล้วใช่หรือไม่?`,
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "โอนเรียบร้อย",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
    });
    if (result.isConfirmed) {
      onConfirm(from, to, amount);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ModalShell
        backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/80"
        panelClassName="max-w-sm"
        onClose={onClose}
      >
        <div className="relative bg-gray-800 p-4 text-center">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="absolute right-3 top-3 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200"
            aria-label="ปิดหน้าต่าง"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-400">ชำระเงินให้</p>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-lime-400">{to}</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-3xl font-bold text-white">
            ฿{formatMoney(amount)}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex border-b border-gray-800">
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("qr")}
            className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition ${tab === "qr" ? "border-b-2 border-lime-400 text-lime-400" : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-300"}`}
          >
            สแกนคิวอาร์
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("bank")}
            className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition ${tab === "bank" ? "border-b-2 border-lime-400 text-lime-400" : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-300"}`}
          >
            คัดลอกบัญชี
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-5">
          {tab === "qr" && (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
              {normalizedPromptPay ? (
                <>
                  <div className="mb-4 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-white p-2">
                    <img
                      src={`https://promptpay.io/${normalizedPromptPay}/${amount}.png`}
                      alt="PromptPay QR"
                      className="h-48 w-48 object-contain"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                    พร้อมเพย์:{" "}
                    <span className="font-mono text-gray-200">
                      {normalizedPromptPay}
                    </span>
                  </p>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="w-full space-y-3">
                  <p className="text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
                    ไม่มีข้อมูลพร้อมเพย์ของ {to}
                  </p>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={form.promptpay}
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    pattern="[0-9]*"
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({
                        ...form,
                        promptpay: normalizePromptPay(e.target.value).replace(
                          /\D/g,
                          "",
                        ),
                      })
                    }
                    placeholder="กรอกเบอร์โทรหรือเลขบัตร..."
                    className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSaveDetails}
                    className="w-full rounded bg-gray-700 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition hover:bg-gray-600"
                  >
                    บันทึกและสร้าง QR
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {tab === "bank" && (
            <div className="flex flex-col">
              {details.bankAcc ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-gray-800 bg-gray-800/50 p-4 text-center">
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      {selectedBank?.name}
                    </p>
                    <p className="font-mono text-lg tracking-wider text-gray-100">
                      {details.bankAcc}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleCopyAccount}
                      className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 py-3 text-sm text-gray-300 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
                    >
                      <Copy size={16} /> คัดลอกเลขบัญชี
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="w-full space-y-3">
                  <p className="text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
                    ไม่มีข้อมูลบัญชีของ {to}
                  </p>
                  <select
                    value={form.bankId}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({ ...form, bankId: e.target.value })
                    }
                    className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    {BANKS.map((b) => (
                      <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>
                        {b.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    value={form.bankAcc}
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    pattern="[0-9]*"
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({
                        ...form,
                        bankAcc: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ""),
                      })
                    }
                    placeholder="เลขบัญชี..."
                    className="w-full rounded border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSaveDetails}
                    className="w-full rounded bg-gray-700 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition hover:bg-gray-600"
                  >
                    บันทึกข้อมูลบัญชี
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="mt-6">
            <button
              onClick={handleConfirmPay}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className={`mx-auto flex w-4/5 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-lg py-3 text-sm font-bold text-gray-950 transition ${
                isSubmitting
                  ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                  : "bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300"
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCircle size={16} />{" "}
              {isSubmitting ? "กำลังบันทึก..." : "ยืนยันการโอน"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ModalShell>

      {showBankPicker && (
        <ModalShell
          backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/85 z-60"
          panelClassName="max-w-xs"
          onClose={() => setShowBankPicker(false)}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-800 bg-gray-800 px-4 py-3">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-lime-400">
              ต้องการใช้ธนาคารไหน
            </h3>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowBankPicker(false)}
              className="text-gray-400 transition hover:text-gray-200"
              aria-label="ปิดหน้าต่าง"
            >
              <X size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2 p-3">

                type="button"

              >
                {bank.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </ModalShell>
      )}

  );

const formatDateTime = (expense) => {
  if (!expense.created_at) return expense.expense_date;
  const parsed = new Date(expense.created_at);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return expense.expense_date;

  const timeText = parsed.toLocaleTimeString("th-TH", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  });
  return `${expense.expense_date} • ${timeText} น.`;
};

import {
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle,
  ChevronDown,
  FileText,
  History,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";

export default function SettlementSection({
  settlements,
  onOpenPayment,
  onOpenDetails,
  onOpenHistory,
  pendingSettlement,
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);
  const transferCount = settlements.transfers.length;

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div
        role="button"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            setIsOpen((prev) => !prev);
          }
        }}
        className="flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center justify-between gap-2"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lime-400">
            <Users size={20} /> สรุปเคลียร์เงิน
          </h2>
          {!isOpen && (
            <span
              className={`rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                transferCount > 0
                  ? "border-lime-500/40 bg-lime-500/15 text-lime-400"
                  : "border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 text-gray-400"
              }`}
            >
              {transferCount > 0 ? `${transferCount} รายการ` : "ครบแล้ว"}
            </span>
          )}
          <ChevronDown
            size={18}
            className={`text-gray-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${
              isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
            }`}
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            onOpenHistory();
          }}
          className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 transition hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-gray-950"
          title="ประวัติการชำระ"
          aria-label="ประวัติการชำระ"
        >
          <History size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className={`grid transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity,margin] duration-200 ease-out ${
          isOpen
            ? "mt-4 grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"
            : "mt-0 grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"
        }`}
      >
        <div className="overflow-hidden">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {transferCount === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-2 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
                ทุกคนเคลียร์เงินครบแล้ว
              </p>
            ) : (
              settlements.transfers.map((transfer) => {
                const pairKey = `${transfer.from}-${transfer.to}`;
                const isPendingPair = pendingSettlement === pairKey;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={pairKey}
                    className="rounded-lg border border-lime-900 bg-gray-800 p-3"
                  >
                    <div className="mb-2 flex justify-between p-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
                        <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.from}</span>
                        <ArrowRight size={16} className="text-gray-400" />
                        <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.to}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                        ฿{formatMoney(transfer.amount)}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenDetails(transfer)}
                        className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded border border-gray-600 bg-gray-900 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-100 shadow-sm transition hover:cursor-pointer hover:scale-102"
                      >
                        <FileText size={14} /> รายละเอียด
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenPayment(transfer)}
                        disabled={isPendingPair}
                        className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded py-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-950 shadow-sm transition ${

                            ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                            : "bg-lime-500 hover:bg-lime-300"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <CheckCircle size={14} />{" "}
                        {isPendingPair ? "กำลังบันทึก..." : "เคลียร์ยอด"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}


==================== FILE: ./src/components/SplitModal.jsx ====================
import { Users, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

export default function SplitModal({ expense, members, onClose, onSave }) {
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSplit, setSelectedSplit] = useState(() => {
    const rawSplit =
      expense?.split_between?.length > 0
        ? expense.split_between
        : [expense.paid_by];
    return rawSplit.filter((m) => members.includes(m));
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleToggle = (member) =>
    setSelectedSplit((prev) =>
      prev.includes(member)
        ? prev.filter((m) => m !== member)
        : [...prev, member],
    );
  const isAllSelected =
    selectedSplit.length === members.length && members.length > 0;
  const handleToggleAll = () =>
    isAllSelected ? setSelectedSplit([]) : setSelectedSplit([...members]);

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/70"
      panelClassName="max-w-sm"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-gray-800 bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-100">
            ระบุผู้หารรายการ
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-lime-400">
            {expense.item_name} (฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)})
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-sky-400">
            <Users size={13} />
            <span>
              เลือกแล้ว {selectedSplit.length} คน (จาก {members.length} คน)
            </span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="text-gray-400 transition hover:text-gray-200"
        >
          <X size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">เลือกคนที่ร่วมหาร</p>
          <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-lime-400 hover:text-lime-300">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={isAllSelected}
              onChange={handleToggleAll}
              className="split-check h-3.5 w-3.5 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <span>เลือกทุกคน</span>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="mb-4 max-h-56 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {members.map((member) => (
            <label
              key={member}
              className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-800 bg-gray-800/60 p-3 transition hover:bg-gray-750"
            >
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-100">
                {member}
              </span>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={selectedSplit.includes(member)}
                onChange={() => handleToggle(member)}
                className="split-check h-4 w-4 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
          >
            ยกเลิก
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isSaving}
            onClick={async () => {
              setIsSaving(true);
              const success = expense.__draft
                ? await onSave(null, selectedSplit)
                : await onSave(expense.id, selectedSplit);
              setIsSaving(false);
              if (success) onClose();
            }}
            className={`flex-1 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-950 transition ${
              isSaving
                ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                : "bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300"
            }`}
          >
            {isSaving ? "กำลังบันทึก..." : "ตกลง"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}

          key={option.id}

==================== FILE: ./src/components/TripHeader.jsx ====================
import { Check, RefreshCw, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";

export default function TripHeader({
  totalExpense,
  isSyncing,
  onRefresh,
  MEMBERS,
  onOpenMemberModal,
  isOffline,
}) {
  const [syncStatus, setSyncStatus] = useState("idle");
  const [displayTotal, setDisplayTotal] = useState(0);
  const [replayCount, setReplayCount] = useState(0);
  const animatedValueRef = useRef(0);
  const prevSyncingRef = useRef(isSyncing);
  const manualSyncRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const wasSyncing = prevSyncingRef.current;
    prevSyncingRef.current = isSyncing;

    if (isSyncing) {
      setSyncStatus("syncing");
      return;
    }

    if (wasSyncing) {
      setSyncStatus("success");
      if (manualSyncRef.current) {
        manualSyncRef.current = false;
        animatedValueRef.current = 0;
        setDisplayTotal(0);
        setReplayCount((count) => count + 1);
      }
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setSyncStatus("idle"), 1500);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [isSyncing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const target = Number(totalExpense) || 0;
    const start = animatedValueRef.current;

    if (Math.abs(target - start) < 0.005) {
      animatedValueRef.current = target;
      setDisplayTotal(target);
      return;
    }

    const duration = 650;
    const startTime = performance.now();
    let frameId;

    const tick = (now) => {
      const elapsed = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / duration);
      // easeOutCubic: วิ่งเร็วช่วงต้นแล้วชะลอนุ่มๆ ตอนเข้าเป้า
      const eased = 1 - (1 - progress) ** 3;
      const current = start + (target - start) * eased;

      animatedValueRef.current = current;
      setDisplayTotal(current);

      if (progress < 1) {
        frameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        animatedValueRef.current = target;
        setDisplayTotal(target);
      }
    };

    frameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
  }, [totalExpense, replayCount]);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-gray-900 px-4 pb-4 pt-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)+1rem)] text-gray-100 shadow-md">
      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-md text-center">
        <button
          onClick={onOpenMemberModal}
          className="absolute left-0 top-5 flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
        >
          <Users size={20} className="text-lime-400" />
          <span className="text-base font-bold text-gray-300">
            {MEMBERS.length}
          </span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (isOffline) {
              dynaura.warning({
                title: "ออฟไลน์",
                description: "ไม่สามารถรีเฟรชขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
                duration: 4000,
              });
              return;
            }
            manualSyncRef.current = true;
            onRefresh();
          }}
          disabled={syncStatus === "syncing" || isOffline}
          className={`absolute right-1 top-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-800 transition hover:bg-gray-700 ${
            isOffline ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-50" : ""
          }`}
        >
          {syncStatus === "syncing" ? (
            <RefreshCw size={26} className="animate-spin text-gray-400" />
          ) : syncStatus === "success" ? (
            <Check size={26} className="text-lime-400" />
          ) : (
            <RefreshCw size={26} className="text-gray-300" />
          )}
        </button>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-light opacity-80">
          ยอดรวมค่าใช้จ่ายทั้งทริป
        </p>
        <h1 className="my-1 text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums">
          ฿{formatMoney(displayTotal)}
        </h1>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}


==================== FILE: ./src/context/ThemeContext.jsx ====================
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("tripTheme") || "pink",
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    localStorage.setItem("tripTheme", theme);

    const themeColors = {
      dark: "#111827",
      pink: "#fec7d7",
      light: "#55423d",
      purple: "#faeee7",
    };
    const themeColor = themeColors[theme] || themeColors.dark;

    let themeMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    if (!themeMeta) {
      themeMeta = document.createElement("meta");
      themeMeta.name = "theme-color";
      document.head.appendChild(themeMeta);
    }
    themeMeta.content = themeColor;

    const statusBarMeta = document.querySelector(
      'meta[name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style"]',
    );
    if (statusBarMeta) {
      statusBarMeta.content = theme === "dark" ? "black" : "default";
    }
  }, [theme]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider");
  return context;
}

import { useEffect } from "react";

export default function usePinchGuard() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const preventPinchTouch = (event) => {
      if (event.touches?.length > 1) event.preventDefault();
    };
    const preventSafariGesture = (event) => event.preventDefault();

    document.addEventListener("touchmove", preventPinchTouch, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener("gesturestart", preventSafariGesture, {
      passive: false,
    });
    document.addEventListener("gesturechange", preventSafariGesture, {
      passive: false,
    });

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("touchmove", preventPinchTouch);
      document.removeEventListener("gesturestart", preventSafariGesture);
      document.removeEventListener("gesturechange", preventSafariGesture);
    };
  }, []);
}


==================== FILE: ./src/hooks/useSettlements.js ====================
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { HISTORY_CATEGORY } from "../data/constants";

const roundMoney = (value) =>
  Math.round((Number(value) + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;

const parseExpenseTimestamp = (expense) => {
  let dateScore = 0;
  if (
    typeof expense.expense_date === "string" &&
    expense.expense_date.includes("/")
  ) {
    const [day, month, year] = expense.expense_date.split("/").map(Number);
    if (day && month && year) {
      dateScore = new Date(year, month - 1, day).getTime();
    }
  }

  const createdScore = expense.created_at
    ? new Date(expense.created_at).getTime()
    : 0;
  const fallbackId = Number(expense.id) || 0;

  return {
    dateScore: Number.isFinite(dateScore) ? dateScore : 0,
    timeScore:
      Number.isFinite(createdScore) && createdScore > 0
        ? createdScore
        : fallbackId,
  };
};

const compareNewestFirst = (a, b) => {
  const timeA = parseExpenseTimestamp(a);
  const timeB = parseExpenseTimestamp(b);
  if (timeB.dateScore !== timeA.dateScore) {
    return timeB.dateScore - timeA.dateScore;
  }
  return timeB.timeScore - timeA.timeScore;
};

const getValidSplitters = (expense, members) => {
  const configuredSplit = Array.isArray(expense.split_between)
    ? expense.split_between
    : [];
  const validSplit = configuredSplit.filter((member) =>
    members.includes(member),
  );
  if (validSplit.length > 0) return validSplit;
  if (members.includes(expense.paid_by)) return [expense.paid_by];
  return members.length > 0 ? [members[0]] : [];
};

export default function useSettlements(expenses, members) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const regularExpenses = expenses.filter(
      (expense) => expense.category !== HISTORY_CATEGORY,
    );
    const historyExpenses = expenses.filter(
      (expense) => expense.category === HISTORY_CATEGORY,
    );

    const balanceMap = new Map(members.map((member) => [member, 0]));
    const transfers = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i += 1) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < members.length; j += 1) {
        const personA = members[i];
        const personB = members[j];

        const paidByAForB = [];
        const paidByBForA = [];

        regularExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
          const splitters = getValidSplitters(expense, members);
          if (splitters.length === 0) return;

          const shareAmount = roundMoney(
            Number(expense.amount) / splitters.length,
          );
          if (shareAmount <= 0) return;

          if (expense.paid_by === personA && splitters.includes(personB)) {
            paidByAForB.push({
              ...expense,
              splitCount: splitters.length,
              shareAmount,
            });
          } else if (
            expense.paid_by === personB &&
            splitters.includes(personA)
          ) {
            paidByBForA.push({
              ...expense,
              splitCount: splitters.length,
              shareAmount,
            });
          }
        });

        const totalAForB = roundMoney(
          paidByAForB.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.shareAmount, 0),
        );
        const totalBForA = roundMoney(
          paidByBForA.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.shareAmount, 0),
        );

        const pairHistory = historyExpenses.filter(
          (item) =>
            item.item_name.includes(`${personA} -> ${personB}`) ||
            item.item_name.includes(`${personB} -> ${personA}`),
        );

        const settledByBToA = roundMoney(
          pairHistory
            .filter((item) => item.item_name.includes(`${personB} -> ${personA}`))
            .reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0),
        );

        const settledByAToB = roundMoney(
          pairHistory
            .filter((item) => item.item_name.includes(`${personA} -> ${personB}`))
            .reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0),
        );

        // diff > 0 หมายถึง B ยังค้างจ่าย A อยู่สุทธิ
        const diff = roundMoney(
          totalAForB - totalBForA - settledByBToA + settledByAToB,
        );
        if (Math.abs(diff) <= 0.005) continue;

        const isBOwesA = diff > 0;
        const from = isBOwesA ? personB : personA;
        const to = isBOwesA ? personA : personB;
        const amount = Math.abs(diff);

        const positiveItems = (isBOwesA ? paidByAForB : paidByBForA).sort(
          compareNewestFirst,
        );
        const negativeItems = (isBOwesA ? paidByBForA : paidByAForB).sort(
          compareNewestFirst,
        );

        const positiveTotal = isBOwesA ? totalAForB : totalBForA;
        const negativeTotal = isBOwesA ? totalBForA : totalAForB;

        const settledHistory = [...pairHistory].sort(compareNewestFirst);

        balanceMap.set(from, roundMoney((balanceMap.get(from) || 0) - amount));
        balanceMap.set(to, roundMoney((balanceMap.get(to) || 0) + amount));

        transfers.push({
          from,
          to,
          amount,
          positiveItems,
          negativeItems,
          positiveTotal,
          negativeTotal,
          settledHistory,
        });
      }
    }

    const balances = members.map((member) => ({
      member,
      balance: balanceMap.get(member) || 0,
    }));

    return { balances, transfers };
  }, [expenses, members]);
}


==================== FILE: ./src/hooks/useSwipeDrag.js ====================
import { useRef, useState } from "react";

export default function useSwipeDrag({
  id,
  isOpen,
  setOpen,
  canDrag = true,
}) {
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState({
    active: false,
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    offset: 0,
    scrolling: false,
  });
  const isMouse = useRef(false);
  const suppressClick = useRef(false);

  let currentOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
  if (drag.active) {
    currentOffset = (isOpen ? -70 : 0) + drag.offset;
    currentOffset = Math.max(-90, Math.min(0, currentOffset));
  }

  const startDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!canDrag) return;
    setDrag({
      active: true,
      startX: clientX,
      startY: clientY,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
    if (!isOpen) setOpen(null);
  };

  const moveDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    const diffX = clientX - drag.startX;
    const diffY = Math.abs(clientY - drag.startY);

    if (!drag.scrolling && diffY > 15 && Math.abs(diffX) < 15) {
      setDrag((previous) => ({ ...previous, scrolling: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      setDrag((previous) => ({ ...previous, offset: diffX }));
    }
  };

  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    suppressClick.current = Math.abs(drag.offset) > 5;
    isMouse.current = false;

    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      const baseOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
      if (baseOffset + drag.offset < -35) setOpen(id);
      else setOpen(null);
    }

    setDrag({
      active: false,
      startX: 0,
      startY: 0,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
  };

  const touchHandlers = {
    onTouchStart: (event) =>
      startDrag(
        event.targetTouches[0].clientX,
        event.targetTouches[0].clientY,
      ),
    onTouchMove: (event) =>
      moveDrag(
        event.targetTouches[0].clientX,
        event.targetTouches[0].clientY,
      ),
    onTouchEnd: endDrag,
  };

  const mouseHandlers = {
    onMouseDown: (event) => {
      isMouse.current = true;
      startDrag(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    },
    onMouseMove: (event) => {
      if (isMouse.current) moveDrag(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    },
    onMouseUp: () => {
      if (isMouse.current) endDrag();
    },
    onMouseLeave: () => {
      if (isMouse.current) endDrag();
    },
  };

  const consumeSuppressedClick = () => {
    if (!suppressClick.current) return false;
    suppressClick.current = false;
    return true;
  };

  return {
    drag,
    currentOffset,
    isSwiped: currentOffset < -5,
    consumeSuppressedClick,
    touchHandlers,
    mouseHandlers,
  };
}


==================== FILE: ./src/hooks/useTripData.js ====================
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { getOfflineQueue, getStoredMembers } from "../utils/trip";
import { supabase } from "../services/supabase";

export default function useTripData(onMembersUpdated, onMemberDetailsUpdated) {
  const [members, setMembers] = useState(getStoredMembers);
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState([]);
  const [isOffline, setIsOffline] = useState(!navigator.onLine);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  const refreshMembers = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!navigator.onLine) return;

    const { data } = await supabase
      .from("trip_members")
      .select("name, promptpay, bank_id, bank_acc")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

    if (data && data.length > 0) {
      const fetchedMembers = data.map((member) => member.name);
      const fetchedDetails = data.reduce((details, member) => {
        details[member.name] = {
          promptpay: member.promptpay || "",
          bankId: member.bank_id || "kbank",
          bankAcc: member.bank_acc || "",
        };
        return details;
      }, {});
      setMembers(fetchedMembers);
      localStorage.setItem("tripMembers", JSON.stringify(fetchedMembers));
      localStorage.setItem("memberDetails", JSON.stringify(fetchedDetails));
      onMembersUpdated(fetchedMembers);
      if (onMemberDetailsUpdated) onMemberDetailsUpdated(fetchedDetails);
    }
  }, [onMembersUpdated, onMemberDetailsUpdated]);

  const refreshExpenses = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      const cachedData = localStorage.getItem("tripExpensesCache");
      const cachedExpenses = cachedData ? JSON.parse(cachedData) : [];
      const queuedExpenses = getOfflineQueue();
      const mergedById = new Map();
      [...cachedExpenses, ...queuedExpenses].forEach((expense) => {
        mergedById.set(expense.id, expense);
      });
      const mergedExpenses = [...mergedById.values()].sort(
        (a, b) => new Date(b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.created_at || 0),
      );
      setExpenses(mergedExpenses);
      localStorage.setItem("tripExpensesCache", JSON.stringify(mergedExpenses));
      return;
    }

    setIsSyncing(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;

      if (data) {
        const pendingQueue = getOfflineQueue();
        const mergedById = new Map();
        [...data, ...pendingQueue].forEach((expense) => {
          mergedById.set(expense.id, expense);
        });
        const mergedExpenses = [...mergedById.values()].sort(
          (a, b) =>
            new Date(b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.created_at || 0),
        );
        setExpenses(mergedExpenses);
        localStorage.setItem(
          "tripExpensesCache",
          JSON.stringify(mergedExpenses),
        );
      }
    } catch {
      const cachedData = localStorage.getItem("tripExpensesCache");
      if (cachedData) setExpenses(JSON.parse(cachedData));
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => setIsSyncing(false), 500);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsOffline(!navigator.onLine);

    const handleOnline = () => {
      setIsOffline(false);
      Promise.all([refreshMembers(), refreshExpenses()]).then(() =>
        setLoading(false),
      );
    };
    const handleOffline = () => setIsOffline(true);

    window.addEventListener("online", handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener("offline", handleOffline);

    Promise.all([refreshMembers(), refreshExpenses()]).then(() =>
      setLoading(false),
    );

    const expenseSub = supabase
      .channel("trip_expenses_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_expenses" },
        refreshExpenses,
      )
      .subscribe();
    const memberSub = supabase
      .channel("trip_members_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_members" },
        refreshMembers,
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("online", handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", handleOffline);
      supabase.removeChannel(expenseSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(memberSub);
    };
  }, [refreshExpenses, refreshMembers]);

  return {
    members,
    setMembers,
    expenses,
    setExpenses,
    isOffline,
    loading,
    isSyncing,
    refreshMembers,
    refreshExpenses,
  };
}

==================== FILE: ./src/utils/trip.js ====================
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";
import { DEFAULT_MEMBERS } from "../data/constants";

export const getTodayISO = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA");

export const formatForDB = (isoDate) => {
  if (!isoDate || !isoDate.includes("-")) return isoDate;
  const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-");
  return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
};

export const parseForUI = (thDate) => {
  if (!thDate || !thDate.includes("/")) return getTodayISO();
  const [d, m, y] = thDate.split("/");
  return `${y}-${m.padStart(2, "0")}-${d.padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

export const getStoredMembers = () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tripMembers") || "null");
    if (Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length > 0) return saved;
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed local data and use the defaults.
  }
  return DEFAULT_MEMBERS;
};

export const getStoredMemberDetails = () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("memberDetails") || "null");
    if (saved) return saved;
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed local data and use an empty details object.
  }
  return {};
};

export const formatMoney = (value) =>
  Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });

export const normalizePromptPay = (value) => {
  let normalized = String(value || "").trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, "");
  if (normalized.startsWith("+66")) {
    normalized = `0${normalized.slice(3)}`;
  } else if (normalized.startsWith("66") && normalized.length === 11) {
    normalized = `0${normalized.slice(2)}`;
  }

  return normalized;
};

export const validatePromptPay = (value) => {
  const raw = String(value || "").trim();
  if (raw && /[^0-9+\-\s]/.test(raw)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      normalized: "",
      message: "กรุณากรอกเฉพาะตัวเลข เว้นวรรคหรือเครื่องหมาย - เท่านั้น",
    };
  }
  if (raw.includes("+") && !raw.replace(/[\s-]/g, "").startsWith("+66")) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      normalized: "",
      message: "กรุณากรอกเบอร์โทรหรือเลขบัตรประชาชนที่ถูกต้อง",
    };
  }

  const normalized = normalizePromptPay(value);
  if (!normalized) return { valid: true, normalized: "" };

  const valid =
    (normalized.length === 10 && /^0\d{9}$/.test(normalized)) ||
    (normalized.length === 13 && /^\d{13}$/.test(normalized));

  return {
    valid,
    normalized,
    message: "กรุณากรอกพร้อมเพย์เป็นเบอร์มือถือ 10 หลักหรือเลขบัตรประชาชน 13 หลัก",
  };
};

export const openBankApp = async (textToCopy, scheme, title) => {
  let copied = false;
  if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy);
      copied = true;
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }
  } else {
    const textarea = document.createElement("textarea");
    textarea.value = textToCopy;
    textarea.style.position = "fixed";
    textarea.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    textarea.select();
    copied = document.execCommand("copy");
    textarea.remove();
  }

  if (!copied) {
    dynaura.error({
      title: "คัดลอกไม่สำเร็จ",
      description: "กรุณาลองคัดลอกเลขบัญชีอีกครั้ง",
      duration: 4000,
    });
    return;
  }

  dynaura.success({
    title,
    description: scheme
      ? "ก๊อปเลขบัญชีแล้ว กำลังเปิดแอปธนาคาร"
      : "คัดลอกเลขบัญชีเรียบร้อยแล้ว",
    duration: 3000,
  });

  if (scheme) window.location.href = scheme;
};
// ดึงข้อมูลคิวที่ค้างซิงค์ (Get pending sync queue)
export const getOfflineQueue = () => {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("trip_offline_queue") || "[]");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

// บันทึกคิวลงเครื่อง (Save queue to local storage)
export const saveOfflineQueue = (queue) => {
  localStorage.setItem("trip_offline_queue", JSON.stringify(queue));
};

// ดึงข้อมูลรายจ่ายล่าสุดที่เคยโหลดไว้ (Get cached expenses)
export const getCachedExpenses = () => {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("trip_cached_expenses") || "[]");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

// บันทึกข้อมูลรายจ่ายลงเครื่องเพื่อแสดงผลทันที (Save expenses to local storage for instant load)
export const saveCachedExpenses = (expenses) => {
  localStorage.setItem("trip_cached_expenses", JSON.stringify(expenses));
};

# React + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the Oxlint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the [TS template](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/tree/main/packages/create-vite/template-react-ts) for information on how to integrate TypeScript and Oxlint's TypeScript related rules in your project.

// If the loader is already loaded, just stop.
if (!self.define) {
  let registry = {};

  // Used for `eval` and `importScripts` where we can't get script URL by other means.
  // In both cases, it's safe to use a global var because those functions are synchronous.
  let nextDefineUri;

  const singleRequire = (uri, parentUri) => {
    uri = new URL(uri + ".js", parentUri).href;
    return registry[uri] || (
      
        new Promise(resolve => {
          if ("document" in self) {
            const script = document.createElement("script");
            script.src = uri;
            script.onload = resolve;
            document.head.appendChild(script);
          } else {
            nextDefineUri = uri;
            importScripts(uri);
            resolve();
          }
        })
      
      .then(() => {
        let promise = registry[uri];
        if (!promise) {
          throw new Error(`Module ${uri} didn’t register its module`);
        }
        return promise;
      })
    );
  };

  self.define = (depsNames, factory) => {
    const uri = nextDefineUri || ("document" in self ? document.currentScript.src : "") || location.href;
    if (registry[uri]) {
      // Module is already loading or loaded.
      return;
    }
    let exports = {};
    const require = depUri => singleRequire(depUri, uri);
    const specialDeps = {
      module: { uri },
      exports,
      require
    };
    registry[uri] = Promise.all(depsNames.map(
      depName => specialDeps[depName] || require(depName)
    )).then(deps => {
      factory(...deps);
      return exports;
    });
  };
}

    /**
     * Workbox errors should be thrown with this class.
     * This allows use to ensure the type easily in tests,
     * helps developers identify errors from workbox
     * easily and allows use to optimise error
     * messages correctly.
     *
     * @private
