import {
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

const formatDateTime = (expense) => {
  if (!expense.created_at) return expense.expense_date;
  const parsed = new Date(expense.created_at);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return expense.expense_date;

  const timeText = parsed.toLocaleTimeString("th-TH", {
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
    hour12: false,
  });
  return `${expense.expense_date} • ${timeText} น.`;
};

export default function SettlementDetailsModal({ transfer, onClose }) {
  const [isHistoryExpanded, setIsHistoryExpanded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (event) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
  }, [onClose]);

  const {
    from,
    to,
    amount,
    positiveItems = [],
    negativeItems = [],
    positiveTotal = 0,
    negativeTotal = 0,
    settledHistory = [],
  } = transfer;

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/75"
      panelClassName="max-h-[85vh] max-w-md"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-gray-800 bg-gray-800 p-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-100">
            <span>{from}</span>
            <ArrowRight size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
            <span>{to}</span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-400">
            ยอดสุทธิหลังหักลบ:{" "}
            <span className="text-base font-bold text-lime-400">
              ฿{formatMoney(amount)}
            </span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="text-gray-400 transition hover:text-gray-200"
          aria-label="ปิดหน้าต่าง"
        >
          <X size={22} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Summary Strip */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 border-b border-gray-800 bg-gray-900/80 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs">
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 px-3 py-1.5">
          <span className="text-gray-400">{to} ออกให้ก่อน</span>
          <p className="font-bold text-emerald-500">
            +฿{formatMoney(positiveTotal)}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 px-3 py-1.5">
          <span className="text-gray-400">{from} ออกให้หักลบ</span>
          <p className="font-bold text-red-500">
            -฿{formatMoney(negativeTotal)}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Itemized List */}
      <div className="flex-1 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto p-4">
        {/* 1. รายการบวก (สีเขียว) เรียงวันที่และเวลาล่าสุด -> เก่าสุด */}
        {positiveItems.map((expense) => (
          <div
            key={`pos-${expense.id}`}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/30 bg-gray-800 p-3"
          >
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="mb-0.5 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                <span>{formatDateTime(expense)}</span>
                <span className="mx-1.5">•</span>
                <span>
                  จ่ายโดย:{" "}
                  <strong className="font-semibold text-lime-400">
                    {expense.paid_by}
                  </strong>
                </span>
              </p>
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-gray-100">
                {expense.item_name}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                หาร {expense.splitCount} คน (ยอดเต็ม ฿
                {formatMoney(expense.amount)})
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-500">
                +฿{formatMoney(expense.shareAmount)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}

        {/* 2. รายการลบ (สีแดง) เรียงวันที่และเวลาล่าสุด -> เก่าสุด */}
        {negativeItems.map((expense) => (
          <div
            key={`neg-${expense.id}`}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-gray-800 p-3"
          >
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="mb-0.5 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                <span>{formatDateTime(expense)}</span>
                <span className="mx-1.5">•</span>
                <span>
                  จ่ายโดย:{" "}
                  <strong className="font-semibold text-lime-400">
                    {expense.paid_by}
                  </strong>
                </span>
              </p>
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-gray-100">
                {expense.item_name}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                หาร {expense.splitCount} คน (ยอดเต็ม ฿
                {formatMoney(expense.amount)})
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="shrink-0 text-right">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-500">
                -฿{formatMoney(expense.shareAmount)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}

        {/* 3. บรรทัดสุดท้าย: เมนูพับเก็บรายการที่ชำระแล้ว (สีเทา ไม่นำมาคำนวณ) */}
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800/60">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsHistoryExpanded((prev) => !prev)}
            className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 transition hover:bg-gray-800"
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="text-gray-400" />
              <span>รายการที่ชำระแล้ว ({settledHistory.length})</span>
            </span>
            {isHistoryExpanded ? (
              <ChevronDown size={16} className="text-gray-400" />
            ) : (
              <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-gray-400" />
            )}
          </button>

          <div
            className={`grid transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out ${
              isHistoryExpanded
                ? "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"
                : "grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="overflow-hidden">
              <div className="space-y-1.5 border-t border-gray-700/70 p-2.5">
                {settledHistory.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="py-2 text-center text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                    ยังไม่มีรายการที่ชำระแล้วของคู่นี้
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  settledHistory.map((item) => (
                    <div
                      key={`settled-${item.id}`}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between rounded border border-gray-700/60 bg-gray-900/60 px-2.5 py-2 text-xs text-gray-400"
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                          {formatDateTime(item)}
                        </p>
                        <p className="truncate text-gray-400">
                          {item.item_name}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <span className="shrink-0 font-medium text-gray-400">
                        ฿{formatMoney(item.amount)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer */}
      <div className="border-t border-gray-800 bg-gray-900 p-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-300 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
        >
          ปิดหน้าต่าง
        </button>
      </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/components/SettlementSection.jsx
==================================================
import {
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle,
  ChevronDown,
  FileText,
  History,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";

export default function SettlementSection({
  settlements,
  onOpenPayment,
  onOpenDetails,
  onOpenHistory,
  pendingSettlement,
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);
  const transferCount = settlements.transfers.length;

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div
        role="button"
        tabIndex={0}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen((prev) => !prev)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            setIsOpen((prev) => !prev);
          }
        }}
        className="flex cursor-pointer select-none items-center justify-between gap-2"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lime-400">
            <Users size={20} /> สรุปเคลียร์เงิน
          </h2>
          {!isOpen && (
            <span
              className={`rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                transferCount > 0
                  ? "border-lime-500/40 bg-lime-500/15 text-lime-400"
                  : "border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 text-gray-400"
              }`}
            >
              {transferCount > 0 ? `${transferCount} รายการ` : "ครบแล้ว"}
            </span>
          )}
          <ChevronDown
            size={18}
            className={`text-gray-400 transition-transform duration-200 ${
              isOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""
            }`}
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            onOpenHistory();
          }}
          className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 transition hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-gray-950"
          title="ประวัติการชำระ"
          aria-label="ประวัติการชำระ"
        >
          <History size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div
        className={`grid transition-[grid-template-rows,opacity,margin] duration-200 ease-out ${
          isOpen
            ? "mt-4 grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"
            : "mt-0 grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"
        }`}
      >
        <div className="overflow-hidden">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {transferCount === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-2 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
                ทุกคนเคลียร์เงินครบแล้ว
              </p>
            ) : (
              settlements.transfers.map((transfer) => {
                const pairKey = `${transfer.from}-${transfer.to}`;
                const isPendingPair = pendingSettlement === pairKey;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={pairKey}
                    className="rounded-lg border border-lime-900 bg-gray-800 p-3"
                  >
                    <div className="mb-2 flex justify-between p-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
                        <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.from}</span>
                        <ArrowRight size={16} className="text-gray-400" />
                        <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.to}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                        ฿{formatMoney(transfer.amount)}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenDetails(transfer)}
                        className="flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded border border-gray-600 bg-gray-900 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-gray-100 shadow-sm transition hover:cursor-pointer hover:scale-102"
                      >
                        <FileText size={14} /> รายละเอียด
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenPayment(transfer)}
                        disabled={isPendingPair}
                        className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded py-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-950 shadow-sm transition ${
                          isPendingPair
                            ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                            : "bg-lime-500 hover:bg-lime-300"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <CheckCircle size={14} />{" "}
                        {isPendingPair ? "กำลังบันทึก..." : "เคลียร์ยอด"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { Users, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import ModalShell from "./ModalShell";

export default function SplitModal({ expense, members, onClose, onSave }) {
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSplit, setSelectedSplit] = useState(() => {
    const rawSplit =
      expense?.split_between?.length > 0
        ? expense.split_between
        : [expense.paid_by];
    return rawSplit.filter((m) => members.includes(m));
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
  }, [onClose]);

  const handleToggle = (member) =>
    setSelectedSplit((prev) =>
      prev.includes(member)
        ? prev.filter((m) => m !== member)
        : [...prev, member],
    );
  const isAllSelected =
    selectedSplit.length === members.length && members.length > 0;
  const handleToggleAll = () =>
    isAllSelected ? setSelectedSplit([]) : setSelectedSplit([...members]);

  return (
    <ModalShell
      backdropClassName="bg-gray-950/70"
      panelClassName="max-w-sm"
      onClose={onClose}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-gray-800 bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-100">
            ระบุผู้หารรายการ
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-lime-400">
            {expense.item_name} (฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)})
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-sky-400">
            <Users size={13} />
            <span>
              เลือกแล้ว {selectedSplit.length} คน (จาก {members.length} คน)
            </span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="text-gray-400 transition hover:text-gray-200"
        >
          <X size={20} />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">เลือกคนที่ร่วมหาร</p>
          <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-lime-400 hover:text-lime-300">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={isAllSelected}
              onChange={handleToggleAll}
              className="split-check h-3.5 w-3.5 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <span>เลือกทุกคน</span>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div className="mb-4 max-h-56 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {members.map((member) => (
            <label
              key={member}
              className="flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-800 bg-gray-800/60 p-3 transition hover:bg-gray-750"
            >
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-100">
                {member}
              </span>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={selectedSplit.includes(member)}
                onChange={() => handleToggle(member)}
                className="split-check h-4 w-4 cursor-pointer"
              />
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
          >
            ยกเลิก
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isSaving}
            onClick={async () => {
              setIsSaving(true);
              const success = expense.__draft
                ? await onSave(null, selectedSplit)
                : await onSave(expense.id, selectedSplit);
              setIsSaving(false);
              if (success) onClose();
            }}
            className={`flex-1 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-950 transition ${
              isSaving
                ? "cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-500 shimmer"
                : "bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300"
            }`}
          >
            {isSaving ? "กำลังบันทึก..." : "ตกลง"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ModalShell>
  );
}

import { Palette } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useTheme } from "../context/ThemeContext";

const THEMES = [
  { id: "dark", color: "#111827", label: "ธีมเขียวดำ", transform: "translate(-8px, -132px)" },
  { id: "brown", color: "#55423d", label: "ธีมน้ำตาล", transform: "translate(-74px, -112px)" },
  { id: "coral", color: "#ff8ba7", label: "ธีมครีม-คอรัล", transform: "translate(-126px, -70px)" },
  { id: "pink", color: "#fec7d7", label: "ธีมชมพู", transform: "translate(-166px, -10px)" },
];

export default function ThemeMenu() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const { setTheme } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const closeMenu = () => setOpen(false);
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", closeMenu);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", closeMenu, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("touchmove", closeMenu, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", closeMenu);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", closeMenu);
      window.removeEventListener("touchmove", closeMenu);
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed bottom-[max(1.25rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] right-5 z-40 h-14 w-14"
      onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      onPointerDown={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
    >
      {THEMES.map((option) => (
        <button
          key={option.id}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setTheme(option.id);
            setOpen(false);
          }}
          className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-11 w-11 rounded-full border-2 border-white/80 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: option.color,
            transform: open ? option.transform : "translate(0, 0) scale(0)",
            opacity: open ? 1 : 0,
            pointerEvents: open ? "auto" : "none",
          }}
          title={option.label}
          aria-label={option.label}
        />
      ))}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
        className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-lime-400/40 bg-lime-400 text-gray-950 shadow-xl transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105"
        aria-label="เปลี่ยนธีม"
      >
        <Palette size={24} />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Check, RefreshCw, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { formatMoney } from "../utils/trip";
import { dynaura } from "dynaura";

export default function TripHeader({
  totalExpense,
  isSyncing,
  onRefresh,
  MEMBERS,
  onOpenMemberModal,
  isOffline,
}) {
  const [syncStatus, setSyncStatus] = useState("idle");
  const [displayTotal, setDisplayTotal] = useState(0);
  const [replayCount, setReplayCount] = useState(0);
  const animatedValueRef = useRef(0);
  const prevSyncingRef = useRef(isSyncing);
  const manualSyncRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const wasSyncing = prevSyncingRef.current;
    prevSyncingRef.current = isSyncing;

    if (isSyncing) {
      setSyncStatus("syncing");
      return;
    }

    if (wasSyncing) {
      setSyncStatus("success");
      if (manualSyncRef.current) {
        manualSyncRef.current = false;
        animatedValueRef.current = 0;
        setDisplayTotal(0);
        setReplayCount((count) => count + 1);
      }
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setSyncStatus("idle"), 1500);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [isSyncing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const target = Number(totalExpense) || 0;
    const start = animatedValueRef.current;

    if (Math.abs(target - start) < 0.005) {
      animatedValueRef.current = target;
      setDisplayTotal(target);
      return;
    }

    const duration = 650;
    const startTime = performance.now();
    let frameId;

    const tick = (now) => {
      const elapsed = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / duration);
      // easeOutCubic: วิ่งเร็วช่วงต้นแล้วชะลอนุ่มๆ ตอนเข้าเป้า
      const eased = 1 - (1 - progress) ** 3;
      const current = start + (target - start) * eased;

      animatedValueRef.current = current;
      setDisplayTotal(current);

      if (progress < 1) {
        frameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        animatedValueRef.current = target;
        setDisplayTotal(target);
      }
    };

    frameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
  }, [totalExpense, replayCount]);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-gray-900 px-4 pb-4 pt-[calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)+1rem)] text-gray-100 shadow-md">
      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-md text-center">
        <button
          onClick={onOpenMemberModal}
          className="absolute left-0 top-5 flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
        >
          <Users size={20} className="text-lime-400" />
          <span className="text-base font-bold text-gray-300">
            {MEMBERS.length}
          </span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (isOffline) {
              dynaura.warning({
                title: "ออฟไลน์",
                description: "ไม่สามารถรีเฟรชขณะออฟไลน์ได้",
                duration: 4000,
              });
              return;
            }
            manualSyncRef.current = true;
            onRefresh();
          }}
          disabled={syncStatus === "syncing" || isOffline}
          className={`absolute right-1 top-4 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-800 transition hover:bg-gray-700 ${
            isOffline ? "cursor-not-allowed opacity-50" : ""
          }`}
        >
          {syncStatus === "syncing" ? (
            <RefreshCw size={26} className="animate-spin text-gray-400" />
          ) : syncStatus === "success" ? (
            <Check size={26} className="text-lime-400" />
          ) : (
            <RefreshCw size={26} className="text-gray-300" />
          )}
        </button>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-light opacity-80">
          ยอดรวมค่าใช้จ่ายทั้งทริป
        </p>
        <h1 className="my-1 text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums">
          ฿{formatMoney(displayTotal)}
        </h1>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

FILE: ./src/context/ThemeContext.jsx

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

const LEGACY_THEME_MAP = {
  light: "brown",
  purple: "coral",
};

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("tripTheme") || "pink";
    return LEGACY_THEME_MAP[saved] || saved;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
    localStorage.setItem("tripTheme", theme);

    const themeColors = {
      dark: "#111827",
      pink: "#fec7d7",
      brown: "#55423d",
      coral: "#faeee7",
    };
    const themeColor = themeColors[theme] || themeColors.dark;

    let themeMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    if (!themeMeta) {
      themeMeta = document.createElement("meta");
      themeMeta.name = "theme-color";
      document.head.appendChild(themeMeta);
    }
    themeMeta.content = themeColor;

    const statusBarMeta = document.querySelector(
      'meta[name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style"]',
    );
    if (statusBarMeta) {
      statusBarMeta.content = theme === "dark" ? "black" : "default";
    }
  }, [theme]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider");
  return context;
}

import { useEffect } from "react";

export default function usePinchGuard() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const preventPinchTouch = (event) => {
      if (event.touches?.length > 1) event.preventDefault();
    };
    const preventSafariGesture = (event) => event.preventDefault();

    document.addEventListener("touchmove", preventPinchTouch, { passive: false });
    document.addEventListener("gesturestart", preventSafariGesture, {
      passive: false,
    });
    document.addEventListener("gesturechange", preventSafariGesture, {
      passive: false,
    });

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("touchmove", preventPinchTouch);
      document.removeEventListener("gesturestart", preventSafariGesture);
      document.removeEventListener("gesturechange", preventSafariGesture);
    };
  }, []);
}

FILE: ./src/hooks/useSettlements.js

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { HISTORY_CATEGORY } from "../data/constants";

const roundMoney = (value) =>
  Math.round((Number(value) + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;

const parseExpenseTimestamp = (expense) => {
  let dateScore = 0;
  if (
    typeof expense.expense_date === "string" &&
    expense.expense_date.includes("/")
  ) {
    const [day, month, year] = expense.expense_date.split("/").map(Number);
    if (day && month && year) {
      dateScore = new Date(year, month - 1, day).getTime();
    }
  }

  const createdScore = expense.created_at
    ? new Date(expense.created_at).getTime()
    : 0;
  const fallbackId = Number(expense.id) || 0;

  return {
    dateScore: Number.isFinite(dateScore) ? dateScore : 0,
    timeScore:
      Number.isFinite(createdScore) && createdScore > 0
        ? createdScore
        : fallbackId,
  };
};

const compareNewestFirst = (a, b) => {
  const timeA = parseExpenseTimestamp(a);
  const timeB = parseExpenseTimestamp(b);
  if (timeB.dateScore !== timeA.dateScore) {
    return timeB.dateScore - timeA.dateScore;
  }
  return timeB.timeScore - timeA.timeScore;
};

const getValidSplitters = (expense, members) => {
  const configuredSplit = Array.isArray(expense.split_between)
    ? expense.split_between
    : [];
  const validSplit = configuredSplit.filter((member) =>
    members.includes(member),
  );
  if (validSplit.length > 0) return validSplit;
  if (members.includes(expense.paid_by)) return [expense.paid_by];
  return members.length > 0 ? [members[0]] : [];
};

export default function useSettlements(expenses, members) {
  return useMemo(() => {
    const regularExpenses = expenses.filter(
      (expense) => expense.category !== HISTORY_CATEGORY,
    );
    const historyExpenses = expenses.filter(
      (expense) => expense.category === HISTORY_CATEGORY,
    );

    const balanceMap = new Map(members.map((member) => [member, 0]));
    const transfers = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i += 1) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < members.length; j += 1) {
        const personA = members[i];
        const personB = members[j];

        const paidByAForB = [];
        const paidByBForA = [];

        regularExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
          const splitters = getValidSplitters(expense, members);
          if (splitters.length === 0) return;

          const shareAmount = roundMoney(
            Number(expense.amount) / splitters.length,
          );
          if (shareAmount <= 0) return;

          if (expense.paid_by === personA && splitters.includes(personB)) {
            paidByAForB.push({
              ...expense,
              splitCount: splitters.length,
              shareAmount,
            });
          } else if (
            expense.paid_by === personB &&
            splitters.includes(personA)
          ) {
            paidByBForA.push({
              ...expense,
              splitCount: splitters.length,
              shareAmount,
            });
          }
        });

        const totalAForB = roundMoney(
          paidByAForB.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.shareAmount, 0),
        );
        const totalBForA = roundMoney(
          paidByBForA.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.shareAmount, 0),
        );

        const pairHistory = historyExpenses.filter(
          (item) =>
            item.item_name.includes(`${personA} -> ${personB}`) ||
            item.item_name.includes(`${personB} -> ${personA}`),
        );

        const settledByBToA = roundMoney(
          pairHistory
            .filter((item) => item.item_name.includes(`${personB} -> ${personA}`))
            .reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0),
        );

        const settledByAToB = roundMoney(
          pairHistory
            .filter((item) => item.item_name.includes(`${personA} -> ${personB}`))
            .reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.amount || 0), 0),
        );

        // diff > 0 หมายถึง B ยังค้างจ่าย A อยู่สุทธิ
        const diff = roundMoney(
          totalAForB - totalBForA - settledByBToA + settledByAToB,
        );
        if (Math.abs(diff) <= 0.005) continue;

        const isBOwesA = diff > 0;
        const from = isBOwesA ? personB : personA;
        const to = isBOwesA ? personA : personB;
        const amount = Math.abs(diff);

        const positiveItems = (isBOwesA ? paidByAForB : paidByBForA).sort(
          compareNewestFirst,
        );
        const negativeItems = (isBOwesA ? paidByBForA : paidByAForB).sort(
          compareNewestFirst,
        );

        const positiveTotal = isBOwesA ? totalAForB : totalBForA;
        const negativeTotal = isBOwesA ? totalBForA : totalAForB;

        const settledHistory = [...pairHistory].sort(compareNewestFirst);

        balanceMap.set(from, roundMoney((balanceMap.get(from) || 0) - amount));
        balanceMap.set(to, roundMoney((balanceMap.get(to) || 0) + amount));

        transfers.push({
          from,
          to,
          amount,
          positiveItems,
          negativeItems,
          positiveTotal,
          negativeTotal,
          settledHistory,
        });
      }
    }

    const balances = members.map((member) => ({
      member,
      balance: balanceMap.get(member) || 0,
    }));

    return { balances, transfers };
  }, [expenses, members]);
}

==================================================
import { useRef, useState } from "react";

export default function useSwipeDrag({
  id,
  isOpen,
  setOpen,
  canDrag = true,
}) {
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState({
    active: false,
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    offset: 0,
    scrolling: false,
  });
  const isMouse = useRef(false);
  const suppressClick = useRef(false);

  let currentOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
  if (drag.active) {
    currentOffset = (isOpen ? -70 : 0) + drag.offset;
    currentOffset = Math.max(-90, Math.min(0, currentOffset));
  }

  const startDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!canDrag) return;
    setDrag({
      active: true,
      startX: clientX,
      startY: clientY,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
    if (!isOpen) setOpen(null);
  };

  const moveDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    const diffX = clientX - drag.startX;
    const diffY = Math.abs(clientY - drag.startY);

    if (!drag.scrolling && diffY > 15 && Math.abs(diffX) < 15) {
      setDrag((previous) => ({ ...previous, scrolling: true }));
      return;
    }
    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      setDrag((previous) => ({ ...previous, offset: diffX }));
    }
  };

  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    suppressClick.current = Math.abs(drag.offset) > 5;
    isMouse.current = false;

    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      const baseOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
      if (baseOffset + drag.offset < -35) setOpen(id);
      else setOpen(null);
    }

    setDrag({
      active: false,
      startX: 0,
      startY: 0,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
  };

  const touchHandlers = {
    onTouchStart: (event) =>
      startDrag(
        event.targetTouches[0].clientX,
        event.targetTouches[0].clientY,
      ),
    onTouchMove: (event) =>
      moveDrag(
        event.targetTouches[0].clientX,
        event.targetTouches[0].clientY,
      ),
    onTouchEnd: endDrag,
  };

  const mouseHandlers = {
    onMouseDown: (event) => {
      isMouse.current = true;
      startDrag(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    },
    onMouseMove: (event) => {
      if (isMouse.current) moveDrag(event.clientX, event.clientY);
    },
    onMouseUp: () => {
      if (isMouse.current) endDrag();
    },
    onMouseLeave: () => {
      if (isMouse.current) endDrag();
    },
  };

  const consumeSuppressedClick = () => {
    if (!suppressClick.current) return false;
    suppressClick.current = false;
    return true;
  };

  return {
    drag,
    currentOffset,
    isSwiped: currentOffset < -5,
    consumeSuppressedClick,
    touchHandlers,
    mouseHandlers,
  };
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { getOfflineQueue, getStoredMembers } from "../utils/trip";
import { supabase } from "../services/supabase";

export default function useTripData(onMembersUpdated, onMemberDetailsUpdated) {
  const [members, setMembers] = useState(getStoredMembers);
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState([]);
  const [isOffline, setIsOffline] = useState(!navigator.onLine);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  const refreshMembers = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!navigator.onLine) return;

    const { data } = await supabase
      .from("trip_members")
      .select("name, promptpay, bank_id, bank_acc")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

    if (data && data.length > 0) {
      const fetchedMembers = data.map((member) => member.name);
      const fetchedDetails = data.reduce((details, member) => {
        details[member.name] = {
          promptpay: member.promptpay || "",
          bankId: member.bank_id || "kbank",
          bankAcc: member.bank_acc || "",
        };
        return details;
      }, {});
      setMembers(fetchedMembers);
      localStorage.setItem("tripMembers", JSON.stringify(fetchedMembers));
      localStorage.setItem("memberDetails", JSON.stringify(fetchedDetails));
      onMembersUpdated(fetchedMembers);
      if (onMemberDetailsUpdated) onMemberDetailsUpdated(fetchedDetails);
    }
  }, [onMembersUpdated, onMemberDetailsUpdated]);

  const refreshExpenses = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      const cachedData = localStorage.getItem("tripExpensesCache");
      const cachedExpenses = cachedData ? JSON.parse(cachedData) : [];
      const queuedExpenses = getOfflineQueue();
      const mergedById = new Map();
      [...cachedExpenses, ...queuedExpenses].forEach((expense) => {
        mergedById.set(expense.id, expense);
      });
      const mergedExpenses = [...mergedById.values()].sort(
        (a, b) => new Date(b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.created_at || 0),
      );
      setExpenses(mergedExpenses);
      localStorage.setItem("tripExpensesCache", JSON.stringify(mergedExpenses));
      return;
    }

    setIsSyncing(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;

      if (data) {
        const pendingQueue = getOfflineQueue();
        const mergedById = new Map();
        [...data, ...pendingQueue].forEach((expense) => {
          mergedById.set(expense.id, expense);
        });
        const mergedExpenses = [...mergedById.values()].sort(
          (a, b) =>
            new Date(b.created_at || 0) - new Date(a.created_at || 0),
        );
        setExpenses(mergedExpenses);
        localStorage.setItem(
          "tripExpensesCache",
          JSON.stringify(mergedExpenses),
        );
      }
    } catch {
      const cachedData = localStorage.getItem("tripExpensesCache");
      if (cachedData) setExpenses(JSON.parse(cachedData));
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => setIsSyncing(false), 500);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsOffline(!navigator.onLine);

    const handleOnline = () => {
      setIsOffline(false);
      Promise.all([refreshMembers(), refreshExpenses()]).then(() =>
        setLoading(false),
      );
    };
    const handleOffline = () => setIsOffline(true);

    window.addEventListener("online", handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener("offline", handleOffline);

    Promise.all([refreshMembers(), refreshExpenses()]).then(() =>
      setLoading(false),
    );

    const expenseSub = supabase
      .channel("trip_expenses_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_expenses" },
        refreshExpenses,
      )
      .subscribe();
    const memberSub = supabase
      .channel("trip_members_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_members" },
        refreshMembers,
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("online", handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", handleOffline);
      supabase.removeChannel(expenseSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(memberSub);
    };
  }, [refreshExpenses, refreshMembers]);

  return {
    members,
    setMembers,
    expenses,
    setExpenses,
    isOffline,
    loading,
    isSyncing,
    refreshMembers,
    refreshExpenses,
  };
}

import { dynaura } from "dynaura";
import { DEFAULT_MEMBERS } from "../data/constants";

export const getTodayISO = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA");

export const formatForDB = (isoDate) => {
  if (!isoDate || !isoDate.includes("-")) return isoDate;
  const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-");
  return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
};

export const parseForUI = (thDate) => {
  if (!thDate || !thDate.includes("/")) return getTodayISO();
  const [d, m, y] = thDate.split("/");
  return `${y}-${m.padStart(2, "0")}-${d.padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

export const getStoredMembers = () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tripMembers") || "null");
    if (Array.isArray(saved) && saved.length > 0) return saved;
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed local data and use the defaults.
  }
  return DEFAULT_MEMBERS;
};

export const getStoredMemberDetails = () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("memberDetails") || "null");
    if (saved) return saved;
  } catch {
    // Ignore malformed local data and use an empty details object.
  }
  return {};
};

export const formatMoney = (value) =>
  Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  });

export const normalizePromptPay = (value) => {
  let normalized = String(value || "").trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, "");
  if (normalized.startsWith("+66")) {
    normalized = `0${normalized.slice(3)}`;
  } else if (normalized.startsWith("66") && normalized.length === 11) {
    normalized = `0${normalized.slice(2)}`;
  }

  return normalized;
};

export const validatePromptPay = (value) => {
  const raw = String(value || "").trim();
  if (raw && /[^0-9+\-\s]/.test(raw)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      normalized: "",
      message: "กรุณากรอกเฉพาะตัวเลข เว้นวรรคหรือเครื่องหมาย - เท่านั้น",
    };
  }
  if (raw.includes("+") && !raw.replace(/[\s-]/g, "").startsWith("+66")) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      normalized: "",
      message: "กรุณากรอกเบอร์โทรหรือเลขบัตรประชาชนที่ถูกต้อง",
    };
  }

  const normalized = normalizePromptPay(value);
  if (!normalized) return { valid: true, normalized: "" };

  const valid =
    (normalized.length === 10 && /^0\d{9}$/.test(normalized)) ||
    (normalized.length === 13 && /^\d{13}$/.test(normalized));

  return {
    valid,
    normalized,
    message: "กรุณากรอกพร้อมเพย์เป็นเบอร์มือถือ 10 หลักหรือเลขบัตรประชาชน 13 หลัก",
  };
};

export const openBankApp = async (textToCopy, scheme, title) => {
  let copied = false;
  if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textToCopy);
      copied = true;
    } catch {
      copied = false;
    }
  } else {
    const textarea = document.createElement("textarea");
    textarea.value = textToCopy;
    textarea.style.position = "fixed";
    textarea.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    textarea.select();
    copied = document.execCommand("copy");
    textarea.remove();
  }

  if (!copied) {
    dynaura.error({
      title: "คัดลอกไม่สำเร็จ",
      description: "กรุณาลองคัดลอกเลขบัญชีอีกครั้ง",
      duration: 4000,
    });
    return;
  }

  dynaura.success({
    title,
    description: scheme
      ? "ก๊อปเลขบัญชีแล้ว กำลังเปิดแอปธนาคาร"
      : "คัดลอกเลขบัญชีเรียบร้อยแล้ว",
    duration: 3000,
  });

  if (scheme) window.location.href = scheme;
};
// ดึงข้อมูลคิวที่ค้างซิงค์ (Get pending sync queue)
export const getOfflineQueue = () => {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("trip_offline_queue") || "[]");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

// บันทึกคิวลงเครื่อง (Save queue to local storage)
export const saveOfflineQueue = (queue) => {
  localStorage.setItem("trip_offline_queue", JSON.stringify(queue));
};

// ดึงข้อมูลรายจ่ายล่าสุดที่เคยโหลดไว้ (Get cached expenses)
export const getCachedExpenses = () => {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("trip_cached_expenses") || "[]");
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

// บันทึกข้อมูลรายจ่ายลงเครื่องเพื่อแสดงผลทันที (Save expenses to local storage for instant load)
export const saveCachedExpenses = (expenses) => {
  localStorage.setItem("trip_cached_expenses", JSON.stringify(expenses));
};

//  Helper จัดการวันที่
const getTodayISO = () => new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA");
const formatForDB = (isoDate) => {
  if (!isoDate || !isoDate.includes("-")) return isoDate;
  const [y, m, d] = isoDate.split("-");
  return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
};
const parseForUI = (thDate) => {
  if (!thDate || !thDate.includes("/")) return getTodayISO();
  const [d, m, y] = thDate.split("/");
  return `${y}-${m.padStart(2, "0")}-${d.padStart(2, "0")}`;
};
const getStoredMembers = () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tripMembers") || "null");
    if (Array.isArray(saved)) {
      const members = [
        ...new Set(saved.map((member) => String(member).trim())),
      ].filter(Boolean);
      if (members.length > 0) return members;
    }
  } catch {
    localStorage.removeItem("tripMembers");
  }
  return DEFAULT_MEMBERS;
};
const getOfflineQueue = () => {
  try {
    const queue = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("offlineQueue") || "[]");
    return Array.isArray(queue) ? queue : [];
  } catch {
    localStorage.removeItem("offlineQueue");
    return [];
  }
};

  const handleAddGas = async () => {

    localStorage.setItem("defaultGasRate", gasRate);

    const payload = {
      expense_date: formatForDB(date),
      item_name: `ค่าน้ำมัน (ไมล์ ${odoStart}-${odoEnd})`,
      amount: ((end - start) / rate) * price,
      category: "⛽ ค่าน้ำมัน",
      paid_by: paidBy,
      odometer_start: start,
      odometer_end: end,
    };
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      if (editId) {
        return Swal.fire({
          icon: "warning",
          title: "แก้ไขขณะออฟไลน์ไม่ได้",
          text: "เชื่อมต่ออินเทอร์เน็ตก่อน แล้วค่อยบันทึกการแก้ไข",
        });
      }
      const queue = getOfflineQueue();
      const tempItem = { ...payload, id: `temp-${Date.now()}`, tempId: true };

      });
    } else {

        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .update(payload)
          .eq("id", editId);
        if (error)
          return Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",
            title: "แก้ไขไม่สำเร็จ",
            text: error.message,
          });
        setEditId(null);
      } else {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .insert([payload]);
        if (error)
          return Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",

          });

      await refreshExpenses();
      Swal.fire({

        showConfirmButton: false,
      });
    }
    setOdoStart(String(end));
    setOdoEnd("");
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (id.toString().startsWith("temp"))
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",

        text: "ไม่สามารถลบรายการค้างซิงก์ได้ รอเน็ตกลับมาก่อนนะครับ",

    const result = await Swal.fire({

    if (result.isConfirmed) {

        .from("trip_expenses")

      if (error)
        return Swal.fire({

  const handleSettleDebt = async (from, to, settleAmount) => {
    if (!navigator.onLine)
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        text: "เน็ตหลุดจ้า",
      });

    const qrUrl =
      QR_IMAGES[to] || "https://placehold.co/250x250?text=No+QR+Code";

    const result = await Swal.fire({
      title: `โอนเงินให้ ${to}`,
      text: `ยอดเงิน ฿${settleAmount.toLocaleString()}`,
      imageUrl: qrUrl,
      imageWidth: 250,
      imageHeight: 250,
      imageAlt: `QR Code ของ ${to}`,
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "ยืนยันโอนแล้ว",
      confirmButtonColor: "#D7FF3B",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
    });

    if (!result.isConfirmed) return;

    const today = new Date();
    const formattedDate = `${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}/${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}/${today.getFullYear()}`;

    const { error } = await supabase.from("trip_expenses").insert([
      {
        expense_date: formattedDate,
        item_name: `[เคลียร์ยอด] ${from} -> ${to}`,
        amount: settleAmount,
        category: HISTORY_CATEGORY,
        paid_by: from,
      },
    ]);
    if (error)
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",
        title: "บันทึกการโอนไม่สำเร็จ",
        text: error.message,
      });
    await refreshExpenses();
    Swal.fire({
      icon: "success",
      title: "เคลียร์ยอดสำเร็จ!",
      text: `บันทึกการโอนเงินของ ${from} แล้ว ยอดหนี้เป็น 0`,
      timer: 2000,
      showConfirmButton: false,
    });
  };

  const regularExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (expense) => expense.category !== HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const historyExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (expense) => expense.category === HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const groupedExpenses = useMemo(
    () =>
      regularExpenses.reduce((groups, expense) => {
        (groups[expense.expense_date] ||= []).push(expense);
        return groups;
      }, {}),
    [regularExpenses],
  );
  const totalExpense = useMemo(
    () =>
      regularExpenses.reduce((sum, expense) => sum + Number(expense.amount), 0),
    [regularExpenses],
  );
  const perPerson = MEMBERS.length > 0 ? totalExpense / MEMBERS.length : 0;
  const previewGasCost =
    Number.isFinite(Number(odoStart)) &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(odoEnd)) &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(gasPrice)) &&
    Number(gasRate) > 0
      ? ((Number(odoEnd) - Number(odoStart)) / Number(gasRate)) *
        Number(gasPrice)
      : 0;
  const settlements = useMemo(() => {
    const balances = MEMBERS.map((member) => {
      const groupPaidAmount = regularExpenses
        .filter((expense) => expense.paid_by === member)
        .reduce((sum, expense) => sum + Number(expense.amount), 0);
      let balance = groupPaidAmount - perPerson;
      historyExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
        if (expense.paid_by === member) balance += Number(expense.amount);
        if (expense.item_name.includes(`-> ${member}`))
          balance -= Number(expense.amount);
      });
      return { member, balance, groupPaidAmount };
    });
    const debtors = balances
      .filter((balance) => balance.balance < -0.01)
      .map((balance) => ({ ...balance }));
    const creditors = balances
      .filter((balance) => balance.balance > 0.01)
      .map((balance) => ({ ...balance }));
    const transfers = [];
    let debtorIndex = 0;
    let creditorIndex = 0;
    while (debtorIndex < debtors.length && creditorIndex < creditors.length) {
      const debtor = debtors[debtorIndex];
      const creditor = creditors[creditorIndex];
      const transferAmount = Math.min(
        Math.abs(debtor.balance),
        creditor.balance,
      );
      if (transferAmount > 0.01)
        transfers.push({
          from: debtor.member,
          to: creditor.member,
          amount: transferAmount,
        });
      debtor.balance += transferAmount;
      creditor.balance -= transferAmount;
      if (Math.abs(debtor.balance) < 0.01) debtorIndex++;
      if (creditor.balance < 0.01) creditorIndex++;
    }
    return { balances, transfers };
  }, [MEMBERS, regularExpenses, historyExpenses, perPerson]);

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen bg-black pb-20 font-sans text-gray-100">
      <TripHeader
        totalExpense={totalExpense}
        perPerson={perPerson}
        isSyncing={isSyncing}
        onRefresh={refreshExpenses}
        MEMBERS={MEMBERS}
      />
      <main className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-1 items-start gap-6 p-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <ExpenseForm
          editId={editId}
          date={date}
          category={category}
          categories={CATEGORIES}
          item={item}
          amount={amount}
          paidBy={paidBy}
          members={MEMBERS}
          onDateChange={setDate}
          onCategoryChange={setCategory}
          onItemChange={setItem}
          onAmountChange={setAmount}
          onPaidByChange={handlePaidByChange}
          onAddMember={handleAddMember}
          onSubmit={handleAddExpense}
          onCancel={cancelEdit}
        />

        <ExpenseList
          expenses={regularExpenses}
          groupedExpenses={groupedExpenses}
          loading={loading}
          isExpanded={isListExpanded}
          collapsedDates={collapsedDates}
          onToggleExpanded={() => setIsListExpanded((expanded) => !expanded)}
          onToggleDate={(value) =>
            setCollapsedDates((dates) => ({ ...dates, [value]: !dates[value] }))
          }
          onEdit={handleEdit}
          onDelete={handleDelete}
        />
        <SettlementCard
          settlements={settlements}
          handleRemoveMember={handleRemoveMember}
          onSettle={handleSettleDebt}
        />
        <GasForm
          odoStart={odoStart}
          odoEnd={odoEnd}
          gasPrice={gasPrice}
          gasRate={gasRate}
          previewGasCost={previewGasCost}
          onOdoStartChange={setOdoStart}
          onOdoEndChange={setOdoEnd}
          onGasPriceChange={setGasPrice}
          onGasRateChange={setGasRate}
          onSubmit={handleAddGas}
        />
      </main>
      <button
        onClick={() => setShowHistory(true)}
        className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 rounded-full bg-amber-500 p-4 text-gray-950 shadow-xl shadow-lime-500/10 transition hover:bg-amber-700"
        title="ดูประวัติการเคลียร์เงิน"
      >
        <History size={24} />
      </button>
      {showHistory && (
        <HistoryModal
          expenses={historyExpenses}
          onClose={() => setShowHistory(false)}
          onUndo={handleUndoHistory}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== src/components/ExpenseForm.jsx =====

import { Edit2, Receipt } from "lucide-react";

export default function ExpenseForm({
  editId,
  date,
  category,
  categories,
  item,
  amount,
  paidBy,
  members,
  onDateChange,
  onCategoryChange,
  onItemChange,
  onAmountChange,
  onPaidByChange,
  onAddMember, 
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
}) {
  const setToday = () => {
    onDateChange(new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA"));
  };

  return (
    <section
      className={`rounded-xl border p-5 shadow-sm ${
        editId ? "border-lime-400 bg-gray-900" : "border-gray-700 bg-gray-900"
      }`}
    >
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lime-400">
        {editId ? <Edit2 size={20} className="text-lime-400" /> : <Receipt size={20} />}
        <h2 className={editId ? "text-lime-400" : ""}>
          {editId ? "แก้ไขรายการ" : "จดรายจ่ายใหม่"}
        </h2>
      </div>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-3">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <label className="mb-1 text-xs text-gray-400">วันที่</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="date"
                value={date}
                onChange={(event) => onDateChange(event.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={setToday}
                className="w-1/4 rounded-lg bg-lime-400 px-3 text-md font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300"
              >
                วันนี้
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <label className="flex flex-col text-xs text-gray-400">
            <span className="mb-1">หมวดหมู่</span>
            <select
              value={category}
              onChange={(event) => onCategoryChange(event.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            >
              {categories.map((option) => (
                <option key={option} value={option}>
                  {option}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <label className="block text-xs text-gray-400">
          ชื่อรายการ (เว้นว่างได้)
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="ดึงชื่อหมวดรายการ"
            value={item}
            onChange={(event) => onItemChange(event.target.value)}
            className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
          />
        </label>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <label className="flex flex-col text-xs text-gray-400">
            <span className="mb-1">จำนวนเงิน (บาท)</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              inputMode="decimal"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(event) => onAmountChange(event.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col text-xs text-gray-400">
            <span className="mb-1">คนจ่ายสำรอง</span>
            {/* ดักจับ onChange หากเลือกเพิ่มคน ให้เรียก onAddMember แทน */}
            <select
              value={paidBy}
              onChange={(event) => {
                if (event.target.value === "ADD_NEW_MEMBER") {
                  onAddMember();
                } else {
                  onPaidByChange(event.target.value);
                }
              }}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-300 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            >
              {members.map((member) => (
                <option key={member} value={member}>
                  {member}
                </option>
              ))}
              {/* 🧠 เพิ่มตัวเลือกนี้ไว้ล่างสุด */}
              <option value="ADD_NEW_MEMBER" className="bg-gray-700 font-bold text-lime-400">
                + เพิ่มคนจ่าย...
              </option>
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        {editId ? (
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" className="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-lime-400 py-3 font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300">
              บันทึกแก้ไข
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="rounded-lg bg-gray-700 px-4 py-3 font-bold text-gray-100 transition hover:bg-gray-600">
              ยกเลิก
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button type="submit" className="w-full rounded-lg bg-lime-400 py-3 font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300">
            บันทึกรายการ
          </button>
        )}
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}


===== src/components/ExpenseList.jsx =====

import {
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  Edit2,
  FolderClosed,
  FolderOpen,
  Maximize2,
  Minimize2,
  Receipt,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useState, useRef } from "react";

//  Component ย่อยสำหรับแต่ละรายการ
function ExpenseItem({
  expense,
  swipedId,
  setSwipedId,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  formatMoney,
  isLast,
}) {
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState({
    active: false,
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    offset: 0,
    scrolling: false,
  });
  const isMouse = useRef(false);

  const isOpen = swipedId === expense.id;

  // ปรับระยะดึงให้พอดีกับปุ่มวงกลม (ปุ่มวงกลมใช้พื้นที่ประมาณ 60px)
  let currentOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
  if (drag.active) {
    currentOffset = (isOpen ? -70 : 0) + drag.offset;
    if (currentOffset > 0) currentOffset = 0;
    if (currentOffset < -90) currentOffset = -90; // ยืดสุดได้แค่ -90px
  }

  // เช็คว่าเริ่มโดนลากเกิน 5px หรือยัง เพื่อเปลี่ยนขอบการ์ดให้โค้งมน
  const isSwiped = currentOffset < -5;

  const startDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    setDrag({
      active: true,
      startX: clientX,
      startY: clientY,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
    if (swipedId !== expense.id) setSwipedId(null);
  };

  const moveDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    const diffX = clientX - drag.startX;
    const diffY = Math.abs(clientY - drag.startY);

    if (!drag.scrolling && diffY > 15 && Math.abs(diffX) < 15) {
      setDrag((prev) => ({ ...prev, scrolling: true }));
    }
    if (drag.scrolling) return;
    setDrag((prev) => ({ ...prev, offset: diffX }));
  };

  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      // ถ้าดึงเกิน -35 ให้ถือว่าเปิด
      if (currentOffset < -35) setSwipedId(expense.id);
      else setSwipedId(null);
    }
    setDrag({
      active: false,
      startX: 0,
      startY: 0,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
  };

  return (
    // เปลี่ยนพื้นหลังหลักเป็นสีเดียวกับฉากหลัง เพื่อให้ปุ่มวงกลมดูลอยเด่นขึ้นมา
    <div
      className={`relative bg-gray-900 ${!isLast ? "border-b border-gray-800" : ""}`}
    >
      {/* 🗑️ กล่องปุ่ม Delete "วงกลม" สีแดง ลอยอยู่ขวาสุด */}
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 flex items-center justify-center">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            onDelete(expense.id);
            setSwipedId(null);
          }}
          //  กำหนดให้ปุ่มเป็นวงกลม (h-11 w-11 rounded-full)
          className="flex h-13 w-13 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-red-600"
          style={{
            // ถ้ายังดึงไม่ถึงระยะ ให้ซ่อนปุ่มไว้ก่อน (opacity) และให้มันค่อยๆ ขยายตัวโผล่มา (scale)
            opacity: currentOffset < -20 ? 1 : 0,
            transform: `scale(${Math.min(1.2, 0.2 + (-currentOffset / 70) * 0.8)})`,
            transition: drag.active ? "none" : "all 0.25s ease-out",
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={22} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 📱 เลเยอร์การ์ดสีเทาหลัก */}
      <div
        className={` relative z-10 flex cursor-grab touch-pan-y items-center justify-between  p-3 pl-8 active:cursor-grabbing ${isOpen || drag.active ? "bg-gray-700" : "bg-gray-800"}  `}
        style={{
          transform: `translate3d(${currentOffset}px, 0, 0)`,
          transition: drag.active ? "none" : "all 0.25s ease-out",
          //  สั่งให้ขอบขวา "โค้งมน (Rounded)" เมื่อเริ่มโดนลาก
          borderTopRightRadius: isSwiped ? "20px" : "0px",
          borderBottomRightRadius: isSwiped ? "20px" : "0px",
        }}
        // Touch
        onTouchStart={(e) =>
          startDrag(e.targetTouches[0].clientX, e.targetTouches[0].clientY)
        }
        onTouchMove={(e) =>
          moveDrag(e.targetTouches[0].clientX, e.targetTouches[0].clientY)
        }
        onTouchEnd={endDrag}
        // Mouse
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          isMouse.current = true;
          startDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        }}
        onMouseMove={(e) => {
          if (isMouse.current) moveDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        }}
        onMouseUp={() => {
          if (isMouse.current) {
            isMouse.current = false;
            endDrag();
          }
        }}
        onMouseLeave={() => {
          if (isMouse.current) {
            isMouse.current = false;
            endDrag();
          }
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex-1 pointer-events-none">
          <p className="mb-0.5 text-xs text-gray-400">
            จ่ายโดย:{" "}
            <span className="font-bold text-lime-400">{expense.paid_by}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="font-medium text-gray-100">{expense.item_name}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{expense.category}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <p className="font-bold text-gray-100 pointer-events-none">
            ฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onEdit(expense);
              setSwipedId(null);
            }}
            className="text-gray-400 transition hover:text-lime-400 z-20 relative"
          >
            <Edit2 size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// 🧠 Component หลัก
export default function ExpenseList({
  expenses,
  groupedExpenses,
  loading,
  isExpanded,
  collapsedDates,
  onToggleExpanded,
  onToggleDate,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}) {
  const [swipedId, setSwipedId] = useState(null);

  const formatMoney = (value) =>
    Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm relative">
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-100">
          <Receipt size={20} /> <h2>รายการ ({expenses.length})</h2>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onToggleExpanded}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-300 shadow-sm"
        >
          {isExpanded ? <Minimize2 size={14} /> : <Maximize2 size={14} />}{" "}
          {isExpanded ? "ย่อเก็บ" : "ดูเต็ม"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">กำลังโหลด...</p>
      ) : expenses.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">ไม่มีรายการ</p>
      ) : (
        <div
          className={`space-y-4 pr-2 transition-all ${!isExpanded ? "max-h-96 overflow-y-auto overscroll-none" : ""}`}
        >
          {Object.keys(groupedExpenses).map((date) => (
            <div
              key={date}
              className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 shadow-sm"
            >
              <button
                onClick={() => onToggleDate(date)}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-t-lg border-b-2 border-gray-700 bg-gray-600 p-3 hover:bg-gray-600 relative z-20"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-100">
                  {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                    <FolderClosed size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                  ) : (
                    <FolderOpen size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                  )}
                  <span>{date}</span>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-gray-700 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-normal text-gray-300">
                    {groupedExpenses[date].length} รายการ
                  </span>
                </div>
                {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                  <ChevronRight size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronDown size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                )}
              </button>

              <div
                className={`grid transition-all duration-400 ease-in-out ${collapsedDates[date] ? "grid-rows-[0fr]" : "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"}`}
              >
                <div className="overflow-hidden bg-gray-900">
                  {groupedExpenses[date].map((expense, index) => (
                    <ExpenseItem
                      key={expense.id}
                      expense={expense}
                      swipedId={swipedId}
                      setSwipedId={setSwipedId}
                      onEdit={onEdit}
                      onDelete={onDelete}
                      formatMoney={formatMoney}
                      isLast={index === groupedExpenses[date].length - 1}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

===== src/components/HistoryModal.jsx =====

import { History, RotateCcw, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect } from "react";

export default function HistoryModal({ expenses, onClose, onUndo }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    };
  }, [onClose]);
  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-950/80 p-4"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="flex max-h-[80vh] w-full max-w-md flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 text-gray-100 shadow-2xl"
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
            <History size={20} /> ประวัติการเคลียร์ยอด
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="hover:text-lime-300">
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          {expenses.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-10 text-center text-gray-400">
              ยังไม่มีประวัติการโอนเงิน
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {expenses.map((expense) => (
                <div
                  key={expense.id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-3"
                >
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      {expense.expense_date}
                    </p>
                    <p className="font-medium text-gray-100">
                      {expense.item_name}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-right">
                    <p className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                      ฿{Number(expense.amount).toLocaleString()}
                    </p>
                    {/*  เปลี่ยนเป็นปุ่มกู้คืน (Undo) พร้อมไอคอน RotateCcw */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onUndo(expense.id)}
                      className="ml-2 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-3xl border border-sky-500/30 bg-sky-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sky-400 transition hover:bg-sky-500 hover:text-gray-950"
                      title="กู้คืนรายการนี้"
                    >
                      <RotateCcw size={14} /> กู้คืนรายการ
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== src/components/SettlementCard.jsx =====

import { ArrowRight, CheckCircle, Trash2, Users } from "lucide-react"; // 🧠 เอา Plus ออก

export default function SettlementCard({
  settlements,
  onSettle,
  handleRemoveMember,
}) {
  const formatMoney = (value) =>
    value.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-lime-400">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Users size={20} /> <h2>สรุปเคลียร์เงิน</h2>
        </div>
        {/* 🧠 ปุ่มเพิ่มสมาชิกถูกถอดออกไปแล้ว */}
      </div>
      <div className="mb-6 space-y-2">
        {settlements.transfers.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-2 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
            ทุกคนเคลียร์เงินครบแล้ว 🎉
          </p>
        ) : (
          settlements.transfers.map((transfer) => (
            <div
              key={`${transfer.from}-${transfer.to}`}
              className="rounded-lg border border-lime-900 bg-gray-800 p-3 "
            >
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium p-2 ">
                  <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.from}</span>
                  <ArrowRight size={16} className="text-gray-400" />
                  <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.to}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                  ฿{formatMoney(transfer.amount)}
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() =>
                  onSettle(transfer.from, transfer.to, transfer.amount)
                }
                className="flex w-10/12 m-auto items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded bg-lime-500 py-2 text-xs text-gray-950 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-lime-300"
              >
                <CheckCircle size={14} /> เคลียร์ยอดนี้
              </button>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
      <hr className="my-4 border-gray-800" />
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">
          สรุปยอดสุทธิแต่ละคน
        </p>
        {settlements.balances.map((balance) => (
          <div
            key={balance.member}
            className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-gray-100">
              <span>{balance.member}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleRemoveMember(balance.member)}
                className="rounded p-1 text-red-500 transition hover:bg-red-100 hover:text-red-700"
                title={`ลบ ${balance.member}`}
                aria-label={`ลบ ${balance.member}`}
              >
                <Trash2 size={14} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              {balance.balance > 0.01 ? (
                <span className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                  (ได้คืน ฿{formatMoney(balance.balance)})
                </span>
              ) : balance.balance < -0.01 ? (
                <span className="font-bold text-red-500">
                  (ติดลบ ฿{formatMoney(Math.abs(balance.balance))})
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-400">(พอดี)</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}


===== src/components/TripHeader.jsx =====

// src/components/TripHeader.jsx

import { RefreshCw, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function TripHeader({ totalExpense, perPerson, isSyncing, onRefresh, MEMBERS }) {
  const [syncStatus, setSyncStatus] = useState("idle");

  // 1. ดักจับการเริ่มซิงก์และซิงก์เสร็จ
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSyncing) {
      setSyncStatus("syncing");
    } else if (!isSyncing && syncStatus === "syncing") {
      setSyncStatus("success");
    }
  }, [isSyncing]); // เอา syncStatus ออกจาก dep จะได้ไม่เผลอไปตัด Timer ตัวเอง

  // 2. ดักจับตอนเป็น success ให้รอ 1.5 วิ แล้วค่อยกลับไป idle
  useEffect(() => {
    if (syncStatus === "success") {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setSyncStatus("idle"), 1500); // เพิ่มเวลาให้ดูแอนิเมชันทัน
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [syncStatus]);

  const formatMoney = (value) =>
    value.toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 bg-gray-900 p-4 text-gray-100 shadow-md">
      {/*  แทรก CSS สำหรับทำแอนิเมชันวาดเส้นขีดถูก */}
      <style>{`
        @keyframes drawCheck {
          0% {
            stroke-dasharray: 50;
            stroke-dashoffset: 50;
          }
          100% {
            stroke-dasharray: 50;
            stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          }
        }
        .animate-draw {
          animation: drawCheck 0.4s ease-out ;
        }
      `}</style>

      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-md text-center">
        <button
          onClick={onRefresh}
          disabled={syncStatus === "syncing"} 
          // 🧠 ล็อกความกว้าง-สูงให้ปุ่ม (h-10 w-10) ป้องกันปุ่มขยับตอนสลับไอคอน
          className="absolute right-5 top-5 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-800 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
          title="รีเฟรชข้อมูล"
        >
          {syncStatus === "syncing" ? (
            <RefreshCw size={40} className="animate-spin text-gray-400" />
          ) : syncStatus === "success" ? (
            //  เรียกใช้ class animate-draw ที่เราสร้างไว้ใน <style>
            <Check size={40} className="text-lime-400 animate-draw" />
          ) : (
            <RefreshCw size={40} className="text-gray-300 transition" />
          )}
        </button>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-light opacity-80">ยอดรวมค่าใช้จ่ายทั้งทริป</p>
        <h1 className="my-1 text-4xl font-bold">฿{formatMoney(totalExpense)}</h1>
        <p className="mt-3 inline-block rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 py-1 text-sm text-lime-400">
          หาร {MEMBERS.length} คน = ตกคนละ ฿{formatMoney(perPerson)}
        </p>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
