    const queue = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("offlineQueue") || "[]");
    return Array.isArray(queue) ? queue : [];
  } catch {
    localStorage.removeItem("offlineQueue");
    return [];
  }
};

export default function App() {
  const [MEMBERS, setMembers] = useState(getStoredMembers);

  const [paidBy, setPaidBy] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("defaultPaidBy");
    return saved && MEMBERS.includes(saved) ? saved : MEMBERS[0];
  });

  //  อัปเกรดฟังก์ชันเพิ่มคน ให้เปลี่ยนช่องเลือกคนเป็นชื่อใหม่ทันที
  const handleAddMember = async () => {
    const { value: name } = await Swal.fire({
      title: "เพิ่มสมาชิกใหม่",
      input: "text",
      inputLabel: "ชื่อสมาชิก",
      inputPlaceholder: "กรอกชื่อ",
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "บันทึก",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
      background: "#111827",
      color: "#F3F4F6",
      customClass: {
        popup: "!w-10/12 rounded-xl border border-gray-700",
        title: "!text-gray-100",
        input: "!border-gray-700 !bg-gray-800 !text-gray-100 !outline-none !shadow-none focus:!border-lime-400 focus:!outline-none focus:!ring-0 focus:!shadow-none",
        confirmButton: "!rounded-lg !bg-lime-400 !font-bold !text-gray-950",
        cancelButton: "!rounded-lg !bg-gray-700 !font-bold !text-gray-100",
      },
    });

    const trimmedName = name?.trim();
    if (trimmedName) {
      if (!MEMBERS.includes(trimmedName)) {
        const newMembers = [...MEMBERS, trimmedName];
        setMembers(newMembers);
        localStorage.setItem("tripMembers", JSON.stringify(newMembers));
        setPaidBy(trimmedName);
        localStorage.setItem("defaultPaidBy", trimmedName);
      } else {
        setPaidBy(trimmedName);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = (name) => {
    if (MEMBERS.length <= 1) {
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "warning",
        title: "ลบไม่ได้",
        text: "ต้องมีสมาชิกอย่างน้อย 1 คน",
      });
    }
    const memberData = settlements.balances.find((b) => b.member === name);
    if (memberData && Math.abs(memberData.balance) > 0.01) {
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",
        title: "ลบไม่ได้จ่ะ No No",
        text: `${name} มียอดค้างชำระอยู่`,
      });
    }
    const newMembers = MEMBERS.filter((m) => m !== name);
    setMembers(newMembers);
    localStorage.setItem("tripMembers", JSON.stringify(newMembers));
    if (paidBy === name) {
      setPaidBy(newMembers[0]);
      localStorage.setItem("defaultPaidBy", newMembers[0]);
    }
    Swal.fire({
      icon: "success",
      title: "ลบสมาชิกสำเร็จ",
      timer: 1000,
      showConfirmButton: false,
    });
  };

  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [isListExpanded, setIsListExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [collapsedDates, setCollapsedDates] = useState({});
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);

  const [date, setDate] = useState(getTodayISO());
  const [item, setItem] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(CATEGORIES[0]);
  const [odoStart, setOdoStart] = useState("");
  const [odoEnd, setOdoEnd] = useState("");
  const [gasPrice, setGasPrice] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("defaultGasPrice") || "",
  );
  const [gasRate, setGasRate] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("defaultGasRate") || "11",
  );

  const refreshExpenses = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("trip_expenses")
      .select("*")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",
        title: "โหลดข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ",
        text: error.message,
      });
    } else if (data) {
      setExpenses(data);
      const latestOdo = data.find((ex) => ex.odometer_end !== null);
      if (latestOdo && !editId) setOdoStart(latestOdo.odometer_end.toString());
    }
    setTimeout(() => setIsSyncing(false), 500);
  }, [editId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const loadInitialData = async () => {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (isMounted) {
        if (error) {
          Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",
            title: "โหลดข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ",
            text: error.message,
          });
        } else if (data) {
          setExpenses(data);
          const latestOdo = data.find((ex) => ex.odometer_end !== null);
          if (latestOdo && !editId)
            setOdoStart(latestOdo.odometer_end.toString());
        }
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadInitialData();

    const syncOfflineQueue = async () => {
      const queue = getOfflineQueue();
      if (queue.length > 0) {
        const payloads = queue.map(
          ({ id: _id, tempId: _tempId, ...rest }) => rest,
        );
        const { error } = await supabase.from("trip_expenses").insert(payloads);
        if (error) {
          Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",
            title: "ซิงก์ข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ",
            text: error.message,
          });
          return;
        }
        localStorage.removeItem("offlineQueue");
        await refreshExpenses();
        Swal.fire({
          icon: "success",
          title: "ออนไลน์แล้ว!",
          text: "ข้อมูลที่ค้างไว้ถูกซิงก์ขึ้นระบบเรียบร้อย",
          timer: 2000,
          showConfirmButton: false,
        });
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("online", syncOfflineQueue);

    const subscription = supabase
      .channel("trip_expenses_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_expenses" },
        () => {
          refreshExpenses();
        },
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      supabase.removeChannel(subscription);
      window.removeEventListener("online", syncOfflineQueue);
    };
  }, [editId, refreshExpenses]);

  const handlePaidByChange = (name) => {
    setPaidBy(name);
    localStorage.setItem("defaultPaidBy", name);
  };

  const handleAddExpense = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const numericAmount = Number(amount);
    if (!Number.isFinite(numericAmount) || numericAmount <= 0)
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "warning",
        title: "เตือน",
        text: "กรุณากรอกจำนวนเงิน",
      });
    const payload = {
      expense_date: formatForDB(date),
      item_name: item.trim() || category,
      amount: numericAmount,
      category,
      paid_by: paidBy,
    };
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      if (editId) {
        return Swal.fire({
          icon: "warning",
          title: "แก้ไขขณะออฟไลน์ไม่ได้",
          text: "เชื่อมต่ออินเทอร์เน็ตก่อน แล้วค่อยบันทึกการแก้ไข",
        });
      }
      const queue = getOfflineQueue();
      const tempItem = { ...payload, id: `temp-${Date.now()}`, tempId: true };
      localStorage.setItem(
        "offlineQueue",
        JSON.stringify([...queue, tempItem]),
      );
      setExpenses((current) => [tempItem, ...current]);
      await Swal.fire({
        icon: "info",
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        text: "บันทึกลงเครื่องแล้ว จะแอบซิงก์เมื่อเน็ตกลับมา",
      });
    } else {
      if (editId) {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .update(payload)
          .eq("id", editId);
        if (error)
          return Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",
            title: "แก้ไขไม่สำเร็จ",
            text: error.message,
          });
        Swal.fire({
          icon: "success",
          title: "สำเร็จ",
          text: "แก้ไขรายการเรียบร้อย",
          timer: 1500,
          showConfirmButton: false,
        });
        setEditId(null);
      } else {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .insert([payload]);
        if (error)
          return Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",
            title: "บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ",
            text: error.message,
          });
        Swal.fire({
          icon: "success",
          title: "สำเร็จ",
          text: "บันทึกรายการเรียบร้อย",
          timer: 1500,
          showConfirmButton: false,
        });
      }
      await refreshExpenses();
    }
    setItem("");
    setAmount("");
  };

  const handleEdit = (expense) => {
    setEditId(expense.id);
    setDate(parseForUI(expense.expense_date));
    setPaidBy(expense.paid_by);

    if (
      expense.category === "⛽ ค่าน้ำมัน" &&
      expense.odometer_start != null &&
      expense.odometer_end != null
    ) {
      setOdoStart(expense.odometer_start.toString());
      setOdoEnd(expense.odometer_end.toString());
      window.scrollTo({ top: 400, behavior: "smooth" });
    } else {
      setItem(expense.item_name);
      setAmount(expense.amount);
      setCategory(expense.category);
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  };

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setItem("");
    setAmount("");
    setOdoEnd("");
  };

  const handleAddGas = async () => {
    const start = Number(odoStart);
    const end = Number(odoEnd);
    const price = Number(gasPrice);
    const rate = Number(gasRate);
    if (
      !Number.isFinite(start) ||
      !Number.isFinite(end) ||
      !Number.isFinite(price) ||
      !Number.isFinite(rate) ||
      end <= start ||
      price <= 0 ||
      rate <= 0
    )
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "warning",
        title: "เตือน",
        text: "กรอกข้อมูลให้ครบ",
      });
    localStorage.setItem("defaultGasPrice", gasPrice);
    localStorage.setItem("defaultGasRate", gasRate);

    const payload = {
      expense_date: formatForDB(date),
      item_name: `ค่าน้ำมัน (ไมล์ ${odoStart}-${odoEnd})`,
      amount: ((end - start) / rate) * price,
      category: "⛽ ค่าน้ำมัน",
      paid_by: paidBy,
      odometer_start: start,
      odometer_end: end,
    };
    if (!navigator.onLine) {
      if (editId) {
        return Swal.fire({
          icon: "warning",
          title: "แก้ไขขณะออฟไลน์ไม่ได้",
          text: "เชื่อมต่ออินเทอร์เน็ตก่อน แล้วค่อยบันทึกการแก้ไข",
        });
      }
      const queue = getOfflineQueue();
      const tempItem = { ...payload, id: `temp-${Date.now()}`, tempId: true };
      localStorage.setItem(
        "offlineQueue",
        JSON.stringify([...queue, tempItem]),
      );
      setExpenses((current) => [tempItem, ...current]);
      Swal.fire({
        icon: "info",
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        text: "บันทึกลงเครื่องแล้ว",
      });
    } else {
      if (editId) {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .update(payload)
          .eq("id", editId);
        if (error)
          return Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",
            title: "แก้ไขไม่สำเร็จ",
            text: error.message,
          });
        setEditId(null);
      } else {
        const { error } = await supabase
          .from("trip_expenses")
          .insert([payload]);
        if (error)
          return Swal.fire({
            icon: "error",
            title: "บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ",
            text: error.message,
          });
      }
      await refreshExpenses();
      Swal.fire({
        icon: "success",
        title: "สำเร็จ",
        text: "บันทึกค่าน้ำมันเรียบร้อย",
        timer: 1000,
        showConfirmButton: false,
      });
    }
    setOdoStart(String(end));
    setOdoEnd("");
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    if (id.toString().startsWith("temp"))
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        text: "ไม่สามารถลบรายการค้างซิงก์ได้ รอเน็ตกลับมาก่อนนะครับ",
      });
    const result = await Swal.fire({
      title: "ลบรายการนี้?",
      icon: "warning",
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonColor: "#d33",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
      confirmButtonText: "ลบเลย!",
    });
    if (result.isConfirmed) {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .delete()
        .eq("id", id);
      if (error)
        return Swal.fire({
          icon: "error",
          title: "ลบไม่สำเร็จ",
          text: error.message,
        });
      await refreshExpenses();
      Swal.fire({
        icon: "success",
        title: "ลบแล้ว",
        timer: 1000,
        showConfirmButton: false,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleUndoHistory = async (id) => {
    const result = await Swal.fire({
      title: "กู้คืนยอดนี้?",
      text: "ยอดหนี้จะกลับไปเป็นสถานะ 'ยังไม่เคลียร์' เหมือนเดิม",
      icon: "warning",
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonColor: "#D7FF3B",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
      confirmButtonText: "ใช่, กู้คืนเลย!",
    });
    if (result.isConfirmed) {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("trip_expenses")
        .delete()
        .eq("id", id);
      if (error)
        return Swal.fire({
          icon: "error",
          title: "กู้คืนไม่สำเร็จ",
          text: error.message,
        });
      await refreshExpenses();
      Swal.fire({
        icon: "success",
        title: "กู้คืนเรียบร้อย",
        timer: 1500,
        showConfirmButton: false,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSettleDebt = async (from, to, settleAmount) => {
    if (!navigator.onLine)
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",
        title: "ออฟไลน์",
        text: "เน็ตหลุดจ้า",
      });

    const qrUrl =
      QR_IMAGES[to] || "https://placehold.co/250x250?text=No+QR+Code";

    const result = await Swal.fire({
      title: `โอนเงินให้ ${to}`,
      text: `ยอดเงิน ฿${settleAmount.toLocaleString()}`,
      imageUrl: qrUrl,
      imageWidth: 250,
      imageHeight: 250,
      imageAlt: `QR Code ของ ${to}`,
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "ยืนยันโอนแล้ว",
      confirmButtonColor: "#D7FF3B",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
    });

    if (!result.isConfirmed) return;

    const today = new Date();
    const formattedDate = `${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}/${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}/${today.getFullYear()}`;

    const { error } = await supabase.from("trip_expenses").insert([
      {
        expense_date: formattedDate,
        item_name: `[เคลียร์ยอด] ${from} -> ${to}`,
        amount: settleAmount,
        category: HISTORY_CATEGORY,
        paid_by: from,
      },
    ]);
    if (error)
      return Swal.fire({
        icon: "error",
        title: "บันทึกการโอนไม่สำเร็จ",
        text: error.message,
      });
    await refreshExpenses();
    Swal.fire({
      icon: "success",
      title: "เคลียร์ยอดสำเร็จ!",
      text: `บันทึกการโอนเงินของ ${from} แล้ว ยอดหนี้เป็น 0`,
      timer: 2000,
      showConfirmButton: false,
    });
  };

  const regularExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (expense) => expense.category !== HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const historyExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (expense) => expense.category === HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const groupedExpenses = useMemo(
    () =>
      regularExpenses.reduce((groups, expense) => {
        (groups[expense.expense_date] ||= []).push(expense);
        return groups;
      }, {}),
    [regularExpenses],
  );
  const totalExpense = useMemo(
    () =>
      regularExpenses.reduce((sum, expense) => sum + Number(expense.amount), 0),
    [regularExpenses],
  );
  const perPerson = MEMBERS.length > 0 ? totalExpense / MEMBERS.length : 0;
  const previewGasCost =
    Number.isFinite(Number(odoStart)) &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(odoEnd)) &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(gasPrice)) &&
    Number(gasRate) > 0
      ? ((Number(odoEnd) - Number(odoStart)) / Number(gasRate)) *
        Number(gasPrice)
      : 0;
  const settlements = useMemo(() => {
    const balances = MEMBERS.map((member) => {
      const groupPaidAmount = regularExpenses
        .filter((expense) => expense.paid_by === member)
        .reduce((sum, expense) => sum + Number(expense.amount), 0);
      let balance = groupPaidAmount - perPerson;
      historyExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
        if (expense.paid_by === member) balance += Number(expense.amount);
        if (expense.item_name.includes(`-> ${member}`))
          balance -= Number(expense.amount);
      });
      return { member, balance, groupPaidAmount };
    });
    const debtors = balances
      .filter((balance) => balance.balance < -0.01)
      .map((balance) => ({ ...balance }));
    const creditors = balances
      .filter((balance) => balance.balance > 0.01)
      .map((balance) => ({ ...balance }));
    const transfers = [];
    let debtorIndex = 0;
    let creditorIndex = 0;
    while (debtorIndex < debtors.length && creditorIndex < creditors.length) {
      const debtor = debtors[debtorIndex];
      const creditor = creditors[creditorIndex];
      const transferAmount = Math.min(
        Math.abs(debtor.balance),
        creditor.balance,
      );
      if (transferAmount > 0.01)
        transfers.push({
          from: debtor.member,
          to: creditor.member,
          amount: transferAmount,
        });
      debtor.balance += transferAmount;
      creditor.balance -= transferAmount;
      if (Math.abs(debtor.balance) < 0.01) debtorIndex++;
      if (creditor.balance < 0.01) creditorIndex++;
    }
    return { balances, transfers };
  }, [MEMBERS, regularExpenses, historyExpenses, perPerson]);

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen bg-black pb-20 font-sans text-gray-100">
      <TripHeader
        totalExpense={totalExpense}
        perPerson={perPerson}
        isSyncing={isSyncing}
        onRefresh={refreshExpenses}
        MEMBERS={MEMBERS}
      />
      <main className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-1 items-start gap-6 p-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <ExpenseForm
          editId={editId}
          date={date}
          category={category}
          categories={CATEGORIES}
          item={item}
          amount={amount}
          paidBy={paidBy}
          members={MEMBERS}
          onDateChange={setDate}
          onCategoryChange={setCategory}
          onItemChange={setItem}
          onAmountChange={setAmount}
          onPaidByChange={handlePaidByChange}
          onAddMember={handleAddMember}
          onSubmit={handleAddExpense}
          onCancel={cancelEdit}
        />

        <ExpenseList
          expenses={regularExpenses}
          groupedExpenses={groupedExpenses}
          loading={loading}
          isExpanded={isListExpanded}
          collapsedDates={collapsedDates}
          onToggleExpanded={() => setIsListExpanded((expanded) => !expanded)}
          onToggleDate={(value) =>
            setCollapsedDates((dates) => ({ ...dates, [value]: !dates[value] }))
          }
          onEdit={handleEdit}
          onDelete={handleDelete}
        />
        <SettlementCard
          settlements={settlements}
          handleRemoveMember={handleRemoveMember}
          onSettle={handleSettleDebt}
        />
        <GasForm
          odoStart={odoStart}
          odoEnd={odoEnd}
          gasPrice={gasPrice}
          gasRate={gasRate}
          previewGasCost={previewGasCost}
          onOdoStartChange={setOdoStart}
          onOdoEndChange={setOdoEnd}
          onGasPriceChange={setGasPrice}
          onGasRateChange={setGasRate}
          onSubmit={handleAddGas}
        />
      </main>
      <button
        onClick={() => setShowHistory(true)}
        className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-40 rounded-full bg-amber-500 p-4 text-gray-950 shadow-xl shadow-lime-500/10 transition hover:bg-amber-700"
        title="ดูประวัติการเคลียร์เงิน"
      >
        <History size={24} />
      </button>
      {showHistory && (
        <HistoryModal
          expenses={historyExpenses}
          onClose={() => setShowHistory(false)}
          onUndo={handleUndoHistory}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


===== src/components/ExpenseForm.jsx =====

import { Edit2, Receipt } from "lucide-react";

export default function ExpenseForm({
  editId,
  date,
  category,
  categories,
  item,
  amount,
  paidBy,
  members,
  onDateChange,
  onCategoryChange,
  onItemChange,
  onAmountChange,
  onPaidByChange,
  onAddMember, 
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
}) {
  const setToday = () => {
    onDateChange(new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA"));
  };

  return (
    <section
      className={`rounded-xl border p-5 shadow-sm ${
        editId ? "border-lime-400 bg-gray-900" : "border-gray-700 bg-gray-900"
      }`}
    >
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lime-400">
        {editId ? <Edit2 size={20} className="text-lime-400" /> : <Receipt size={20} />}
        <h2 className={editId ? "text-lime-400" : ""}>
          {editId ? "แก้ไขรายการ" : "จดรายจ่ายใหม่"}
        </h2>
      </div>
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-3">
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <label className="mb-1 text-xs text-gray-400">วันที่</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="date"
                value={date}
                onChange={(event) => onDateChange(event.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={setToday}
                className="w-1/4 rounded-lg bg-lime-400 px-3 text-md font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300"
              >
                วันนี้
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <label className="flex flex-col text-xs text-gray-400">
            <span className="mb-1">หมวดหมู่</span>
            <select
              value={category}
              onChange={(event) => onCategoryChange(event.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            >
              {categories.map((option) => (
                <option key={option} value={option}>
                  {option}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <label className="block text-xs text-gray-400">
          ชื่อรายการ (เว้นว่างได้)
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="ดึงชื่อหมวดรายการ"
            value={item}
            onChange={(event) => onItemChange(event.target.value)}
            className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
          />
        </label>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <label className="flex flex-col text-xs text-gray-400">
            <span className="mb-1">จำนวนเงิน (บาท)</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              inputMode="decimal"
              placeholder="0.00"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(event) => onAmountChange(event.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            />
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col text-xs text-gray-400">
            <span className="mb-1">คนจ่ายสำรอง</span>
            {/* ดักจับ onChange หากเลือกเพิ่มคน ให้เรียก onAddMember แทน */}
            <select
              value={paidBy}
              onChange={(event) => {
                if (event.target.value === "ADD_NEW_MEMBER") {
                  onAddMember();
                } else {
                  onPaidByChange(event.target.value);
                }
              }}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-300 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            >
              {members.map((member) => (
                <option key={member} value={member}>
                  {member}
                </option>
              ))}
              {/* 🧠 เพิ่มตัวเลือกนี้ไว้ล่างสุด */}
              <option value="ADD_NEW_MEMBER" className="bg-gray-700 font-bold text-lime-400">
                + เพิ่มคนจ่าย...
              </option>
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        {editId ? (
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" className="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-lime-400 py-3 font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300">
              บันทึกแก้ไข
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className="rounded-lg bg-gray-700 px-4 py-3 font-bold text-gray-100 transition hover:bg-gray-600">
              ยกเลิก
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button type="submit" className="w-full rounded-lg bg-lime-400 py-3 font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300">
            บันทึกรายการ
          </button>
        )}
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}


===== src/components/ExpenseList.jsx =====

import {
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  Edit2,
  FolderClosed,
  FolderOpen,
  Maximize2,
  Minimize2,
  Receipt,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useState, useRef } from "react";

//  Component ย่อยสำหรับแต่ละรายการ
function ExpenseItem({
  expense,
  swipedId,
  setSwipedId,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  formatMoney,
  isLast,
}) {
  const [drag, setDrag] = useState({
    active: false,
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    offset: 0,
    scrolling: false,
  });
  const isMouse = useRef(false);

  const isOpen = swipedId === expense.id;

  // ปรับระยะดึงให้พอดีกับปุ่มวงกลม (ปุ่มวงกลมใช้พื้นที่ประมาณ 60px)
  let currentOffset = isOpen ? -70 : 0;
  if (drag.active) {
    currentOffset = (isOpen ? -70 : 0) + drag.offset;
    if (currentOffset > 0) currentOffset = 0;
    if (currentOffset < -90) currentOffset = -90; // ยืดสุดได้แค่ -90px
  }

  // เช็คว่าเริ่มโดนลากเกิน 5px หรือยัง เพื่อเปลี่ยนขอบการ์ดให้โค้งมน
  const isSwiped = currentOffset < -5;

  const startDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    setDrag({
      active: true,
      startX: clientX,
      startY: clientY,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
    if (swipedId !== expense.id) setSwipedId(null);
  };

  const moveDrag = (clientX, clientY) => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    const diffX = clientX - drag.startX;
    const diffY = Math.abs(clientY - drag.startY);

    if (!drag.scrolling && diffY > 15 && Math.abs(diffX) < 15) {
      setDrag((prev) => ({ ...prev, scrolling: true }));
    }
    if (drag.scrolling) return;
    setDrag((prev) => ({ ...prev, offset: diffX }));
  };

  const endDrag = () => {
    if (!drag.active) return;
    if (!drag.scrolling) {
      // ถ้าดึงเกิน -35 ให้ถือว่าเปิด
      if (currentOffset < -35) setSwipedId(expense.id);
      else setSwipedId(null);
    }
    setDrag({
      active: false,
      startX: 0,
      startY: 0,
      offset: 0,
      scrolling: false,
    });
  };

  return (
    // เปลี่ยนพื้นหลังหลักเป็นสีเดียวกับฉากหลัง เพื่อให้ปุ่มวงกลมดูลอยเด่นขึ้นมา
    <div
      className={`relative bg-gray-900 ${!isLast ? "border-b border-gray-800" : ""}`}
    >
      {/* 🗑️ กล่องปุ่ม Delete "วงกลม" สีแดง ลอยอยู่ขวาสุด */}
      <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-3 flex items-center justify-center">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            onDelete(expense.id);
            setSwipedId(null);
          }}
          //  กำหนดให้ปุ่มเป็นวงกลม (h-11 w-11 rounded-full)
          className="flex h-13 w-13 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-red-600"
          style={{
            // ถ้ายังดึงไม่ถึงระยะ ให้ซ่อนปุ่มไว้ก่อน (opacity) และให้มันค่อยๆ ขยายตัวโผล่มา (scale)
            opacity: currentOffset < -20 ? 1 : 0,
            transform: `scale(${Math.min(1.2, 0.2 + (-currentOffset / 70) * 0.8)})`,
            transition: drag.active ? "none" : "all 0.25s ease-out",
          }}
        >
          <Trash2 size={22} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 📱 เลเยอร์การ์ดสีเทาหลัก */}
      <div
        className={` relative z-10 flex cursor-grab touch-pan-y items-center justify-between  p-3 pl-8 active:cursor-grabbing ${isOpen || drag.active ? "bg-gray-700" : "bg-gray-800"}  `}
        style={{
          transform: `translate3d(${currentOffset}px, 0, 0)`,
          transition: drag.active ? "none" : "all 0.25s ease-out",
          //  สั่งให้ขอบขวา "โค้งมน (Rounded)" เมื่อเริ่มโดนลาก
          borderTopRightRadius: isSwiped ? "20px" : "0px",
          borderBottomRightRadius: isSwiped ? "20px" : "0px",
        }}
        // Touch
        onTouchStart={(e) =>
          startDrag(e.targetTouches[0].clientX, e.targetTouches[0].clientY)
        }
        onTouchMove={(e) =>
          moveDrag(e.targetTouches[0].clientX, e.targetTouches[0].clientY)
        }
        onTouchEnd={endDrag}
        // Mouse
        onMouseDown={(e) => {
          isMouse.current = true;
          startDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        }}
        onMouseMove={(e) => {
          if (isMouse.current) moveDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        }}
        onMouseUp={() => {
          if (isMouse.current) {
            isMouse.current = false;
            endDrag();
          }
        }}
        onMouseLeave={() => {
          if (isMouse.current) {
            isMouse.current = false;
            endDrag();
          }
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex-1 pointer-events-none">
          <p className="mb-0.5 text-xs text-gray-400">
            จ่ายโดย:{" "}
            <span className="font-bold text-lime-400">{expense.paid_by}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="font-medium text-gray-100">{expense.item_name}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{expense.category}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <p className="font-bold text-gray-100 pointer-events-none">
            ฿{formatMoney(expense.amount)}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onEdit(expense);
              setSwipedId(null);
            }}
            className="text-gray-400 transition hover:text-lime-400 z-20 relative"
          >
            <Edit2 size={16} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// 🧠 Component หลัก
export default function ExpenseList({
  expenses,
  groupedExpenses,
  loading,
  isExpanded,
  collapsedDates,
  onToggleExpanded,
  onToggleDate,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}) {
  const [swipedId, setSwipedId] = useState(null);

  const formatMoney = (value) =>
    Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm relative">
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-100">
          <Receipt size={20} /> <h2>รายการ ({expenses.length})</h2>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onToggleExpanded}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-300 shadow-sm"
        >
          {isExpanded ? <Minimize2 size={14} /> : <Maximize2 size={14} />}{" "}
          {isExpanded ? "ย่อเก็บ" : "ดูเต็ม"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">กำลังโหลด...</p>
      ) : expenses.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-4 text-center text-gray-400">ไม่มีรายการ</p>
      ) : (
        <div
          className={`space-y-4 pr-2 transition-all ${!isExpanded ? "max-h-96 overflow-y-auto overscroll-none" : ""}`}
        >
          {Object.keys(groupedExpenses).map((date) => (
            <div
              key={date}
              className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 shadow-sm"
            >
              <button
                onClick={() => onToggleDate(date)}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between rounded-t-lg border-b-2 border-gray-700 bg-gray-600 p-3 hover:bg-gray-600 relative z-20"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-gray-100">
                  {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                    <FolderClosed size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                  ) : (
                    <FolderOpen size={16} className="text-lime-400" />
                  )}
                  <span>{date}</span>
                  <span className="rounded-full bg-gray-700 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-normal text-gray-300">
                    {groupedExpenses[date].length} รายการ
                  </span>
                </div>
                {collapsedDates[date] ? (
                  <ChevronRight size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                ) : (
                  <ChevronDown size={18} className="text-lime-400" />
                )}
              </button>

              <div
                className={`grid transition-all duration-400 ease-in-out ${collapsedDates[date] ? "grid-rows-[0fr]" : "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"}`}
              >
                <div className="overflow-hidden bg-gray-900">
                  {groupedExpenses[date].map((expense, index) => (
                    <ExpenseItem
                      key={expense.id}
                      expense={expense}
                      swipedId={swipedId}
                      setSwipedId={setSwipedId}
                      onEdit={onEdit}
                      onDelete={onDelete}
                      formatMoney={formatMoney}
                      isLast={index === groupedExpenses[date].length - 1}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"

}


===== src/components/HistoryModal.jsx =====

import { History, RotateCcw, X } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect } from "react";

export default function HistoryModal({ expenses, onClose, onUndo }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleEsc = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEsc);
    };
  }, [onClose]);
  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-950/80 p-4"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="flex max-h-[80vh] w-full max-w-md flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 text-gray-100 shadow-2xl"
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-gray-800 p-4 text-lime-400">
          <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold">
            <History size={20} /> ประวัติการเคลียร์ยอด
          </h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="hover:text-lime-300">
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          {expenses.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-10 text-center text-gray-400">
              ยังไม่มีประวัติการโอนเงิน
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {expenses.map((expense) => (
                <div
                  key={expense.id}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-3"
                >
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                      {expense.expense_date}
                    </p>
                    <p className="font-medium text-gray-100">
                      {expense.item_name}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-right">
                    <p className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                      ฿{Number(expense.amount).toLocaleString()}
                    </p>
                    {/*  เปลี่ยนเป็นปุ่มกู้คืน (Undo) พร้อมไอคอน RotateCcw */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onUndo(expense.id)}
                      className="ml-2 flex items-center gap-1 rounded-3xl border border-sky-500/30 bg-sky-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-xs text-sky-400 transition hover:bg-sky-500 hover:text-gray-950"
                      title="กู้คืนรายการนี้"
                    >
                      <RotateCcw size={14} /> กู้คืนรายการ
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


===== src/components/SettlementCard.jsx =====

import { ArrowRight, CheckCircle, Trash2, Users } from "lucide-react"; // 🧠 เอา Plus ออก

export default function SettlementCard({
  settlements,
  onSettle,
  handleRemoveMember,
}) {
  const formatMoney = (value) =>
    value.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 });

  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm">
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-lime-400">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Users size={20} /> <h2>สรุปเคลียร์เงิน</h2>
        </div>
        {/* 🧠 ปุ่มเพิ่มสมาชิกถูกถอดออกไปแล้ว */}
      </div>
      <div className="mb-6 space-y-2">
        {settlements.transfers.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="py-2 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
            ทุกคนเคลียร์เงินครบแล้ว 🎉
          </p>
        ) : (
          settlements.transfers.map((transfer) => (
            <div
              key={`${transfer.from}-${transfer.to}`}
              className="rounded-lg border border-lime-900 bg-gray-800 p-3 "
            >
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium p-2 ">
                  <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.from}</span>
                  <ArrowRight size={16} className="text-gray-400" />
                  <span className="text-gray-100">{transfer.to}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                  ฿{formatMoney(transfer.amount)}
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() =>
                  onSettle(transfer.from, transfer.to, transfer.amount)
                }
                className="flex w-10/12 m-auto items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded bg-lime-500 py-2 text-xs text-gray-950 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-lime-300"
              >
                <CheckCircle size={14} /> เคลียร์ยอดนี้
              </button>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
      <hr className="my-4 border-gray-800" />
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <p className="mb-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-400">
          สรุปยอดสุทธิแต่ละคน
        </p>
        {settlements.balances.map((balance) => (
          <div
            key={balance.member}
            className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-gray-100">
              <span>{balance.member}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleRemoveMember(balance.member)}
                className="rounded p-1 text-red-500 transition hover:bg-red-100 hover:text-red-700"
                title={`ลบ ${balance.member}`}
                aria-label={`ลบ ${balance.member}`}
              >
                <Trash2 size={14} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              {balance.balance > 0.01 ? (
                <span className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                  (ได้คืน ฿{formatMoney(balance.balance)})
                </span>
              ) : balance.balance < -0.01 ? (
                <span className="font-bold text-red-500">
                  (ติดลบ ฿{formatMoney(Math.abs(balance.balance))})
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-400">(พอดี)</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}


===== src/components/TripHeader.jsx =====

// src/components/TripHeader.jsx

import { RefreshCw, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function TripHeader({ totalExpense, perPerson, isSyncing, onRefresh, MEMBERS }) {
  const [syncStatus, setSyncStatus] = useState("idle");

  // 1. ดักจับการเริ่มซิงก์และซิงก์เสร็จ
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isSyncing) {
      setSyncStatus("syncing");
    } else if (!isSyncing && syncStatus === "syncing") {
      setSyncStatus("success");
    }
  }, [isSyncing]); // เอา syncStatus ออกจาก dep จะได้ไม่เผลอไปตัด Timer ตัวเอง

  // 2. ดักจับตอนเป็น success ให้รอ 1.5 วิ แล้วค่อยกลับไป idle
  useEffect(() => {
    if (syncStatus === "success") {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setSyncStatus("idle"), 1500); // เพิ่มเวลาให้ดูแอนิเมชันทัน
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [syncStatus]);

  const formatMoney = (value) =>
    value.toLocaleString(undefined, {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 bg-gray-900 p-4 text-gray-100 shadow-md">
      {/*  แทรก CSS สำหรับทำแอนิเมชันวาดเส้นขีดถูก */}
      <style>{`
        @keyframes drawCheck {
          0% {
            stroke-dasharray: 50;
            stroke-dashoffset: 50;
          }
          100% {
            stroke-dasharray: 50;
            stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          }
        }
        .animate-draw {
          animation: drawCheck 0.4s ease-out ;
        }
      `}</style>

      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-md text-center">
        <button
          onClick={onRefresh}
          disabled={syncStatus === "syncing"} 
          // 🧠 ล็อกความกว้าง-สูงให้ปุ่ม (h-10 w-10) ป้องกันปุ่มขยับตอนสลับไอคอน
          className="absolute right-5 top-5 flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-800 transition hover:bg-gray-700"
          title="รีเฟรชข้อมูล"
        >
          {syncStatus === "syncing" ? (
            <RefreshCw size={40} className="animate-spin text-gray-400" />
          ) : syncStatus === "success" ? (
            //  เรียกใช้ class animate-draw ที่เราสร้างไว้ใน <style>
            <Check size={40} className="text-lime-400 animate-draw" />
          ) : (
            <RefreshCw size={40} className="text-gray-300 transition" />
          )}
        </button>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-light opacity-80">ยอดรวมค่าใช้จ่ายทั้งทริป</p>
        <h1 className="my-1 text-4xl font-bold">฿{formatMoney(totalExpense)}</h1>
        <p className="mt-3 inline-block rounded-full bg-gray-800 px-3 py-1 text-sm text-lime-400">
          หาร {MEMBERS.length} คน = ตกคนละ ฿{formatMoney(perPerson)}
        </p>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

===== src/App.jsx =====

import { ArrowRight, CheckCircle, Edit2, History, Receipt, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
import Swal from "sweetalert2";
import { CATEGORIES, HISTORY_CATEGORY, SWAL_THEME } from "./data/constants";
import { formatForDB, formatMoney, getStoredMemberDetails, getStoredMembers, getTodayISO, parseForUI } from "./utils/trip";
import ExpenseList from "./components/ExpenseList";
import HistoryModal from "./components/HistoryModal";
import MemberModal from "./components/MemberModal";
import PaymentModal from "./components/PaymentModal";
import SplitModal from "./components/SplitModal";
import TripHeader from "./components/TripHeader";

const supabase = createClient(
  import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL,
  import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
);

export default function App() {
  const [MEMBERS, setMembers] = useState(getStoredMembers);
  const [memberDetails, setMemberDetails] = useState(getStoredMemberDetails);
  const [paidBy, setPaidBy] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("defaultPaidBy");
    return saved && MEMBERS.includes(saved) ? saved : MEMBERS[0];
  });

  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [isListExpanded, setIsListExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [collapsedDates, setCollapsedDates] = useState({});
  const [showHistory, setShowHistory] = useState(false);
  const [showMemberModal, setShowMemberModal] = useState(false);
  const [activePayment, setActivePayment] = useState(null);
  const [activeSplitExpense, setActiveSplitExpense] = useState(null);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [swipedId, setSwipedId] = useState(null);

  const [date, setDate] = useState(getTodayISO());
  const [item, setItem] = useState("");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(CATEGORIES[0]);

  const [odometerStart, setOdometerStart] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("lastOdometerEnd") || "",
  );
  const [odometerEnd, setOdometerEnd] = useState("");
  const [fuelPrice, setFuelPrice] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("lastFuelPrice") || "",
  );
  const [fuelConsumption, setFuelConsumption] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("lastFuelConsumption") || "",
  );

  const [isPressing, setIsPressing] = useState(false);
  const pressTimer = useRef(null);
  const hasScrolled = useRef(false);

  const refreshExpenses = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSyncing(true);
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("trip_expenses")
      .select("*")
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
    if (error)
      Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "error",
        title: "โหลดข้อมูลไม่สำเร็จ",
        text: error.message,
      });
    else if (data) setExpenses(data);
    setTimeout(() => setIsSyncing(false), 500);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshExpenses().then(() => setLoading(false));
    const subscription = supabase
      .channel("trip_expenses_changes")
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "trip_expenses" },
        refreshExpenses,
      )
      .subscribe();
    return () => supabase.removeChannel(subscription);
  }, [refreshExpenses]);

  // หุบ Swipe อัตโนมัติเมื่อกดพื้นที่ว่าง
  const handleAppClick = () => {
    if (swipedId) setSwipedId(null);
  };

  const handleAddMember = (name, details) => {
    if (!MEMBERS.includes(name)) {
      const newMembers = [...MEMBERS, name];
      setMembers(newMembers);
      localStorage.setItem("tripMembers", JSON.stringify(newMembers));
      setPaidBy(name);
      localStorage.setItem("defaultPaidBy", name);

      if (details) {
        handleUpdateMemberDetails(name, details, false);
      }
      Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "success",
        title: `เพิ่ม ${name} สำเร็จ`,
        timer: 400,
        showConfirmButton: false,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateMemberDetails = (name, details, showToast = true) => {
    const updated = { ...memberDetails, [name]: details };
    setMemberDetails(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("memberDetails", JSON.stringify(updated));
    if (showToast)
      Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "success",
        title: "บันทึกข้อมูลเรียบร้อย",
        timer: 700,
        showConfirmButton: false,
      });
  };

  const handleRemoveMember = async (name, hasDebt) => {
    if (MEMBERS.length <= 1)
      return Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "warning",
        title: "ลบไม่ได้",
        text: "ต้องมีสมาชิกอย่างน้อย 1 คน",
      });
    if (hasDebt)
      return Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "error",
        title: "ลบไม่ได้",
        text: `${name} มียอดค้างชำระอยู่`,
      });

    const result = await Swal.fire({
      ...SWAL_THEME,
      title: "ยืนยันการลบ",
      text: `ลบ ${name} ออกจากทริป?`,
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: "ลบ",
      cancelButtonText: "ยกเลิก",
      customClass: {
        ...SWAL_THEME.customClass,
        confirmButton:
          "bg-red-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-600 transition text-sm cursor-pointer",
      },
    });
    if (!result.isConfirmed) return;

    const newMembers = MEMBERS.filter((m) => m !== name);
    setMembers(newMembers);
    localStorage.setItem("tripMembers", JSON.stringify(newMembers));
    const newDetails = { ...memberDetails };
    delete newDetails[name];
    setMemberDetails(newDetails);
    localStorage.setItem("memberDetails", JSON.stringify(newDetails));

    if (paidBy === name) {
      setPaidBy(newMembers[0]);
      localStorage.setItem("defaultPaidBy", newMembers[0]);
    }
    Swal.fire({
      ...SWAL_THEME,
      icon: "success",
      title: `ลบ ${name} แล้ว`,
      timer: 500,
      showConfirmButton: false,
    });
  };

  const handleAddExpense = async (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const numericAmount = Number(amount);
    if (!Number.isFinite(numericAmount) || numericAmount <= 0)
      return Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "warning",
        title: "กรุณากรอกจำนวนเงิน",
      });

    const payload = {
      expense_date: formatForDB(date),
      item_name: item.trim() || category,
      amount: numericAmount,
      category,
      paid_by: paidBy,
      split_between: [paidBy],
      odometer_start:
        category === "ค่าน้ำมัน" && odometerStart
          ? Number(odometerStart)
          : null,
      odometer_end:
        category === "ค่าน้ำมัน" && odometerEnd ? Number(odometerEnd) : null,
    };

    if (editId) {
      await supabase.from("trip_expenses").update(payload).eq("id", editId);
      setEditId(null);
    } else {
      await supabase.from("trip_expenses").insert([payload]);
    }

    if (category === "ค่าน้ำมัน") {
      if (odometerEnd) localStorage.setItem("lastOdometerEnd", odometerEnd);
      if (fuelPrice) localStorage.setItem("lastFuelPrice", fuelPrice);
      if (fuelConsumption)
        localStorage.setItem("lastFuelConsumption", fuelConsumption);
    }
    await refreshExpenses();
    setItem("");
    setAmount("");
    setCategory(CATEGORIES[0]);
    setOdometerStart(localStorage.getItem("lastOdometerEnd") || "");
    setOdometerEnd("");
    Swal.fire({
      ...SWAL_THEME,
      icon: "success",
      title: editId ? "แก้ไขสำเร็จ" : "บันทึกสำเร็จ",
      timer: 1000,
      showConfirmButton: false,
    });
  };

  const handleUpdateSplit = async (id, newSplit) => {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("trip_expenses")
      .update({ split_between: newSplit })
      .eq("id", id);
    if (error)
      Swal.fire({
        ...SWAL_THEME,
        icon: "error",
        title: "อัปเดตผู้หารไม่สำเร็จ",
        text: error.message,
      });
    else await refreshExpenses();
  };

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setItem("");
    setAmount("");
    setCategory(CATEGORIES[0]);
    setOdometerStart(localStorage.getItem("lastOdometerEnd") || "");
    setOdometerEnd("");
  };

  const startPressTimer = () => {
    hasScrolled.current = false;
    setIsPressing(true);
    pressTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
      hasScrolled.current = true;
      setIsPressing(false);
    }, 400);
  };
  const cancelPressTimer = () => {
    clearTimeout(pressTimer.current);
    setIsPressing(false);
  };

  const handleSettleDebt = async (from, to, settleAmount) => {
    const today = new Date();
    const formattedDate = `${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}/${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}/${today.getFullYear()}`;
    await supabase
      .from("trip_expenses")
      .insert([
        {
          expense_date: formattedDate,
          item_name: `[เคลียร์ยอด] ${from} -> ${to}`,
          amount: settleAmount,
          category: HISTORY_CATEGORY,
          paid_by: from,
        },
      ]);
    setActivePayment(null);
    await refreshExpenses();
  };

  const regularExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (e) => e.category !== HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const historyExpenses = expenses.filter(
    (e) => e.category === HISTORY_CATEGORY,
  );
  const groupedExpenses = useMemo(
    () =>
      regularExpenses.reduce((groups, expense) => {
        (groups[expense.expense_date] ||= []).push(expense);
        return groups;
      }, {}),
    [regularExpenses],
  );
  const totalExpense = useMemo(
    () => regularExpenses.reduce((sum, e) => sum + Number(e.amount), 0),
    [regularExpenses],
  );

  const settlements = useMemo(() => {
    const balances = MEMBERS.map((member) => ({ member, balance: 0 }));
    regularExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
      const payer = balances.find((b) => b.member === expense.paid_by);
      if (payer) payer.balance += Number(expense.amount);
      const splitMembers =
        Array.isArray(expense.split_between) && expense.split_between.length > 0
          ? expense.split_between
          : [expense.paid_by];
      const validSplit = splitMembers.filter((m) => MEMBERS.includes(m));
      if (validSplit.length > 0) {
        const costPerPerson = Number(expense.amount) / validSplit.length;
        validSplit.forEach((m) => {
          const debtor = balances.find((b) => b.member === m);
          if (debtor) debtor.balance -= costPerPerson;
        });
      }
    });
    historyExpenses.forEach((expense) => {
      const payer = balances.find((b) => b.member === expense.paid_by);
      if (payer) payer.balance += Number(expense.amount);
      MEMBERS.forEach((m) => {
        if (expense.item_name.includes(`-> ${m}`)) {
          const receiver = balances.find((b) => b.member === m);
          if (receiver) receiver.balance -= Number(expense.amount);
        }
      });
    });

    const debtors = balances
      .filter((b) => b.balance < -0.01)
      .map((b) => ({ ...b }));
    const creditors = balances
      .filter((b) => b.balance > 0.01)
      .map((b) => ({ ...b }));
    const transfers = [];
    let dIdx = 0,
      cIdx = 0;
    while (dIdx < debtors.length && cIdx < creditors.length) {
      const d = debtors[dIdx],
        c = creditors[cIdx];
      const amt = Math.min(Math.abs(d.balance), c.balance);
      if (amt > 0.01)
        transfers.push({ from: d.member, to: c.member, amount: amt });
      d.balance += amt;
      c.balance -= amt;
      if (Math.abs(d.balance) < 0.01) dIdx++;
      if (c.balance < 0.01) cIdx++;
    }
    return { balances, transfers };
  }, [MEMBERS, regularExpenses, historyExpenses]);

  return (
    <div
      className="relative min-h-screen bg-black pb-24 font-sans text-gray-100"
      onClick={handleAppClick}
    >
      <style>{`
        @keyframes drawRing { 0% { stroke-dashoffset: 176; } 100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
        .animate-draw-fast { animation: drawRing 0.4s linear forwards; }
      `}</style>

      {/*  เลขเวอร์ชันมุมขวาบน จางๆ เทาๆ */}

      <div className="fixed top-2 right-3 z-50 pointer-events-none select-none text-[10px] text-gray-700 opacity-50">
        v2.0.0
      </div>

      <TripHeader
        totalExpense={totalExpense}
        isSyncing={isSyncing}
        onRefresh={refreshExpenses}
        MEMBERS={MEMBERS}
        onOpenMemberModal={() => setShowMemberModal(true)}
      />

      <main className="mx-auto grid max-w-7xl grid-cols-1 items-start gap-6 p-4 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <section
          className={`rounded-xl border p-5 shadow-sm ${editId ? "border-lime-400 bg-gray-900" : "border-gray-700 bg-gray-900"}`}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lime-400">
            {editId ? <Edit2 size={20} /> : <Receipt size={20} />}{" "}
            <h2>{editId ? "แก้ไขรายการ" : "จดรายจ่ายใหม่"}</h2>
          </div>
          <form onSubmit={handleAddExpense} className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="date"
                value={date}
                onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDate(getTodayISO())}
                className="w-1/4 rounded-lg bg-lime-400 px-3 text-sm font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300"
              >
                วันนี้
              </button>
            </div>
            <select
              value={category}
              onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-sm text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            >
              {CATEGORIES.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt} value={opt}>
                  {opt}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>

            {category === "ค่าน้ำมัน" && (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 p-3 space-y-2">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                      ไมล์เริ่มต้น
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      placeholder="ไมล์เริ่มต้น"
                      value={odometerStart}
                      onChange={(e) => setOdometerStart(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-xs text-gray-100 focus:border-amber-400 focus:outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                      ไมล์สิ้นสุด
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      placeholder="ไมล์สิ้นสุด"
                      value={odometerEnd}
                      onChange={(e) => setOdometerEnd(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-xs text-gray-100 focus:border-amber-400 focus:outline-none"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="ชื่อรายการ (เว้นว่างได้)"
              value={item}
              onChange={(e) => setItem(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
            />
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <input
                type="number"
                inputMode="decimal"
                placeholder="0.00"
                value={amount}
                onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-100 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              />
              <select
                value={paidBy}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  if (e.target.value === "__ADD__") setShowMemberModal(true);
                  else {
                    setPaidBy(e.target.value);
                    localStorage.setItem("defaultPaidBy", e.target.value);
                  }
                }}
                className="w-full rounded-lg border border-gray-700 bg-gray-800 p-2 text-base font-bold text-gray-300 focus:border-lime-400 focus:outline-none"
              >
                {MEMBERS.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>
                    {m}
                  </option>
                ))}
                <option value="__ADD__">+ เพิ่มคนใหม่...</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* 🧠 แก้บั๊คฟอร์มแก้ไขให้มีปุ่มยกเลิก */}
            {editId ? (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="flex-[2] rounded-lg bg-lime-400 py-3 font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300"
                >
                  บันทึกแก้ไข
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={cancelEdit}
                  className="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-gray-700 py-3 font-bold text-gray-100 transition hover:bg-gray-600"
                >
                  ยกเลิก
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full rounded-lg bg-lime-400 py-3 font-bold text-gray-950 transition hover:bg-lime-300"
              >
                บันทึกรายการ
              </button>
            )}
          </form>
        </section>

        <div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
          <ExpenseList
            expenses={regularExpenses}
            groupedExpenses={groupedExpenses}
            loading={loading}
            isExpanded={isListExpanded}
            collapsedDates={collapsedDates}
            onToggleExpanded={() => setIsListExpanded(!isListExpanded)}
            onToggleDate={(val) =>
              setCollapsedDates((d) => ({ ...d, [val]: !d[val] }))
            }
            onEdit={(exp) => {
              setEditId(exp.id);
              setDate(parseForUI(exp.expense_date));
              setPaidBy(exp.paid_by);
              setItem(exp.item_name);
              setAmount(exp.amount);
              setCategory(exp.category);
              setOdometerStart(exp.odometer_start || "");
              setOdometerEnd(exp.odometer_end || "");
              window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
            }}
            onDelete={async (id) => {
              const r = await Swal.fire({
                ...SWAL_THEME,
                title: "ยืนยันการลบ?",
                showCancelButton: true,
                confirmButtonText: "ลบ",
              });
              if (r.isConfirmed) {
                await supabase.from("trip_expenses").delete().eq("id", id);
                refreshExpenses();
              }
            }}
            onOpenSplitModal={setActiveSplitExpense}
            swipedId={swipedId}
            setSwipedId={setSwipedId}
          />
        </div>

        <section className="rounded-xl border border-gray-700 bg-gray-900 p-5 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-lime-400">
            <Users size={20} /> สรุปเคลียร์เงิน
          </h2>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {settlements.transfers.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="py-2 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
                ทุกคนเคลียร์เงินครบแล้ว
              </p>
            ) : (
              settlements.transfers.map((t) => (
                <div
                  key={`${t.from}-${t.to}`}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-lime-900 bg-gray-800 p-3"
                >
                  <div className="mb-2 flex justify-between p-2">
                    <div className="flex gap-2 font-medium">
                      <span className="text-gray-100">{t.from}</span>
                      <ArrowRight size={16} className="text-gray-400" />
                      <span className="text-gray-100">{t.to}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-lime-400">
                      ฿{formatMoney(t.amount)}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setActivePayment(t)}
                    className="m-auto flex w-10/12 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded bg-lime-500 py-2 text-xs text-gray-950 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-lime-300"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle size={14} /> เคลียร์ยอดนี้
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <div className="fixed bottom-10 right-6 z-40 flex items-center justify-center">
        {isPressing && (
          <svg
            className="absolute inset-0 h-[68px] w-[68px] -translate-x-[2px] -translate-y-[2px] -rotate-90 pointer-events-none"
            viewBox="0 0 64 64"
          >
            <circle
              cx="32"
              cy="32"
              r="28"
              stroke="#D7FF3B"
              strokeWidth="4"
              fill="none"
              strokeDasharray="176"
              strokeDashoffset="176"
              className="animate-draw-fast"
            />
          </svg>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (!hasScrolled.current) setShowHistory(true);
          }}
          onMouseEnter={startPressTimer}
          onMouseLeave={cancelPressTimer}
          onTouchStart={startPressTimer}
          onTouchEnd={cancelPressTimer}
          className={`flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-gray-950 shadow-xl transition-all duration-200 ${isPressing ? "scale-110 bg-amber-700" : "bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600"}`}
        >
          <History size={28} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 🧠 นำ Modal กลับมาแสดงผลให้ถูกต้อง */}
      {showMemberModal && (
        <MemberModal
          members={MEMBERS}
          balances={settlements.balances}
          memberDetails={memberDetails}
          onClose={() => setShowMemberModal(false)}
          onAdd={handleAddMember}
          onRemove={handleRemoveMember}
          onUpdateDetails={handleUpdateMemberDetails}
        />
      )}
      {activePayment && (
        <PaymentModal
          from={activePayment.from}
          to={activePayment.to}
          amount={activePayment.amount}
          memberDetails={memberDetails}
          onClose={() => setActivePayment(null)}
          onUpdateDetails={handleUpdateMemberDetails}
          onConfirm={handleSettleDebt}
        />
      )}
      {activeSplitExpense && (
        <SplitModal
          expense={activeSplitExpense}
          members={MEMBERS}
          onClose={() => setActiveSplitExpense(null)}
          onSave={handleUpdateSplit}
        />
      )}
      {showHistory && (
        <HistoryModal
          expenses={historyExpenses}
          onClose={() => setShowHistory(false)}
          onUndo={async (id) => {
            await supabase.from("trip_expenses").delete().eq("id", id);
            refreshExpenses();
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
